tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 bskal pa'i gtam gleng dmar ldang ma

tei:publicationStmt.tei:distributor: This OCR'd text was generated using UCB's Namsel-OCR application on Jul 23, 2014 at the request of the Tibetan Buddhist Resource Center. Please note this document has not been finalized and is subject to additional changes and corrections.

tei:div.tei:p: ༄tsho//bskal pa'i gtam gleng dmar ldang ma/'brong bu tshe ring rdo rjesabartsams/ mirigasadape skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/bsam blo gsar brje dang 'du shes gsar bsgyur bya rgyu ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang mi rigs yar thon 'byung byed kyi gzhi rtsa'i sgul shugs yin pas bsam blo'i gleng slong 'khrug cha 'khol ba byas nas me tog mnyam bzhad dang / mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi rnam pa shar ba bya rgyu ni dmigs yul de nyid 'grub byed kyi thabs lam dam pa yin no/ / kun slong de yis rgyud bskul nas deb chung 'di nyid khyed kyi spyan sngar phul ba lags/deb 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos gtso bo deng rabs kyi rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi lta tshul spyad nas sher rtogs rig pa'i skor la zhib 'jug byas te bod kyi srol rgyun lta tshul 'ga' zhig bsgyur bcos sam legs bcos byas na bod ljongs 'di nyid 'phel rgyas mgyogs tsam yong bar sman pa'i 'dod tshul bton yod pa de ni rang cag dus gsum kun tu dge ba'i legs bshad du 'khums pa khyed kyis mkhyen gsal bzhin no/ /lta ba gsar pa'am thabs lam gsar pa spyad nas srol rgyun rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed skabs gang de'i dge skyon rob tsam ma gleng thabs med yin pa'i khar gnad don 'ga' zhig thad re zhig tshang ma mos mthun yong rgyu'ang ha cang dka' bas nongs cha ci yod gzigs dpyad skabs bod la byams brtse che ba gang nyid kyi thugs rje'i klong nas bzod sgom yong ba dang blang dor gyi cha la mi rmongs par 'tshal/mi rigasadape skrun khang /

dkar chaga'ago brjod sems kyi dbal rlabs/ (1)rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi lta tshul gyis shes rtogs rig pa'i sgyur bcos skor gleng ba/ (1)dang po/ rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi khyab khongs/ (1)gnyis pa/ 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas gsar pa'i dngos yod rang bzhin/ (16)gsum pa/ rtog 'jug dang dpyad gzhigs/ bsam blo'i phyi don rang bzhin skor/ (33)bod kyi deng rabs sher rtogs rig pa'i ma lag gsar 'dzugs skor gyi dpyad gleng / (68)sher rtogs rig pa dang chos lugs dbar gyi he bag skor thog mar gleng ba/ (101)gcig byung ba'i rkyen dang dus kyi thog nas rig sgo gnyis kyi khyad par brjod pa/ (104)gnyis/ rig sgo gnyis kyi brjod bya dang ngo bo/ (109)gsum/ mjug gtam sna tshogs rol mo'i 'gyur khug (113)bdag gi lta tshul 'ga' zhig gi gsed 'grol/ (119)gcig rnam rtog dang yid dpyod zung gis skul ba'i gleng brjod/ (119)gnyis/ gnad don dang bsam gzhigs dbar gyi gdam nga / (120)gsum/ dbyad gleng shes rab dang gdags gzhi mtshan nyid dbar gyi 'jigs nyen/ (125)1

bzhi/ tha snyad mtshon don dang sdeb spyor rtog ge'i dbar gyi 'gal 'brel/ (135)lnga/ phyi don bden grub dang dngos thog bden 'tshol/ dngos yod spyi tshogs dang bdag gi rtsa don bcas kyi kha phyogs/ (140)drug brjod 'dod gtam gyis spel ba'i sems dang sems kyi zung sbrel/(143)zur bkod/'khyar bon dang ma ni'i chos lugs skor las 'phros pa'i gtam/ (149)dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus/ (167)gcig dge lugs pa zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul/ (167)gnyis/ rje blo bzang grags pa'i mi tshe dang / bya gzhag phugs bsam/ (169)gsum/ dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag (172)bzhi/ sgom pad ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor/ (184)lnga/ spyod pa/ phyi'i 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang nang gi rim gnyis rnal 'byor/ (186)bod kyi sad mi'i skor gyi gleng gzhi thog ma/ (188)gcig sad mi'i rtso/ don/ (188)gnyis/ sad mi byung ba'i dus tshigs/ (190)gsum/ sad mi ci yod kyi grangs 'dren lugs/ (194)bzhi/ sad mi tsho'i ming yig 'bri stangs/ (196)lnga/ nges par 'tshol dgos pa'i dris lan/ (204)2

'bo bachong sems bi ngabal rabs// ——ra / tshangapho / /ba/da rang gisarang la gtam du byasapa'i gtam/1dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni bya dngos dang mtshan nyid dbar du dbye mtshams gsal bor 'byed pa'i dus rabs shig yin pa dang / dus rabs 'di'i nyams 'gyur gtso bo ni mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo dang dngos po'i phyogs gang yod khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i dus rabs shig yin pa ma zad de ni dus rabs gzhan dang sto nga lo gzhan gang dang yang mi mtshungs pa'i re ltos kyis khengs pa'i dus rabs shig kyang red/ dus rabs 'di'i nang nga tshos bskyar du dus rabs nyi shu pa'i mtshan snyan skam po der yid phyogs te dus rabs 'phel rgyas kyi sgo'i phyi rol nas 'greng pa yin na gzhar yang nga tshor thob pa'i sdom tshig ni ‘‘smyu gu 'then nas skye rogs ’’dang ‘‘sdong rtsar ri bong la sgug pa'i ’’gtam rgyud gsar ba zhig bskrun rgyu las gzhan spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas la phan thogs spu tsam yang yod pa ma red/ skabs de dus nged cag gi skad cha re re ni khrag gi thigs pa re re dang /nga tsho dang kha gtad du langs pa ni rig pa'i stobs dang dpal 'byor rgyas thad skul lcag thebs nus pa'i deng rabs rig gnas kyi ma lag gsar ba zhig yin rgyu phar zhog/ srol rgyun rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i sgo mo de'ang khegs 'gro nges red/ red lags/ 'dzam gling gi rig gnas de sa gzhi ril mo'i khyon kun tu sa khyab rdo khyab du dar ba'i lo nyi shu'i ring nga tshor yang mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar rig gnas dang lta tshul/ tshan rig dang lag rtsal/ bsam blo dang gsar kitod

kyi spobs par slob sbyong byed pa'i go skabs legs po zhig byung yod mod/ rang re'iblo gros can su zhig gis go skabs de nyid dam 'dzin byas te spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas thad sman pa'i rig gnas bsam blo'i ma lag gsar ba zhig nged cag gi mdun du drangs yod dam/ lar gnad don gaṭa/ra pa'i gleng slong dang / lta tshul gsar ba'i rtsod gleng / bsam blo gsar ba'i gsar gtod gang yang min pa'i nyi tshe ba'i gleng brjod kha shas la'ang mtshan nyid mkhan po dang yig rmongs so nam pa tshos ‘‘lta ba log pa ’’zhes pa'i zhwa mo nag po zhig g.yogs rgyu ma zad kha rdung sna tshogs gtong gi yod mod/ don du rang gis rang la brnyas pa dang rang gis rang la gyong gud bskrun rgyu las sa gzhi ril mo ni nam rgyun ltar 'khor bskyod byed kyang ‘‘'jon thang bral ba'i u tshugs pa tsho ’’zhes spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas la khas len byed mi 'dod rme khan de tshor zur za byed/ mi rigs gang dang gang yin rung 'phel rgyas kyi rmang gzhi ni rang la sngar yod pa'i srol rnyen gyi rig gnas bsam blo de yin pa dang / 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi sgul shugs gtso bo ni dus rabs 'phel rgyas kyi khrod du gsar gtod byas pa'i rig gnas bsam blo gsar ba de red/ da lta'i char 'phel rgyas mgyogs po yin pa'i mi rigs gang gis kyang rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gsar ba spangs te dngos yod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong thub med pa ni mig dang ldan pa su zhig gis yid ngor sgrub par nus/ nged cag gis brgyud zin pa'i lo rgyus la phyir mig bltas tshe hang sangs pa'i gnad don gzhan zhig mchis pa ni chos lugs kyi lta tshul dang dad pa de nyid nam yang bsam blo zhig dang rig gnas shig tshan rig gi lta tshul zhig gi sngon du 'gro bzhin yod pa ma zad ha cang gal 'gangs che ba'i gnaṭage babs su gyur yod pa dang / mi zhig gi spyi tshogs thog gi 'gul spyod yod dgu'i tshad gzhi de'ang chos lugs kho nar ngos 'dzin byas yod pa red/ yin yang mi rigs shig gi spyod lam 2

yod tshad dang tha na rang nyid kyi 'tsho sdod slad rang byung khams dang kha gtad gcog pa'i bsam blo'i drag chas kyang chos lugs lha sgrung dang 'jig rten pha rol gyi slad du brtson pa'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba zhig gi thog gzhi bcol ba yin na mi rigs der dngos po'i dpal yon gyis phyug pa'i mdun lam zhig sus bskrun thub/ nga tshor dngos po'i 'byor ba ji tsam med pa de bzhin du sems kyang dbul bo yin pa thag gis chod pas dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon dbar du phan tshun 'phel rgyas gtong res byed pa'i rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba zhig yod pa der nges par du do snang byed dgos la/ spyi tshogs de nyid 'thus tshang gi sgo nas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rtags mtshan yang dpal yon gnyis kyis phyug pa'i snang tshul de yin pa ni smos ma dgos/ des na spyi tshogs hril pos nges par gtsigs chen dang bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa'i gnad don ni ji ltar 'tsho sdod dang / ji ltar spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong ba/ ji ltar bsam pa'i dpal yon dang dngos po'i dpal yon gyis phyug pa'i spyi tshogs gsar ba zhig 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i thabs lam de red/2mi zhig gi mi tshe de mi'i rigs kyi mi tshe'i lo rgyus dang sbyor skabs dus yun thung ngu zhig yin na'ang mi rang nyid kyi mi tshe dang bsdur dus shin tu nas yun ring po zhig red/ mi zhig gi mi tshe'i khrod du lo bca phrag kha shas las med pa dang / de ༄las bcu phrag snga ma kha shas ni slob pa'i go rim dang bcu phrag mtha' ma dag ni mjug bsdu ba'i dus tshigs red/ rim can gyi go rim de'i khrod du bar dkyil gyi bcu phrag kha shas ni nged cag gi mi tshe la rin thang skrun byed kyi dus tshod gtso bo du gyur yod pa dang / kho bor mtshon na mi tshe'i khrod kyi bcu phrag gsum pa nas mgo brtsams te mi tshe'i rin thang skrun pa'i go skabs shig dus rabs 'phel rgyas 3kyis

bdag gi spyi bor bstsal na'ang rin thang de nyid mngon 'gyur gyi slad du sha dang rus pa'i brtse dungs mang po zhig brjod du bral ba'i bsam blo zhig gis snang med du bcom song / nga rang rtsom yig spel ba'i lam khar zhugs pa de nas bzung gnad don kha shas kyi zhib 'jug thad spobs pa chen pos hur brtson byas yod na'ang dris lan la nges shes 'drongs thub pa'i blo skyed cig ster thub med/ de bzhin zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs mang po zhig la nga tshos gom pa gsar du bsgyur dgos pa mthong tshe ngu dang dgod kyi tshor ba'ang dbang med du 'byung / 'on te gnad don zhig gi mdun du nga rang tsho dngos gnas drang gnas kyi gnyom chung nus med par gyur yod pa ste de ni sngon thon dang rjes lus zhes pa'i gnad don gyi rtsa gnad de red/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa zin pa'i de ring gi nyin mo 'dir yang nged cag khrod kyi shes yon can kha shas kyis sngon thon dang rjes lus gnyis kyi go don la dbye 'byed de tsam byed thub kyi med pa dang / bod mi rigs rjes lus red ces lta tshul zhig gleng slong byed skabs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi legs cha gang yod drangs te sngon thon yin pa'i yin rab brjod kyi yod mod/ don du 'jig rten gyi 'phel phyogs ngos 'dzin byed ma thub pa'i skyon te sa gzhi ril mo'i thog 'tsho sdod byed bzhin pa'i mi rigs gang la rang gi mes pos bskrun pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas med pa ma red/ srol rgyun rig gnas ni 'das zin pa'i mes po tshos gsar skrun byas pa yin pas nga tshor rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod la/blang dor byed pa'i dbang cha'ang yod/ der ma zad dus rabs kyi 'tsho sdod pa (mi)rnams kyis shes rab spyad de rang gi mes po tsho las lhag pa'i shes rab kyi nus pa 'don spel byed dgos pa'ang smos ga la dgos/ der brten sngon thon dang rjes lus kyi go don yang dus rabs 'phel ba'i kha phyogs kyi sgo nas 'jog dgos kyi yod la/ deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas ni dngos po'i dpal yon yin 4

phyir nga tshos rol bzhin pa'i dngos po'i dpal yon gyi chu tshad dang mi rigs gzhan gyi dngos po'i dpal yon gyi chu tshad gnyis bsdur tshe nga tshos rol bzhin pa'i 'tsho ba ni gna' snga mo'i 'tsho ba'i rnam pa zhig tu snang / de bas/ nga tsho rjes lus red zer don gyi rtsa ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di dang thug yod pa dang / snang tshul 'di ni nga tsho tshang mar kha yod lag yod du gyur ba zhig yin phyir khas len byed mi thub pa'ang ga la yod/ gal srid nga tshos tshang mar shin tu rgyus mnga' che ba'i don gnad 'di khas mi len zer na de ni khyod kyi gnad don te dngos po'i 'tsho ba la longs spyod byed mi 'dod mkhan su zhig yod/ spyir yang nged cag gi shes ldan pa kha shas ni rang kho na'i bde skyid la bsam blo gtong mkhan yin pas rang nyid kyi 'thus tshab las rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi bde skyid la mno sems gtong mkhan zhig gtan nas ma red/ nga tsho deng rabs kyi shes ldan pa rnams ni dus rabs gsar ba'i khrod du 'tshar longs byung ba yin pas rang nyid kyi khe phan chung ba spangs te rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi slad du las don la brtson sems che ba zhig dang / srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs tshan rtsal zung 'brel/ bsam pa'i dpal yon dang dngos po'i dpal yon zung du 'brel ba'i bsam blo'i lam btod mkhan zhig lhag don deng rabs rig gnas kyi ma lag 'dzugs mkhan zhig tu 'gyur thub par brtson rgyu ni rtsom pa po bdag gi re 'dun nyag gcig go/slad mar zhu 'dod pa ni dpe deb 'di nyid dal 'gyangs med par klog pa po rnams kyi mdun du bstar thub pa ni rtsom sgrig mkhan po dang reb kong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi tshong rams pa rdo rje bkra shis lags kyis mthun rkyen sbyar ba yin pas 'dir dmigs su thugs rje che zhu ba lags/ /2001lo'i ston gzhug tu lha ldan grong du sbyar ba'o/ /5

༄tsho/ / rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi lta tshul gyis shes rtogs rig pa'i sgyur bcos skor gleng ba/—rig stobasakyisa'atsho ba'i dusarabasashig gi sngon dpag dang bsgragasagatam/dang po/ rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi khyab khongs/ka kha sangs gi drang bden de nyid de ring gi drang bden yang yin pa dang / kha sang gi lo rgyus kyis de ring gi lo rgyus kyi 'thus tshab byed thub pa/ ke re si'i phu lad thu (2sbyibyaspyo0)yis rgya gar gyi ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'thus tshab kyang byed thub pa yin na nga tshos ri bo hi ma la sems pa'i dus rma chen sbom ras 'thus tshab byas chog pa dang / tshag sha mkho ba'i dus lug sha tshab tu byas chog mod gnad don dngos ni 'jig rten gyi bya dngos thams cad phan tshun gang gis kyang 'thus tshab byed mi thub pa zhig yin pa dang / nga tshos nges par du rtogs dgos pa'ang 'jig rten rang nyid 'gal ba'i chos nyid cig la brten te 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i ngang tshul de red/ ngang tshul de ni 'jig rten rang nyid 1

'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi rtsa ba'i sgul shugs yin pa dang mi'i rigs kyi zhib 'jug pa tshos de'i ming la 'gal ba'i drang bden zhes brjod kyi yod pa red/kha red lags/ 'gal ba'i drang bden de'i phan nus ni nga tshos 'tshol dgos shing rgyus lon byed dgos pa zhig yin pa ma zad nga tshos nges par gtsigs chen dang do snang byed dgos pa'i drang bden zhig kyang red/ lo rgyus thog gcig gyur gyi drang bden nam 'jig rten mthar thug gi drang bden der snang zhen ches drags pa des rig gnas kyi lta tshul hril po da ngos yod spyi tshogs dang kha bral ba'i 'du shes kyi rmang gzhi'i thog 'dzugs gnyer byas yod pa dang / shes ldan mi sna dang 'phrin gsar/ rig gnas shes bya nyid spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i sgul shugs su 'gyur ba'i deng rabs kyi tshul ldan shes rig dang deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi mdun du nga tshos so so'i sngar yod kyi rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul der bsam gzhigs dang gdam nga byed rgyu ni spyi tshogs kyis sprad pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin pa ma zad dus rabs dang 'tsham pa'i dbyangs rta zhig dang rjes lus mi rigs nas sngon thon mi rigs kyi gras su slebs thub pa'i thabs shes dang rgyu mtshan nyag gcig kyang red/ka 'o na thog mar nga tshos ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa ni bod kyi ‘‘rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul ’’zhes pa'i khyab khongs de yin pa dang /bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad zhen che ba tshos bod kyi shes rig gi rmang gzhi de sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi shes rig nyid yin par 'dod pa dang / bon chos la mos mkhan tshos bod kyi shes rig gi thog ma'i 'byung khungs ni g.yung drung bon gyi shes rig yin par brjod/ de 2

la btang snyoms pa tshos bon po'i chos lugs dang nang bstan chos lugs kyi 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ba/ phyogs gzhan nas chos lugs gnyis por dag sgrig dang chos lugs kyis rang nyid legs sgrig dang dag ther/snyigs dor bcud len byas rjes su ma lag tu grub pa de ni deng rabs bod kyi shes rig gi ma lag yin par 'dod pa ni skabs babs su dngos yod du 'gyur ba phar zhog 'byung 'gyur gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang gtan du grub mi thub pa zhig red/ rgyu mtshan ni 'di lta ste bod kyi ‘‘rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi khyab khongs ’’zhes brjod tshe bod mi rigs gzhi grub pa nas 'tsho sdod kyi rmang gzhir gyur pa'i zhing las (so nam )rig gnas dang 'brog las (phyugs las )rig gnas 'dus yod pa ma zad dge rgan brgyud slob sbyong byas pa min pa dang rang so so'i lag len gyi khrod nas thad kar bed spyod byas shing phyogs bsdus byed khag pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul can gyi mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas dushig kyang 'dus yod pas bod kyi ‘‘rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi khyab khongs ’’su bon gyi shes rig dang bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs gnyis las 'dus med par brjod tshe khyab chung ba'i skyon du mi 'gyur grang /kha/ khyod kyi lta tshul ltar na bod kyi ‘‘rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi khyab khongs ’’su zhing las rig gnas dang 'brog las rig gnas/mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas/ bon gyi shes rig dang bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs bcas rig gnas kyi phung po lnga 'dus yod pa dang / bod rig pa zhes brjod tshe'ang gong gsal rig gnas kyi phung po chen po lngas grub pa e red/ka 'das zin pa'i zhib 'jug gi go rim khrod du 'thus shor du 3

song ba'i nged cag gi ches che ba'i nor 'khrul zhig ni rig gnas kyi khyon yongs kyi go don skor la bsam 'ib ma byas par bod kyi rig gnas yin na sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis khyab par 'dod pa dang / bon gyi shes rig ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyab khongs su tshud pa'i grub mtha' zhig dang yang na sangs rgyas chos lugs can gyi bon chos su ngos 'dzin byas te dpyad zhib byas pa las zhing las dang 'brog las/ mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas de'i phyogs su zhib 'jug gang yang byas med pa ma zad de dag rig gnas kyi khyab kho/ ngas shig tu'ang ngos 'dzin gtan nas ma byas pas da cha 'tsho sdod kyi bsam blo skyo po dang 'tsho sdod 'gran rtsod kyi nus pa zhan por gyur yod pa red/ deng dus 'dzam gling hril por bsam pa'i tshul ldan shes rig dang dngos po'i tshul ldan shes rig ces phyogs chen po gnyis su dbye yod pa las nga tshos da lta'i char gtsigs chen du 'dzin pa ni bsam pa'i tshul ldan shes rig gi khyab khongs su gyur pa'i bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon gyi shes rig gnyis yin zhing de las kyang dad pa'i char gyur pa'i bsam blo'i stobs de nyid dang len byed rgyu las mi'i rigs kyi dngos yod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su ji ltar gtong dgos pa'i thabs lam skor dang thon skyed nus shugs gsar skrun byed pa'i tshan rig shes bya'i thad zhib 'jug gang yang byed thub med pa dang / mjug 'bras ni bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon gyi shes rig gang yin rung mi'i rigs spyi tshogs dang kha bral ba'i 'du shes shig dang 'jig rten pha rol gyi las don sgrub byed dang gshin por dge chos sgrub byed kyi yo byad 'ba' zhig tu gyur yod pa red/ dngos gnas bshad na gtan tshigs (drang bden )dang lag len gyi rtsa don ni 4

dngos yod spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur gtong rgyu de yin pas dngos yod spyi tshogs der snang chung khur med byas pa yin na de ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgongs pa dang 'gal ba zhig red ces nga tshos brjod thub/('di ni ljar pan pa ad khe rda rde sa khu'i skad cha yin/)lhag don nga tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs la rig gnas zhes 'bod kyi yod la/ rig pa ni blo dang gnas ni yul du ngos 'dzin byas tshe de las gsal por rtogs thub pa ni blo'i kha gtad yul dngos po'i 'jig rten yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de ma red dam/kha yang dag pa'i bsam blo'i nus stobs ni rtsa ba'i thog spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur gtong byed dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded gtong byed de bsam blo'i nus stobs ni spyi tshogs kyi stobs shugs gzhan gang dang bsdur tshe'ang nus stobs shin tu che ba zhig red/ de lta yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni yang dag pa'i bsam blo de mi re 'ga' la yang dag pa'i bsam blo ru gyur pa dang / yang na bsam blo'i 'pho 'gyur gyi mtshams su 'gyur ba gang yang med pa'i rkyen gyis red/ yang dag pa'i bsam blos nam yang rgyun 'khyongs byed nges pa ni phyi don bden grub dang dngos thog bden 'tshol yin pa dang / 'jig rten gyi ngo bo yang dngos thog bden 'tshol dang phyi don bden grub kyi rtsa don zhig yin pas red/'das pa'i lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring nga tshos dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi yang dag pa'i bsam blo spyad de bod kyi ‘‘rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi ’mikhyab khongs der dpyad zhib dang rtog 'jug gdeng 'jog ma byas par brten ‘‘rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul ’’gyi go don de yang sgra dog 'jug gi rig gnas kyi mtshan nyid cig tu 'phel rgyas phyin te rig gnas 5

kyi ma lag hril por rtsa ba brlan dang bral ba'i ljon pa ltar nyab be nyob be zhig tu gyur yod pa ni da lta'i char dngos su mthong thub pa 'dis sgrub nus shing rig stobs kyis 'tsho ba'i dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang du'ang zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu dag la zhib bsher dang rtog 'jug gi sgo mo gsar pa zhig phye ma thub pa yin na/ mig sngar yod pa'i rig gnas kyi ma lag hril por zha 'khums kyi nad 'byung nges pa ni ra sprod byed mi dgos pa'i bden pa zhig yin tsa na/ nga rang ngos nas khyod kyis rig gnas kyi phung po chen po lngas bod kyi rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul grub par brjod pa'i bsam zhib der mos mthun zhu rgyu yin/ mi'i rigs 'tsho sdod kyi go rim khrod du mi'i rigs rang la thog mar dar ba'am mi'i rigs rang gis thog mar gsar gtod byas pa ni zhing las dang 'brog las/ mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas bcas yin la bon gyi shes rig (de la brdol bon ni gdod ma'i dus su bod dmangs khrod du rang bzhin gyis dar rgyas byung ba'i chos lugs shig yin pa dang man ju'i skad du shaka men chos lugs zer ba dang gcig par 'dod pas brtag go)dang bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs gnyis ni (chos lugs 'di gnyis kyi khrod du yi ge byung ba nas mi'i rigs kyis gsar gtod byas pa'i rig gnas kyi rnam grangs khag 'dus pa dang /yi ge ma dar sngon gyi nags las dang chu bed spyad pa ni zhing las dang 'brog las gnyis kyi khongs su gtogs par snyam/)spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i tshul ldan gyi go rim dang yi ge dar 'phel byung ba'i 'gros dang bstun te dar rgyas byung ba zhig red/ der brten deng dus nga tshos zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa ni yi ge gsar gtod byas pa nas dar 'phel byung ba'i bon gyi shes rig dang bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rnam grangs khag yin pa las 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas te zhing las dang / 'brog las/ mi mngon sbas 6

pa'i rig gnas kyi skor la zhib 'jug byed thub kyi med pa dang / de ni bod mi rnams zungs khrag bzo ba'i nus pa zhan por 'gyur byed kyi rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen gyi gras shig red/ka der ma zad sems kyi 'tsho ba ni gnad don yod tshad thag gcod byed kyi gnyen po zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod mod/ dngos don gyi srang la gzhal ba'i dus gzhung lugs kyi thog nas khas len thub pa de lag len gyi khrod du khungs med du 'gyur bzhin pa ni grod khog stong pa'i dus sems kyi bde ba gang du 'tshol dgos pa dang / mi'i rigs lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa ni grod khog stong pa'i sgo nas sems kyi bde ba 'tshol mkhan de red/ de'i phyir nga tshos zhing las dang 'brog las kyi rig gnas der zhib 'jug gting zab byed dgos la/ nga tshos zhib 'jug byed si 'i dus nges par do snang byed dgos pa ni zhing las rig gnas dang 'brog las rig gnas kyi slad du zhing 'brog rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed pa ma yin par 'tsho sdod kyi thabs lam gsar pa zhig 'don spel 'ong ba'i ched zhing 'brog rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed dgos pa dang / zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu de ni rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi 'ding byed du 'gyur bar byed dgos/ zhing las dang 'brog las rig gnas rang la mtshon na/ chab mdo kha rub dang lha sa'i byang rgyud kyi sa'i 'og nas thon pa'i rdo chas gsar ma'i dus rabs kyi rdo chas dang / rus grub yo chas/ rdza chas/ phag pa'i keng rus sogs kyis mtshon nus pa ni skabs de dus thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas su cung tsam phyin yod pa dang / mi rnams kyis zhing las kyi dpal 'byor gtso bor spel te gtan sdod kyi 'tsho ba zhig rol bzhin yod pa 7

mtshon thub pa ma zad chab mdo kha rub grong tsho nas rnyed pa'i ma rmos lo tog gi sa bon des ra sprod byed thub pa ni lo stong phrag lnga'i snga rol tu bod ljongs su/ sa bon 'debs 'gugs kyi las rigs shig dar yod pa de red/yang rang skyong ljongs rig dngos do dam cus kyis brtag dpyad byas pa ltar na/ ding ri rdzong dang / shan rtsa/ ru thog nas rnyed pa'i da lta'i dbar lo ngo khri gcig nas gsum 'das zin pa'i rdo chas rnying ma de dag gis bod ljongs su gdod ma'i dus nas mi'i rigs kyis 'gul bskyod spel myong ba dang / mi rnams kyis ri dwags rngon pa dang shing tog 'ethu ba'i dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba rol myong zhes brjod pa ltar/ 'brog las rig gnas de zhing las rig gnas las ma mtha' yang lo ngo stong phrag lnga lhag gis snga ba yod pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni ri dwags rngon pa'i las ka de rdo chas rnying ma'i dus su byung ba dang rdo chas rnying ma ni lo ngo khri gcig nas gsum dbar gyi gong rol tu byung bas red/ gang ltar phyugs rigs las gnyer gyi go rim khrod du bod mi tshos g.yag dang ba glang / rta dang bong bu/ lug dang ra ma/ bya de dang phag pa sogs sgo phyugs su gnyer yod pa ma zad bod kyi g.yag dang bod kyi rta/ bod kyi lug ces rigs rgyud spus legs can du las snon dang do dam byas te bod ljongs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la skul lcag chen po zhig btang yod pa ni da lta'i char ra sprod gsal por byed thub pa de lta bu'o/ /kha/ zhing las rig gnas dang 'brog 'al rig gnas kyi tshul ldan shes rig gtso bor spel ba'i mtshar sdug 'bras bus bskrun pa'i gna' rabs kyi tshul ldan shes rig de chos lugs dar ba'i 'du shes dang lha'i rig pa'i dbang sgyur 'og yid mug mdog nyams kyi gnas su gyur pa 8

dang / tshul ldan shes rig de'i tshab byed mkhan ni khungs med dang rjes lus/ sger sdom lam lugs can gyi rmongs dad 'du shes shig red/sher rtogs rig pa dang sgyu rtsal gyi cha gang yod lha'i rig pa'i bran g.yog tu gyur yod pa ma zad sher rtogs rig pas 'jig rten gyi bsam blo'i nus par mdzub ston byed pa'i tshugs thub kyi gshis rkya/ de'ang rtsa ba nas med par bzos yod pa red/ ma gzhir spyi tshogs de'i khrod du shugs snon rgyag bzhin pa ni rmongs dad kyi 'du shes brtan por bzo ba dang /de la brten te dbang sgyur pa gang gi dbang sgyur gyi nus pa sra brtan gtong ba dang spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes la kha lo bsgyur rgyu de red/ dper na/rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi 〈bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las mdo btus pa bzhugs so 〉zhes bya ba ru/ ‘‘par sig g.yon chen mar ma ni ’’②zhes gna' rabs par sig (ṣ+ṭhaspo)tu dar ba'i ma ni'i chos lugs dhil dgag pa brgyab yod pa dang / dgag pa rgyag don ni nang bstan chos lugs kyi dar rgyas la brten nas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan rang gi dbang sgyur gyi nus pa je brtan du gtong ba'i ched red/ de la ma ni chos lugs ni dus rabs gsum pa'i nang gna' rabs par sig tu dar ba'i 'dzam gling gi chos lugs chen po bcu'i khag gcig yin pa dang / skabs de dus kyi rgyal po shaka phur (byasmoskuji51)gyi ram 'degs la brten te e sha ya'i dbus lho'i sa cha kun tu dar rgyas byung yod pa dang /rgya yig gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ste sher rtogs rig pa'i tshig mdzod dang chos lugs kyi tshig mdzod/ gzhan yang chos 'byung 'gar ma nis rgya gar du sangs rgyas chos lugs la sbyangs brtson byas rjes rang lo nyer lnga'i thog pha yul par sig tu ma ni chos lugs dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags 9

byas pa dang / de'i phyis krung go'i lho nub mtshams su 'ongs te chos lugs sgrog spel gyi bya 'gul spel bar bshad/ g.yung drung bon gyi chos 'byung dag tu'ang ston pa gshen rab stag gzig yul nas bod du thengs gsum tsam (skabs 'dir kong po la ngos 'dzin byed dgos )phebs par brjod pa dang / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi 〈bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma'i mdo 〉ru/ g.yon mi bzod pas gtsug lag kun dang mi mthun pa gcig bya ba'i phyir gtsug lag kun nas drangs te zhes dang / gtsug lag gzhan gyis grub pa'i mtha' yod par gyur te/ ma grub pa la sogs pa'o/ / zhes brjod yod pa des shugs las ra sprod byed thub pa ni ma ni'i chos lugs de'i khrod du chos lugs kyi 'du shes mang po zhig 'dres yod pa'i snang tshul de yin pa dang / ma nis tsā ra tshe'u se khra'i duchos lugs dang / ci ta'o chos lugs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs/ shes bya'i chos lugs dukyi bsam blo'i rgyu cha bsdu len byas 'og ma ni chos lugs bzos pa'i gtan tshigs de gnyis stes dbang gis 'dra mtshungs su grub pa zhig ma yin par de gnyis gzhi gcig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig yod pa ste rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis ‘‘de ltar lung shin tu rnam par ma dag pa'i mtshan nyid ni rang bzhin gyis ma dag par shes par bya'o ’’zhes gsungs pa des ma ni'i chos lugs kyi khrod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kho na ma yin pa'i chos lugs sna‘tshogs shig 'dres yod pa dang / ma ni'i chos lugs rang nyid dngos gnas chos lugs sna tshogs kyis grub pa'i phung po zhig yin pas red/ der ma zad ma nis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos bdun/(1)〈tshikhu(stsacho྾wo3〉〈rdzogs pa rin chen gser gyi phreng ba/〉10

(2) 〈lha.oṃlha྾rdzoskyu〉〈phung po rang 'gyur thig le dgu bskor/〉(3) dz+nyo⑫྾rdzo3〉〈rnam dag tshul khrims 'dul ba'i 'bum/〉(4) dz+nyoyonyo'irkephrermyu〉〈sngon dngos rjes dran/〉(5) 〈rnyesa.oṃtshesnrozlostuphreskyu〉〈man ngag 'khor lo 'od gsal/〉(6) 〈rki7tram̐rdzo3〉〈khro rgyud mdo chen byams pa/〉(7) 〈7khārdzo3〉 〈dge rgyas tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i 'bum 〉rjol sogs pa g.yung drung bon gyi lta ba dang / sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'phrin las/bskyed rdzogs kyi 'bras bu mtshon pa'i gzhung du gyur yod pas red/des na gong gsal gyi rgyu mtshan de dag dang bon gyi chos 'byung lo rgyus mang po ru khri srong lde btsan gyis bon bsnubs zhes pa'ang don dam par ma ni'i chos lugs bsnubs pa dang / g.yung drung bon gyi chos lugs der brdol bon/ 'khyar bon/ bsgyur bon bcas 'phel rgyas kyi skas rim gsum du dbye yod pa las ma ni chos lugs ni yul phyogs gzhan nas tshur 'khyar 'ong ba'i 'khyar bon te rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis ma ni'i chos lugs nyid yul phyogs gzhan nas 'khyar yong ba'i chos lugs su mi brjod par lung yang dag min pa'i chos lugs su ngos 'dzin byas te rtsod spongs byed don yang sangs rgyas chos lugs nyid kyang yul phyogs gzhan nas dar 'ong ba'i chos lugs shig yin pa dang gcig gnyis su skabs de dus rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis rtse gcig tu dad pa byed bzhin pa'i chos lugs ni sangs rgyas chos lugs yin pas red/ de min sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung kha shas su bon chos bsnubs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni rang byung khams kyi skye dngos dang srog chags kyi 'phel rgyas la gnod tshabs che bar brjod kyang gal srid de lta yin na ni de ni rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi bsam blo spyad de mno sems byas 11

pa'i gtan tshigs shig tu kho bos snyam/ ka bod kyi lo rgyus thog chos lugs kyi lo rgyus ni shin tu rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnad don zhig yin pa dang / chos lugs de nyid rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su skyel mkhan ni chos lugs dar ba'i dus kyi chab srid skyong ba'i rgyal blon de dag red/ dper na rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs dang ma ni'i chos lugs gnyis la gdam nga byas pa'i mthar sangs rgyas chos lugs bod yul gyi zur so so ru dar spel byas yod pa dang / ma ni chos lugs dar ba'i lo rgyus de shul med rjes med kyi gnas su gyar yod pa red/ (spyir btang gna' rabs su chos lugs kyi lta tshul zhig dar thub min ni skabs de dus kyi sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyal po de'i ram 'degs la rag las yod pa ni chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas chos lugs de ke re si ru spel na'ang ke re si'i rgyal pos snang chung dang dang len ma byas pas sangs rgyas chos lugs de ke re si ru dar thub med pa lta bu'o/)lhag par du chos lugs shig phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas gtong ba dang chos lugs gzhan zhig phyogs yongs nas nyams dmas su bzo ba'i ched mi zhig gi tshe srog gi rin thang yang rtsis med rdog rol du btang yod pa ni ma zhang khrom pa skyes gson por dur sbed byas pas mtshon zhing de ni ban bon gnyis kyi rgyal pham gyi thag gcod cig yin pa dang / de 'dra'i lugasasrol ni chos lugs dar ba'i yul gru so so'i lo rgyus khrod du mang tsam yod pa red/ gong gsal khyod kyi lta tshul de ltar nga tshos chos lugs dar ba'i lo rgyus shig gleng gi yod kyang chos lugs nyid ji ltar dar ba dang ji 'dra'i ngang dar ba'i lo rgyus dngos gnas shig da lta'i char skyu ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar gsal por gleng thub kyi med/ dper na/ma ni chos lugs dang 'khyar bon gnyis kyi dbar dbye dka' ba'i 12

mtshungs chos shig yod pa dang yang na 'khyar bon nyid yang snying yul phyogs gang nas 'khyar 'ong ba'i chos lugs shig yin pa dang / yul de nas 'khyar 'ong ba'i dus ma phyi'i chos lugs de'i ming la ji skad zer ba sogs da mus gsal por bzo thub med pa dang / bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs la mtshon na'ang ji ltar dar ba dang phyogs gang dang /dang thog dar ba'i dus ji 'dra yin pa'i lo rgyus gsal po zhig dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i dbang gis da lta'i char gleng thub kyi med la/ 〈bka' bstan 〉gyi 'gyur gyi phyi mo yod tshad rgya gar rang min pa ni 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉las ra sprod byed thub pa ni 〈sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo 〉sogs mdo mang po zhig mes rgyal nang sa'i yi ge las bod yig tu phab bsgyur byas pa dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi dus bod yul du dar ba'i cig car ba dang rim can pa'i lta ba ni mes rgyal nang khul du spyi lo'i dus rabs lnga pa yas mas su dar spel byung ste lta ba gnyis dbar phan tshun rtsod pa byas myong yod pa dang / 〈sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo'i 〉rjes su 'brangs nas cig car ba'i lugs 'dzin pa dang / 〈dam chos pad ma dkar po'i 〉rjes su 'brangs nas rim can pa'i lta ba 'dzin bzhin yod pa red/ de la bsam gtan mkhan po cig car ba'i lugs 'dzin pa po hos ning ①gi bsam gtan gyi lta ba nyid bod du dar myong yod pa'ang tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi gna' rabs yig cha'i bsdus ming 2’1’ 116 (pā li'i dpe mdzod khang du yod pa )〈chos lugs skor gyi bsgyur yig dum bu 'gar 〉zhes bya ba ru mkhan po ni ho shen shi rjodang /mkhan po 'gwa lun shen shi/rjo mkhan po blu cu shen shi/⑪ mkhan po kin hun shen shi/⑪ mkhan po de'u lam shen shiyi sogs kyi cig car ba'i bsam 13

gtan sgom gyi lta tshul bod yig tu bsgyur yod pa dang / rtsom yig de dag ni dus rabs brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar bod yig tu phab bsgyur byas pa des ra sprod byed thub na 'di yang nga tshos nges par rtogs dgos pa'i chos lugs dar 'phel gyi lo rgyus shig ma red dam/ yid skyo ba ni chos lugs kyi lam kha zhig nas chos lugs kyi lam kha gzhan zhig tu phyin yang chos lugs rang nyid dar 'phel gyi lo rgyus kyang rnyog drar gyur yod pa dang / rig stobs la brten nas rdzas kyi nus pa'i phyogs su zhib 'jug byed rgyu ni de bas kyang gsal por bzo mi thub pa'i lo rgyus shig dang lo rgyus kyi las dbang zhig red/kha khyod rang mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas kyi 'phel 'gyur dpe dbyibs (stsa7k+ṣuspra)der mos 'dun yod med gang ltar kyang nga tsho nges par ngo gnongs dgos pa zhig ni nged cag gis ga ler nga tsho'i khor yug tu byung zhing mi rnams kyis do snang byed nges pa'i drang bden rdzun ma (phrukhrir+sām+mu)de dang len byas yod pa dang / drang bden rdzun ma de dag gis g.yol du med pa'i sgo nas nga tshos yang dag gi drang bden zhig 'tshol bar bkag 'gog dang 'jigs skul byed kyi yod pa ma zad thad kar nga tsho'i 'tsho sdod kyi bsam blo dang gnang don gyi gsal bshad thad mgo rmongs shing 'thoms par byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na 'dir gleng bzhin pa'i chos lugs rang gi lo rgyus lta bu ste don gnad 'di'i rigs la spyi'i rnam pa dang bye brag gi rnam par dbye 'byed byas te rtog 'jug byas pa yin na nga tshos gnad don kha shas kyi dris lan gsar du rnyed thub pa dang / dris lan de dag ni nga tsho dang mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho sdod kyi rmang gzhi'i shes byar 'gyur nges red/14

ka tshang mas shes gsal ltar dus rabs shig gi lang tsho gsar du rgyas bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir mi'i rigs dang lhag par du bod mi'i kun spyod kyi srog shing der 'byor 'khos zhan pa dang god chag glen shes bcas kyis 'tsham po min pa'i shugs rkyen zhig sprod bzhin yod pa dang / gnad don de nyid 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i myur tshad/ mgyogs drags pa dang / nged cag gis spel dgos pa'i las 'gul phyi drags pa'i rkyen gyis nga tshos da lam gnad don de'i rigs snyoms sgrig byed thub kyi med la/ gal srid deng phyin yang dpal 'byor spel ba'i phyogs su mno sems mi bya ba dang / gnad don de'i rigs 'a gdong bsu byed mi thub pa yin na nga tsho nam yang ‘‘gnad don gyi rjes su snyeg pa'i ’’rnam pa'i khrod du lus nges dang / nged cag gi kun spyod de yang rang gces 'dzin che ba zhig tu 'gyur nges red/ de bas bod kyi srol rgyun gyi rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul der deng rabs shes rig gis shugs snon dang /gnad don gang zhig dang yang na gnad don 'khor phyogs (/cazlu྾tshi2lhami)kyi mdun du sngon brgal mdun mchongs byed thub pa byung tshe grezhi nas spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi rjes su snyeg thub mi yong ngam snyam/kha mdor na/ nga tshos deng phyin sgrub dgos pa'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul gyi khyab khongs hril por zhib bsher dang rgya cher gtong ba'i phyogs su 'bad 'bungs byed dgos pa ma zad tshan rtsal gyis mtshon pa'i deng rabs rig gnas bsdu len byed pa'i phyogs su'ang hur brtson gang legs byed dgos la/ gzhar yang bsam zhib byed dgos pa'i gnad don ni/ (1) nga tsho'i mes po rnams dpal 'byor gyi phyogs su dbul por 15

gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin dang /(2) dus rabs bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i nang bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba'i dus phyi nang gi lo rgyus rgyab ljongs dang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i rjes bod du grub mtha' shin tu mang po zhig dar thub pa'i rgyu rkyen gang yin/(3) 'tsho ba ni bsam blo zhig dang bsam blo ni dngos yod kyi 'gul bskyod cig yin pa dang / nga tsho dang bar thag shin tu nye ba ni dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba yin mod/ 'on te nga tshos kha gtad gcog mi 'dod pa ni dngos yod kyi spyi tshogs dang / —nga tshos nam yang re ltos dang rjes snyeg byed pa ni dngos yod las 'gongs pa'i stong bsam gyi rmi lam zhig yin pa'i gnad don der rig stobs dpal 'byor tsogyi lta tshul spyad de bsam gzhigs gting zab byed dgos la/ de dag ni nga tsho'i 'tsho sdod dang gnad don yod tshad thag gcod byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen rang red/ka klog pa po rnam pa lags/ don tshan gnyis pa ste 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas gsar pa'i dngos yod rang bzhin skor gleng skabs nga tshos lhan du gong gsal gyi dri gzhi rnams la gros mol yod pa zhu'o/ /gnyis pa/ 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas gsar pa'i dngos yod rang bzhin/ka da ni sde tshan gnyis pa'i brjod don gyi 'go rtsom pa la/ thog mar bdag gis gleng 'dod pa ni rig gnas dang / bsam blo/ lta tshul/16

chos lugs kyi 'du shes gang zhig yin yang 'dzam gling zhi bde dang mi'i rigs kyi bde skyid/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i phyogs su skul 'ded kyi sgul shugs ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur rgyu las 'gog rkyen du 'gyur mi rung ba dang / rig gnas bsam blo'i 'du shes dang chos lugs kyi 'du shes gang yin yang dngos yod dang 'byung 'gyur gyi phugs bsam thad 'gal ba med pa'i phyogs su 'phel rgyas 'gro bar hur brtson byed dgos/ 'das pa'i dus rabs mang po'i khrod du nged cag gi mes po rnams kyis chos lugs dang bsam blo'i ma lag mi 'dra bar brten nas byung ba'i phan tshun dbar 'gal zlar 'dzin pa dang / phan tshun dbar shes rtogs byed khag pa/ phan tshun dbar 'byung nges pa'i 'gal ba bcas bsal phyir 'bad brtson byas yod pa de bzhin nga tshos 'phrin gsar ma lag dang / 'phrin skyel ma lag brgyud de 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag dang / chos lugs mi 'dra ba sogs kyi dbar bsam blo brje res dang rig gnas spel res bya rgyu de ni phan tshun bar shes rtogs kyi nunu/ nga che ru gtong byed cig yin pa ma zad 'dzam gling zhi bde'i lam du skyod byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen zhig kyang red/ gang yin zhe na/ sa gzhi ril mo'i thog byung zin pa'i 'gal 'du'i dmag 'thab mang po zhig mthar thug chos lugs dad mos kyi gnad don la rag las yod pa dang dmag 'thab de rnams kyis mi'i tshe srog dang / spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags/rang byung khams bcas la god chag chen po zhig bskrun yod pas red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas tshan rig gi bsam blo'i rmang gzhi ni lag rtsal yin pa dang / mi 'dra ba'i dus rabs dang mi 'dra ba'i spyi tshogs/ mi 'dra ba'i mi'i dbar gyi lag rtsal brje res ni tshul ldan shes rig gi 'tsho bar 17

spyod pa'i mi'i rigs thun mong gi yo byad dang / de ni mi'i rigs 'tsho sdod kyi byed thabs 'gangs chen zhig yin pas/ tshan rig gi bsam blo de nyid sgron sgrog byed rgyu'ang mi'i rigs bde thang gi ngang nas 'phel rgyas 'gro byed nyag gcig tu kho bos snyam/kha/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul ni nges par du mi'i rigs kyi tshul ldan shes rig gi khang brtsegs bskrun mkhan dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro bar skul lcag gi nus pa thon myong pa'i bsam blo'i stobs shugs kyi rmang gzhi'i thog gcig gyur dang 'phel rgyas gtong dgos/ 'das pa'i dus rabs khrod du mi'i rigs kyis so so'i bsam blo'i nus stobs de 'thus tshang min pa ra sprod byas yod pa ni 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo dang gtor brlag rang bzhin can gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi he bag skor la bsam zhib ma byas pas/ da lta'i char snod bcud btang snyoms dang skye khams snyom4 sgrig gi phyogs su 'jigs nyen gyi snang tshul zhig slebs yod pa 'dis ra sprod byed thub/ der brten deng phyin 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo ni nga tshos nam yang dar spel gtong dgos pa dang / gtor brlag rang bzhin can gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs ni gang thub ci thub kyis 'gog dgos/ 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan nga/'i bsam blo zer ba ni dngos yod dang 'byung 'gyur gyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gnyis la dmigs te 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu de red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni nga tshos dngos yod kho na'i ched du dngos yod 'dzugs skrun 'ba' zhig la hur brtson byas pa las 'byung 'gyur la bsam blo rtsa ba nas ma btang ba yin na gzhar yang 'thus shor du phyin pa ni 'byung 'gyur dang 'byung 'gyur gyi 18

'dzugs skrun yin pas red/ka 'o na khyod kyis bltas na nga tshos ji ltar 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo zhig dar spel dang / bsam blo de nyid ji ltar chos lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs khrod nas bsngog 'don byed dgos/kha/ dus rabs kyi 'phel 'gyur la do snang gang yang mi byed pa'i rig gzhung smra ba 'ga' res brjod pa ltar mi'i rigs kyi bsam gzhigs kyi tshad gzhi'i thog nas brtag tshe mi'i rigs chos lugs kyi slad du skyes shing chos lugs kyi slad du 'jig gi yod pa'i snang tshul zhig mngon bzhin yod na'ang 'tsho sdod la mtshon na 〈rgyal spyi'i glu 〉rtsom pa po pa'o rdi a'e 〈a42 lkogluṣ+ṭha〉yis dang po nyid nas 'jig rten mgon skyabs med la/ lha dang gnam bskos gong mar brten dgos don yang med/ mi'i rigs kyi bde skyid gsar skrun byed dgos tshe de ni khyon yongs nas mi rang la brten dgos pa zhis yin zhes brjod pa'i spobs pa de dang len byed dgos la de ni dngos mo nga/ 'tsho sdod kyi sdom tshig 'gangs chen zhig yin pas/ nga tshos 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bas ma blo yang chos lugs kyi 'du shes khrod nas 'tshol rgyu min par mi'i rigs deng rabs shes rig gi gzhi rkang du gyur pa'i rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs khrod nas 'tshol dgos/ rig stobs dpal 'byor rang la mtshon na dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i lo rabs sum cu pa'i yas mas su 'thus tshang gi gzhung lugs su 'gyur dgos pa'i rig sgo zhig yin na'ang nga tshos nges par du gong bkur dang dang len byed dgos pa ni rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi khyad rtags dpal 'byor 'abhel h+phus sdi 19

rgyun bsring rang bzhin can de red/ de'i go don ni rig stobs dpal 'byor lgus rmo dngaX rang ༷byung khams gnyis mthun sbyor dang mu mthud 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i dmigs yul 'og bzo las lag rtsal kho nas mi'i bsam blor mdzub ston byed tshul der 'gyur ldog btang ste lag rtsal rab kyis mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo la mdzub ston byed rgyu dang / de ni tshan rig dang / 'os 'tsham/ phyogs bsdus/ phan 'bras mtho po bcas kyi sgo nas da yod kyi thon khungs bed spyod dang lhan du sngar gsar spel ma byas pa'i rang byung thon khungs kyis rgyun stongs par 'gyur bzhin pa'i rang byung thon khungs kyi tshab byed rgyu de red/ lhag par du/(1)gshin sa nyid nyin rer bye ma can du 'gyur bzhin pa'i gnad don tshabs che ba dang / 'jig rten hril po'i bye ma can gyi rgya khyon che ru 'gro bzhin pa/ (2)nags tshal la gtor bshig thebs te sa chu srung 'dzin byed dka' ba/(3)ri skyes srog chags mang po'i rgyun stongs par gyur pas snod bcud btang snyoms byed khag por 'gyur bzhin pa/(4)'dzam gling gi mi grangs skye 'phel mgyogs drags pas 'ol tshod byas pa ltar na spyi lo 2010lor 'dzam gling gi mi grangs da yod kyi grangs las ldab gcig 'phar snod byed nges yin pa/(5) 'thung chu'i thon khungs je nyung du phyin pa dang mi rnams kyi 'thung chu'i gnad don rnyog drar 'gyur bzhin pa/(6)nya las kyi thon khungs nyung ngur phyin pa dang 'dzam gling gi 25ltazin pa'i nya gso ra bar gtor skyon thebs pa/(7)chu rgyun btsog bsgyur byas pa'i gnad don tshabs che ba des 20

chu'i thon khungs dang mi'i gzugs gzhi'i bde thang la gnod 'tshe bzo bzhin pa/ (8)zhing sman 'bor chen bed spyod btang ba des zhing las skye dngos (lko༅lha྾)la shugs rkyen sprod bzhin yod pa ma zad mi rnams la'ang gnod 'tshe byed bzhin pa/(9)sa gzhi ril mo'i drod tshad mtho ru phyin pa des gling chen a h+phe ri kha'i rgyal khab dang thig dmar la shugs rkyen chen po zhig sprod bzhin pa/(10)char pa skyur mo'i snang tshul je mang du 'gro bzhin pa des zhing las skye dngos dang mi'i gzugs gzhi'i bde thang la gnod 'tshe byed bzhin yod pa de dag gis ra sprod byed thub pa ni mi'i rigs kyis 'tshol dgos pa'i 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bsam blo ni dred mong gis 'phyi ba 'dzin pa 'i dpe ltar min par rang byung khams kyi 'dzad spyod dang rang byung khams kyi slar gso gnyis zung du 'brel dgos pa de red/ de ni 'dzugs skrun gzhung lugs kyi rlabs che ba'i bsam blo zhig yin pa ma zad mi'i rigs kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi 'tsho sdod la sman pa'i rlabs che ba'i bya gzhag cig kyang red/kha/ 'dzam gling ni rig gnas kyi bsam blo gsar pas sgyur bcos byas pa zhig yin pa dang / gal srid rig gnas kyi bsam blo gsar pa med pa yin na 'dzam gling gi dpyid dbyar ston dgun gyi 'gyur ba de'ang ba rjod mi thub pa zhig red/ da lta'i char nga tshos shes rtogs byung ba ltar mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho sdod la 'jigs skul sprod mkhan ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rab rang nyid min par mi'i rigs kyi shes rab nyid tshad 21

med par 'gul bskyod byas pa'i rkyen gyis bskrun pa'i rang byung khams 'phel rgyas kyi 'khral 'khrul rang bzhin gyi 'bras bu de yin pa dang /gong du gleng ba'i mi'i rigs 'tsho sdod la 'jigs skul sprod bzhin pa'i gnad don bcu po de ni de'i 'bras bu ngan pa zhig red/ dus rabs gnyis 'brel mtshams kyi skabs bab 'dir nga tshos sa gzhi ril mo'i steng gi rang byung gi khams gang yod kyi nus pa tshad yod du nges rtogs byung ba de ni mi'i rigs kyi lo ngo stong gi rlabs che ba'i rgyal kha zhig yin pa ma zad tshan rig kyang tshad mthon po'i tshul ldan shes rig gi lam kha gsar pa zhig tu bgrod bzhin pa'i dan rtags shig kyang red/ deng phyin sa gzhi ril mo'i 'dzugs skrun dang rang rigs kyi khyim gzhis bskyar gso byed par 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bsam blo de 'dzam gling tshul ldan shes rig gi bsam blo'i snying bcud kun las bsdu len byed rgyu ma zad 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo de ni mi rigs shig dang rgyal khab cig min par sa steng gi mi yod tshad kyi bsam blo dang spyod lam yod tshad kyi gtso gnad du 'dzin dgos zhes pa de ni khyod kyis gleng 'dod pa'i rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo de e red/ 'on te mi'i rigs bsam gzhigs kyi 'du 'god khrod du grags 'gul gang yang med pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par 'bad brtson byed myong ba'i mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnas pa'i mi rigs 'dir mtshon na ga 'dra yin nam/ kho tsho slar yang rjes lus thebs mi yong ngam/ yang gcig khyod kyis chos lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs khrod nas 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo de 'tshol mi 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang gong gsal gyi gnad don 22

de dag la rag las yod pa e red/ka de ltar rang red/ nga tshos 'das pa'i gnad don 'ga' shas la bsam zhib ma byas mthu med du gyur yod pa dang / gnad don kha shas la sdom tshig ma bzhag thabs med du gyur yod pa red/ der rten spyi don nam spyi khog gi tshad gzhi'i thog nas bod kyi snga phyi gnyis su dbye ba'i nyis stong lor brtag tshe stong phrag lo snga ma de ni rgyal rabs 'dzugs pa'i dus rabs shig yin pa dang / stong phrag lo phyi ma de ni cho sa lugs lta tshul nang 'dren bskyar spel dang chos lugs kyi grub mtha' gsar gtod byas te dar spel gyi dus rabs shig red/ lo nyis stong snga phyi gang yin yang dus 'go'i lo ngo brgya yas mas ni 'khral 'khrul dang yang na studus rabs shig yin pa dang / lo nyis stong snga phyi gang yin yang dus mjug gi lo lnga bcu yas mas ni kha phyogs skor mtshams kyi dus rabs shig red/gang yin zhe na stong phrag lo snga ma'i rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i gong gi lo ngo nyis brgya yas mas ni nga tshor gang yin 'di yin gyi gsal cha med pa dang bzhag tu med pa'i smodus rabs shig yin pa dang / stong phrag lo phyi ma'i khrod/ chos lugs dar 'phel gyi rgyal pham thag gcod pa'i slad lha lung dpal rdor gyis thu bhod rgyal rabs mjug sgril bar byas pa nas 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha'i srol ma phye gong gi lo ngo brgya yas mas ni 'khral 'khrul gyi dus rabs de'i khrod du chab srid skyong ba'i rgyal po dang bka' yig sgrog pa'i blon po med na'ang bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs bskyar dar la rmang gzhi brtan po bting yod pa red/ stong phrag lo phyi ma'i dus mjug tu'ang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang ba dang rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul yang mar le 23

ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung dgongs pa/ teng zha'o phing gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi skul 'ded 'og dngos yod spyi tshogs dang 'tsham pa dang /deng rabs shes rig gi lam kha zhig tu bgrod kyin yod na nga tshos nges par gces 'dzin byed dgos pa ni dngos yod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong byed kyi bsam blo de dag yin pa ma zad/ bsam blo de dag gi ma dzub ston 'og dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang mthun pa'i 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig 'dzugs thub pa dgos la/ gzhung lugs de'i rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi ni ngas gong du zhus zin pa ltar rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi bsam blo'i lta tshul de yin dgos/kha/ de ni ji 'dra'i yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gtam gleng zhig red ang / snga phyi gnyis su dbye ba'i nyis stong lo'i bod kyi tshul ldan shes rig gi lta tshul gleng slong des nga la'ang lta tshul de'i dbye zhib thad blo skyed chen po zhig thob song / khyod kyi bsam gzhigs kyi thabs lam de brgyud nas brtag tshe nyis stong lo snga phyi gnyis kyi lo 'go'i dus rabs dang lo mjug gi dus rabs ni 'khral 'khrul gyi dus rabs shig yin pa dang / 'khral 'khrul gyi dus rabs de ni lam kha gsar pa zhig tu bgrod byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du gyur yod pa red/ dper na dus rabs dang po dang spyi lo'i gong gi dus rabs su dar bar brjod pa'i brdol bon ni spyi lo'i dus rabs gsum pa'am gri gum btsan po'i ring 'khyar bon gyi rig pa dar byed kyi sngon 'gro'i skya rengs su gyur yod pa dang / stong phrag lo snga ma'i dus mjug tu lha lung dpal rdor gyis glang dar bkrongs pa des lo ngo stong gi rgyal po'i khyim rgyud kyi lo rgyus mjug sgril nas/ dus rabs de 24

nyid chab srid pa dang rig gnas pa/ chos lugs pa med pa'i 'go 'thoms pa'i dus rabs shig tu bsgyur yod na'ang de nas lo ngo nyis brgya yas mas 'gor ba'i rjes su bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar dar thad mgo 'thoms pa'i dus rabs des shugs rkyen chen po zhig bzhag yod pa red/ stong phrag lo phyi ma'i dus mjug (radir mtshon na'ang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang ste lo ngo stong gi chos lugs kyi grub mtha' dang chos lugs bskyar du dar ba'i lo rgyus kyi mjug sgril nas bod mi'i rig gnas bsam blo de nyid dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho sdod thog phyogs su bcug yod pa dang / de 'dra'i 'khor yun rang bzhin (khri4/ 77ṣā7 lha)gyi 'gul skyod chos nyid la gzhigs tshe slebs nges pa'i dus rabanu/ nyer gcig pa'i khro/ da du mi rigs 'dis phyogs yongs nas shes rig gsar pa'i ma lag cig 'dzugs nges par gdon mi za/ma gzhir nga tshos brgyud zin pa'i stong phrag lo snga ma ni rgyal brgyud lo rgyus kyi dus rabs shig yin pa dang / stong phrag lo phyi ma ni chos lugs lo rgyus kyi dus rabs shig yin la/ dus rabs de gnyis mjug sgril ba dang da ni stong phrag lo gsum pa'i dus 'go yin zhing / rgya che sa nas stong phrag lo re rer rgyal brgyud dus rabs dang chos lugs spel ba'i dus rabs kyi grub cha'i snying po'am grub cha'i srog shing zhig yod pa de bzhin stong phrag lo gsum pa'i nang nga tshos 'tsho sdod kyi gnad don thag gcod pa'i ched stong phrag lo gsum pa'i grub cha'i snying po'am grub cha'i srog shing ni 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas bsam blo yin par ngos 'dzin byas tshe gzhi nas gnad don yod tshad thag gcod thub nges red/ yin yang zhib tu gleng tshe 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan 25

pa'i 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas bsam blo ji lta bu yin nam/ka spyir btang 'tsho sdod ces pa'i khyab khongs su 'chi gson dang rin thang / ngal rtsol dang rang dbang / chos lugs kyi gnad don 'dus yod pa dang / mi'i gzhi grub kyi rnam pa shes rtogs byed rgyu ni mi rang nyid dang 'jig rten gyi khor yug mi gzhan dag dang yang na mi rang dang 'brel ba'i gzhi grub de nyid shes rtogs 'ong ba'i ched du red/mi rang gi gzhi grub kyi ngos nas bshad na 'tsho sdod ni bya dngos dang mi gzhan gyi gzhi grub khrod du gnas pa'i 'brel ba der zer zhing dper na/rdzas 'gyur rig pa'i don snying thog mi ni 'jig rten gyi khrod du gzhi grub yod pa dang / ngal rtsol la brten te so so'i tshe srog gi rgyun bsring bzhin yod pa ma zad/ srog ldan gzhan dag dang lhan du rang byung gi 'jig rten de nyid longs su spyod bzhin yod pa red/ 'on te longs spyod ces pa'i tha snyad de'i dngos bstan bsam blo ni 'dzad spyod yin pa dang / da lta'i char rang byung 'jig rten gyi khams dang mi/ srog ldan gzhan dag dbar gyi 'brel ba'ang 'dzad spyod ces pa'i bsam blo des nyen kha'i gnas su skyel bzhin yod pa ni mi'i rigs kyis mi rang nyid 'jig rten gyi byed pa po yin par ngos zin pa nas bzung tshul ldan shes rig gi lam kha zhig tu bgrod par hur brtson byas yod kyang bya dngos 'phel 'gyur gyi bslu brid rang bzhin des mi'i rigs la mgo bskor tshad las 'das pa zhig btang yod pa ni tshul ldan shes rig des mi'i rigs la mgo bskor tshad las 'das pa zhig btang yod pa ni tshul lda na shes rig gi phyogs gcig ni gsar gtod kyi 'phel rgyas dang phyogs gcig ni rmeg med rdul du brlag pa'i rang bzhin yin pa des ra sprod byed thub/ deng phyin mi'i 26

rigs gtor brlag dang bral ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi lam kha zhig tu bgrod thub pa byed dgos tshe 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i bsam blo'i ma lag der rag las yod pas gnad don der bgro gleng byed rgyu ni mi dang 'jig rten gyi khor yug srog ldan gzhan dag gi 'tsho sdod kyi 'jigs nyen thag gcod pa'i ched du red/ yin yang nga tshos shes zin pa ltar 'das pa'i dus kyi 'jigs nyen ni nad mug 'khrug rtsod kyis bzos pa dang /deng rabs kyi 'jigs nyen ni mi'i rang rig gis bskrun pa dang de'i 'byung khungs gtso bo ni mi rnams kyi bde skyid kyi re 'dun las byung ba red/ der brten da lta'i 'jigs nyen 'dir rgo'/ lan slog thub dgos tshe nga tshos thog mar sgyur bcos byed dgos pa ni rnying rul gyi bsam blo de red/kha/ lo rgyus ni dpyid dbyar ston dgun gyis bsdus pa'i lo tshigs shig dang 'dra bar dpyid ka nas dbyar kha dang / ston dus nas dgun khar slebs bzhin yod la/ mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim de'ang gong du 'phel te gnyid las sad pa dang / 'jigs nyen dang rtsa thor gyi yul du gyur pa nas yang bskyar gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i bo/ rim zhig brgyud bzhin yod pa red/ gnas tshul de ni mi'i rigs kyi lta tshul rnying drags te dus rabs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang skye khams kyi 'jigs nyen/spyi tshogs kyi 'jigs nyen dang mi'i 'jigs nyen bcas la kha gtad gcog thub kyi med pa las byung ba zhig red la/ deng phyin gnad don de dag la rgol lan slog thub pa byed dgos tshe nga tshos thog mar nges dgos pa ni gnad don de dag la rgol lan slog pa'i thabs shes 'tshol rgyu de yin pa ma zad thabs shes de ni rnying rul gyi bsam blor bcings 'grol 27

gtong byed kyi yo byad du 'gyur ba byed dgos/ka rdzas lugs rig pa'i mkhan po dang 'phel 'gyur smra ba'i dbang po/ 'jig rten nam yang 'gul skyod kyi khrod du gnas par 'dod mkhan su zhig gis kyang mi'i bsam blo ni rtag brtan dang 'gyur ba gang yang med par khas len mi thub la de ltar brjod myong yang med/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i 'gul skyod ni mi'i rigs kyis 'tsho sdod dang / 'phel rgyas la hur brtson byed pa'i rtsa ba'i byed thabs shig yin pa dang / mi'i rigs kyis spyi tshogs la sgyur bcos byed pa'i 'gul skyod khrod du'ang mi'i rigs rang gi mdun du phyogs pa'i gnad don te dpal 'byor gyi 'jigs nyen dang chab srid kyi 9rajigs nyen/ rig gnas kyi 'jigs nyen/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'jigs nyen sogs kyang bsam blo'i 'gul skyod kyi 'bras bu zhig red/ de bas nga tshos rnying zhen gyi bsam blo bcings 'grol gtong rgyu de'ang phyogs gcig nas mi'i rigs rang nyid 'tsho sdod dang 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi'i rigs rtem/ pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i snod bcud bkod pa'i khyab khongs yongs la srung skyob dang gces 'dzin byed thub dgos/ gal srid mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khams brlags tshar tshe mi'i rigs 'tsho sdod kyi thon khungs nyid brlags pa yin pas 'tsho sdod kyi thon khungs med tshe mi rang nyid brlags pa dang dbye ba ci yod/der brten 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas gsar pa yin na'ang 'dra/ 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin gyi bsam blo yin na'ang 'dra/ rnying rul gyi bsam blor bsgyur bcos byed rgyu yin na'ang 'dra/ rtsa ba'i khas len ni da lta'i char sa steng hril por 'jigs nyen gyi snang tshul mang po zhig lhags yod pa de 28

dag la kha gtad gcog thub pa byas te khyab khongs gsar pa dang tshad gzhi gsar pa/ bsam blo gsar pa dang lta tshul gsar pa zhig gis 'tsho sdod kyi gnad don thag gcod rgyu dang / de ni 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas gsar pa de'i rtsa ba'i bsam blo dang rtsa ba'i ma lag rtsa ba'i byed thabs yin dgos/kha da lta'i char nga tsho'i mdun du phyogs pa'i 'jigs nyen skor gyi gnad don mang po zhig gi gdong bsu ba ni mi rang nyid yin si dang /des ra sprod byed thub pa ni mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khams 'dul sbyong byed pa'i dus khe spogs 'dod gdung tsha drags pa ma zad mi'i rigs kyis gsar sbol dang tshan rig lag rtsal bed spyod pa'i dus kyang yang dag dang lugs mthun gyi rin thang gi dmigs yul dang ring du kha gyes pa'i rkyen gyis khor yug rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog gis skyed pa'i dge mtshan med pa'i shugs rkyen 'di byung ba red/ mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog gdod ma'i dus su'ang 'jigs nyen sna tshogs shig byung yod mod deng rabs kyi 'jigs nyen sna tshogs dang bsdur na ha cang gis rgya chung chung zhig red/nga tshos gdod ma'i dus dang deng rabs 'jigs nyen gyi te bag skor la dpyod skabs sdom tshig mi 'dra ba 'di 'dra zhig thob ste/ gdod ma'i dus kyi 'jigs nyen ni nad mug 'khrug rtsod kyis bskrun pa'i phyi don rang byung gi 'jigs nyen zhig yin pa dang / deng rabs kyi 'jigs nyen ni mi'i rigs rang gi 'du shes nyid tshad med par 'gul skyod byas pas bskrun pa dang / de'i 'byung khungs gtso bo ni mi'i rigs kyi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i re smon der rag las yod pa red/ da lta'i char mi'i rigs kyis mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'tsho ba de nyid mngon 'gyur byed dang byed mus 29

yin na'ang nga tshos gtan du snang chung byed mi rung ba'i gnad don yang mi nyung ba zhig bsus yod pa ni skye khams kyi 'jigs nyen dang / khor yug gi 'jigs nyen/ thon khungs kyi 'jigs nyen/ nus pa'i thon khungs kyi 'jigs nyen/ mi grangs skye 'phel gyi 'jigs nyen/ 'bru rigs kyi 'jigs nyen/ skye dngos rigs kyi 'jigs nyen/ lag rtsal gyi 'jigs nyen/ spyi tshogs kyi 'jigs nyen/ spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi'i thad kyi 'jigs nyen/ spyi tshogs khe phan bgo bsha'i skor gyi 'jigs nyen/ kun spyod kyi 'jigs nyen/ dad mos kyi 'jigs nyen sogs red/ der brten deng phyin 'jigs nyen de'i rigs mu mthud 'phel rgyas 'gro ba 'gog thub pa dang / 'jigs nyen gyi gnad don skor la rgol lan slog thub pa byed rgyu ni mi'i rigs 'tsho sdod kyi rtsa ba'i khas len dang dam bca' yin dgos nges red/ka nga'i sems par 'jigs nyen gyi gnad don de'i rigs thag gcod dgos tshe/ mi'i rigs kyis thog mar sgrub dgos pa ni mi rang nyid kyi 'tsho sdod dang 'phel rgyas lta tshul gyi byed sgo mtha' dag la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin dgos pa ma zad/'phel rgyas kyi lta tshul dang 'gul skyod kyi dmag jus thad khyon yongs nas lam kha gsar pa zhig tu bskyod thub pa byed dgos/ de la rang byung khams 'dul sbyong dang meg med du bzo ba de ni mi'i rigs kyi legs pa'i dge mtshan gang yang min pa dang / rgyun bsrings thub pa'i 'phel rgyas (spye༈rgo07khri cho)kyi bsam blo'i rtsa don dang lag len la brten nas mi'i rigs kyi rang byung gi khyim gzhis ( khri tshi7d+kutha)gsar 'dzugs byed thub dgos/ de ni nga tsho'i 'tsho sdod la sman pa'i byed 30

thabs dang / rig gnas bsam blo gsar pa'i rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi yin pa ma zad mi'i rigs kyis 'dod pa'i mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'tsho ba'i re smon gyi mtshan nyid gsar pa dang blang bya gsar pa/ rtsa don gsar pa zhig kyang red/kha/ khyod kyis 〈sna tshogs gangs ri'i khrod kyi bsam gzhigs 〉kyi khrod du 'jigs nyen skor gyi gnad don mang po zhig gleng slong byas yod kyang / nga tshos do snang chen po byed ma thub pa de ha cang skyo ba'i gnas su mthong / don ngo mar nga tshos skye khams la do snang byed ma thub pa de tsam gyis mi'i rigs spyi chogs kyi 'tsho sdod la 'jigs snang skul byed kyi gnad don yang mang po zhig bsus yong gi yod pa dang / rtsa ba'i thog skye khams med tshe mi'i rigs yod mi srid pa'i rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba der nga tshos shes rtogs byed thub med/ der brten gtam gleng 'di brgyud de srol rgyun gyi 'tsho sdod 'du shes la gdam nga yod pa dang / 'cho sdod kyi rig gnas gsar pa'i bsam blo'i rmang gzhi de'ang 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin gyi bsam blo de yin tshe legs snyam/ka 〈sna tshogs gangs ri'i khrod kyi bsam gzhigs 〉kyi khrod du kho bos 'jigs nyen skor gyi gnad don de'i rigs gleng tsam byas yod pa las de la ji ltar rgol lan slog pa'i dris lan skor gang yang 'god thub med/ de ni nga rang ha cang blo 'gyod skye dgos pa'i las ka zhig red/der brten/ lo 'ga'i ring kho bos 'jigs nyen skor gyi gnad don de'i rigs ji ltar thag gcod dgos pa'i phyogs su mno bsam zhib tu byas pa yin la/ rnyed pa'i dris lan ni/(1)gtor brlags dang bral ba'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su gtong ba/31

(2)rnying rul gyi 'tsho sdod byed thabs la gsar brje byed pa/(3)rgyun bsring thub pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su gtong ba/pa/ (4)tshan rig lag rtsal ni thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin (5)mi'i rigs kyis rang byung gi khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs byed dgos pa/(6)mi'i rigs kyis tshan rig lag rtsal bed spyod pa'i dus yang dag dang lugs mthun can du 'gyur dgos zhes pa'i sgul shugs ldan pa'i bsam blo de rnams red/nga tsho mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu ni dngos yod kyi gnad don zhig red la 'phel rgyas kyi slad du rang byung khams gsar sbol (tshekhri )byed rgyu'ang dngos yod kyi gnad don zhig red/gsar sbol dang 'dzugs skrun/ rang byung khams nyid gtor brlags dang bral ba dang rgyun bsrings thub pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu ni mi'i rigs 'tsho sdod kyi rtsa ba'i dngos yod cig yin pas dngos yod dang dngos yod dbar gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel bar do snang byed thub pa bya rgyu ni spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod cig dang las 'gan bla med cig red/kha/ bod ljongs kyi dngos yod dang mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas/ rnying rul gyi 'tsho sdod bsam blor bsgyur bcos byed par snyam pa'i bsam gzhigs kyi rol rtsed pa rnam pa lags/ nged gnyis kyis so so'i shes rab kyi nus pa spyad de 'tsho sdod kyi byed thabs gsar pa zhig gleng slong byas yod mod/ 'tsho sdod kyi khyab khongs yongs nas bshad na 'tsho sdod kyi bsam blo yod tshad nged gnyis kho nar dbang ba zhig min pas khyed rnams kyang ‘‘'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas bsam blo'i ’’do 32

ra 'dir bag yangs kyi sgo nas 'jug thub par re smon zhu/ spyir yang bsam blo'i lta tshul mang po zhig gi thog ngas tsho phan tshun gtam gleng byas pa brgyud lugs mthun du 'gyur dgos kyi yod na le'u gsum pa ste/rtog 'jug dang dpyad gzhigs/ bsam blo yi phyi don skor gleng ba'i dus nga tshos bskyar du gnad don la bgro gleng yod par smon/gsum pa/ rtog 'jug dang dpyad gzhigs/bsam blo'i phyi don rang bzhin skor/ka mi rigs shig dang / rgyal khab cig gi stobs 'byor mnga' thang de nyid dngos yod gnas tshul dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos tshe mi rigs gang der sngar yod pa'i rig gnas bsam blo'i ma lag der blang dor 'byed pa dang / dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas khrod dar bzhin pa'i rig gnas bsam blo de bsdu len gang nus byed rgyu ni smos ma dgos pa'i gtan tshigs shig yin pa ma zad sus kyang rgol mi nus pa'i khas len zhig kyang red/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar dngos yod ni spyi tshogs gang dang mi su la'ang phyogs ris kyi 'du shes med par btang snyoms su gnas yod pa dang / dngos yod kyi mdun du go skabs dam 'dzin byed thub min ni dngos yod kyi 'tsho sdod pa de'i gdam nga'i nus stobs dang 'phel rgyas kyi bsam blor rag las yod pa zhig red/der brten 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus la phyi mig bltas tshe mtsho bod mtho sgang du gzhis chags pa'i mi rigs der spobs pa skye 'os pa'i lo rgyus yod pa nga tshos mthong thub la ngo gnong dgos pa'i lo rgyus yod pa'ang nga 33

tshos mthong thub/ dper na/ lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi tshul ldan shes rig gi lo rgyus khrod du mi rigs gang des khyon yongs nas chos lugs shig dar spel dang chos lugs kyi 'du shes gzhan zhig nang 'dren byed pa'i phyogs su blo rtsal yod tshad 'don sprugs byed pa las tshe srog gi dngos yod 'tsho sdod kyi rin thang dang snod kyi bkod pa 'dul spyod byed pa'i rang byung sher rtogs rig pa'i ( khri tshi 0 r+ha) bsam blo'i rtogs gzhigs dang dar 'phel gyi phyogs su hur brtson gang yang byas med pa dang / rgyu rkyen des da lta'i char mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnas pa'i mi rnams 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul dang dbye mtshams je ring du 'gro bzhin yod pa ma zad dngos yod kyi 'tsho sdod ni kho tshor mtshon na rin thang gang yang med pa'i 'du shes shig tu gyur yod pa red/mi rigs shig gi 'tsho sdod rin thang gi lta tshul de skyob dka' ba'i nyen kha'i gnas 'di lta bur slebs pa dang bsam blo'i ma lag hril por gzhan rten dang re sgug slong mo bcas rnying zhen dang sgyid lug pa'i rig gnas lta tshul gyis khyab pa'i skabs gzu bor gnas pa tshos thog mar thag gcod 'dod pa ni mi rigs gang de 'tsho sdod kyi mdun du gnyom chung nus med dang rang byung sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul la snang med/ sgyid lug dang rnying zhen gyi lta bar gtsigs chen byed pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs gang yin 'tshol snyeg bya rgyu de ma red dam/kha srol rgyun gyi rig gnas bsam blo yin na'ang 'dra/ srol rgyun gyi lta tshul yin na'ang 'dra/ srol rgyun 'du shes khyab khongs yin na'ang 'dra/ nga tshos bskyar du dpyad gzhigs dang zhib bsher byed 'dod pa'i tshad gzhi ni dngos po'i tshul ldan shes rig dar spel thad 34

'gog rkyen gyi nus shugs yod med kyi sgo nas bzhag gi yod pa dang /gal srid mi'i rigs kyis lo rgyus kyi dngos yod de'i khrod du rig gnas bsam blo de dang lta tshul de nyid/ 'du shes kyi khyab khongs de nyid bed spyod byas zin pa dang rma med kyi dge mtshan yang gang la gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas bskrun yod mod de ni dgos mkho de nyid skong thub pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ de ring gi nyin mo ni rig stobs dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs shig yin pa dang / de'i khyad rtags gtso bo ni shes bya nyid spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi rtsa ba'i thon khungs dang sgul shugs su gyur yod pa ma zad mi'i rigs kyi cha 'phrin gsar pa'i (lo4zlotshokhyuri)tshul ldan shes rig gi spyi tshogs shig kyang bsu bzhin yod pa red/ der brten nga tshos rang nyid 'phel rgyas su 'gro ma thub pa'i rgyu rkyen de nyid 'tshol snyeg dang 'phel rgyas kyi gnad don de nyid thag gcod dgos tshe/thog mar rtogs gzhigs byed dgos pa ni sngar yod srol rgyun gyi 'du shes sna tshogs yin pa dang / brgyud zin pa'i lam khar phyi mig blta ba dang da lta'i spyi tshogs khrod kyi rnying rul gyi bsam blo gnyis drang bden dang dngos yod kyi srang la gzhal ba'i dus/ skabs rer mthong thub pa ni srol rgyun gyi rig gnas bsam blo dang lta tshul/ 'du shes khyab khongs des spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas thad phyogs so so nas 'gog rkyen bzo bzhin yod pa ma zad tshan rig lag rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas phyogs su 'gal 'du'i sun 'byin byed bzhin yod/ de la dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ rnying pa thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ / gsar pa thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems/ / 'di ni da lta'i bar du rang re'i srol/ / zhes spyi tshogs hril po dang mi rigs hril po'i rnying zhen gyi lta tshul la rnag thog 35

gtsag 'khel gyi sdom tshig bzos yod pa 'dis gsal bshad byed thub/yang skabs rer sgug rten slong gsum gyi bsam blo shugs che zhing gang dran spyi rig dang 'char gzhi gang ya nga med pa'i bde lhod ring lugs (sto྾tshokro)pa'i bde skyid la mgo 'khor te sdod kyin yod pa des mtshon thub pa ni nged cag rnams kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs ni khrag 'jib 'bu phra yi 'tsho sdod kyi rnam pa zhig yin pa mthong thub/ka der ma zad bsam blo nyid rnying zhen gyi gnas bab de nas bcing 'grol gtong khag pa dang rlabs chen mi sna'i tshad gzhi de'ang lha yis thag gcod dgos pa'i sgrig gzhi gtan 'bebs des skabs rer nged cag gi rlabs chen mi sna ni spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes gzhan zhig nas byung ba ma yin par lha'i rig par hur brtson byas pa'i 'bras bu las byung ba dang / lo rgyus thog rlabs chen mi sna ni chos lugs pa rang nyid dang yang na chos lugs kyi dad 'dun pa/ de min chos lugs la rgyab skyor byed mkhan tsho'i khrod du ma gtogs byung thub med la byung na'ang lo rgyus thog 'god thub kyi med/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni chos lugs kyi 'du shes kyis lta tshul yod tshad gcig gyur byas pa'i dbang gis yin pa dang / da lta'i char rlabs chen mi sna yod tshad chos lugs pa yin pa dang 'du shes kyi khyab khongs thams cad srol rgyun yin pa des ra sprod byed thub pa de ni rang re'i srol rgyun gyi 'du shes der mi gshis la gnya' gnon dang bsamatshoblo'i 'phel rgyas la tshad bkag gi rang bzhin zhig yod pa de red/ gal srid nga tshos rang gi 'du shes kyi khyab khongs der zhib bsher bya thub pa dang byed dgos tshe nges par dang len byed dgos pa ni 'jar man gyi 'phags mi'i sher rtogs rig pa ba ne khre'i ‘‘rin thang yod tshad la gsar 36

du gdeng 'jog byed pa'i tshod lta'i ’’lta ba de yin pas rang skyon rang brjod dang rang skyon rang bsher/ rang nyid bsgyur bkod kyi rmang gzhi'i thog bdag nyid gong bkur ( khri7stsalko)gyi lta ba'ang dar spel gtong dgos/ nga'i bsam par thabs shes de ni nga tsho nyen kha'i gnas de nas skyob pa'i gdam nga min nam snyam/kha khyed kyi dbye zhib der nga rang rbad de mos mthun yod/gdam nga dang blang dor gyi 'du shes khrod nas nga tshos lam kha gsar pa zhig nges par gtod thub dgos la/ tshe srog gi rin thang der yang ngar shugs gsar pa zhig skyed thub pa byed dgos/ yin yang lo rgyus thog yod pa'i rig gnas bsam blo dang 'du shes kyi khyab khongs der yang ngos 'dzin nan tan byed dgos/ de ni nga tshos lam kha gsar pa zhig gtod byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pas red/ mtsho bod mtho sgang du dar myong ba'i chos lugs 'du shes la rnam pa gnyis yod pa las bon po'i skor gyi gnas tshul 'ga' khri srong lde btsan gyi 〈bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma'i ma do 〉bcas yig cha 'ga' spyad de ngo sprod byas zin pa ltar skabs bab de tsam las bskyar zhu mi bya/ bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs la mtshon na nga tshos gsar du ngos 'dzin dang rtogs gzhigs byed dgos pa'i gnad don yang mang po zhig yod pa dang / bskyar du dpyad 'jog dang gnas thig gtan 'khel (tshomon+t+ra)byed dgos pa'ang yod/ka chos lugs kyi 'du shes dar spel dang der gtsigs chen shugs drag byas pa'i 'bras bu ni da lta'i char dpal 'byor rjes lus kyi gnas su gyur yod pa dang / rang byung khams nyid tshad nges can gyi bsam blos sgyur bcos byed pa'i spobs pa dang / dngos po'i tshul ldan 37

shes rig dang bsam blo'i tshad ldan shes rig dbar gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel ba ni kho tshor mtshon na 'jig rten pha rol gyi gsang ba nang ltar gsang bar gyur yod na'ang kho tshos dang len byed nges pa ni gsang ba gang zhig kho tsho dang dbye mtshams ji tsam ring ba de tsam gyis yid brtan dang dad mos che ru 'gro bzhin yod/ rkyen des dngos yod kyi mdun du kho tsho nam yang gnyid du yur te bsdad yod pa dang / gal srid gnyid las slong mkhan gyi bsam blo ba re byung tshe kho tshos rtag tu dgra ltar 'gal bar 'dzin zhing bde lhod ring lugs pa'i bsam blo dang skyid gnyer gyi las la skul mkhan tshor kho tshos mgon skyabs su ngos 'dzin byas te bsngags brjod dang dga' po byed/ 'on te bde lhod ring lugs pa'i gnas skabs kyi bde skyid des kho tshor bslu brid gzhal las 'das pa zhig byas yod pa ni kho tshos ji ltar shes/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas 'go brtsams te bod yig sde khag yod pa'i slob grwa chen mo'i slob phrug tshos don gnad de la dmigs te bsam blo'i 'gul skyod kyi mtho rlabs rab dang rim par spel yod mod mtsho bod mtho sgang 'di mtho drags pa'am yang na bsam blo'i mtho rlabs der gso rlung nyung drags pa'am gang ltar mkhregs 'dzin gyi sa rgod rnying pa der dngos yod 'du shes dang 'tsho sdod bsam blo ldan pa'i rig gnas gsar pa'i bag chags kyi myu gu zhig skyes thub med/shin tu yid skyo ba ni mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad cha 'phrin gsar ba'i dus rabs (blo4p+ta3ṣ+ṭhari'i44shu)su slebs yod na'ang rang rigs tsho rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi bsam blor mgo 'khor te bsdad yod pa dang / hang sangs pa ni tshan rig gi 'bras bu sna tshogs la longs su spyod bzhin du da dung tshan rig gi bsam blor dma' 'bebs dang zur phud byed pa'i 'du 38

shes de red/ kha rgyu mtshan de dag gi dbang gis nga tshos rig gnas bsam blo gsar pa zhig bsdu len dang dang len byed par gdam nga gang yang mi 'dug la/ srol rgyun gyi lta bas dngos yod kyi 'tsho sdod bsam blo'i 'thus tshab byed mi thub pa'ang drang bden zhig yin pas de'i phyogs su rtsod pa byed dgos don mi 'dug nga tsho'i da lta'i las 'gan gtso bo ni brdar sha chod pa'i sgo nas srol rgyun rig gnas la dpyad gzhigs dang rang byung sher rtogs rig pa dang tshan rig gi lta tshul/ 'tsho sdod kyi bsam blo'i nus shugs che ru ji ltar gtong rgyu de red/ bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs la mtshon na rig gnas 'phel 'gyur smra ba'i lta tshul gyis dpyad tshe rgya gar rang gnas su dar ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rmang gzhi de'i thog bod mi'i mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas ( stsaspra7)kyi 'du shes bsres te bod mi'i 'du shes ltar 'phel rgyas byung ba'i cha nas bod brgyud nang bstan zhes tha snyad btags yod pa dang / de'i khyad rtags gtso bo ni bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar zhes dar 'phel gyi go rim gnyis yod pa las mtshon gyi yod pa ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/(1)bon chos kyis sangs rgyas chos lugs bsdu len dang zur bshol bsam shes byas pa dang / (2) ban bon dbar du zhi ba'i dmag 'thab byung ba/(3) rim can pa dang cig car ba dbar gyi 'thab rtsod/(4)dgon sde gsar 'dzugs dang ser mo ba skyed sring /(5)nang bstan chos lugs kyi bka' bstan bod yig tu bsgyur ba/(6)nang bstan chos lugs kyi sgron sgrog pa/(7)rgyal brgyud mi tshang gi rgyab skyor/39

(8)'dul ba dang mi mthun pa'i gtan 'bebs/(9)'jig rten pa'i lha la bkur bsti byed pa/(10)dge slong ma'i sdom rgyun spel ma thub pa sogs kyi khyad rtags yod pa dang /bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/(1)bod mi'i rang gi blo rtsal gyis bskrun pa'i grub mtha' dar ba dang /(2)bla sprul gyi yang srid 'tshol lugs dar ba/(3)chos srid zung 'brel/(4)zas gos dang rol chas/(5)dgon pa'i sgrig gzhi/(6)dge bshes gtong stangs dang rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod/(7)mdzes rig dang de'i 'phel 'gyur gyi gcig gyur/(8)zlos gar dang dbyangs kyi skor/(9)dmangs khrod kyi dar 'phel/(10)phyogs yongs kyi khyab spel sogs khyad rtags bcu tsam yod pa red/ka gzu bor gnas pa tshor gsal rtogs dang tshor shes gang 'dra byung yod med ma nges mod/ kho bos bod kyi shes rig dang nang sgos de'i deng phyin gyi 'phel lam skor la mno bsam byed pa'i dus/ zhib 'jug gi ched du zhib 'jug byed rgyu las 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam gang yang med pa dang / rig gnas dang bsam blo'i 'du shes/ chos lugs kyi khyab khongs gang yod kyi mdun du 'phel rgyas su 'gro khag pa'i 'jigs nyen gyi gnas tshul zhig lhags 'dug de ni gzhan gang yang min par srol rgyun rig gnas dang bsam blo'i 'du shes/ chos lugs kyi khyab khongs kyi nang rkyen de dngos yod dang dbye mtshams ring du gyes pa dang de'ang gsal por bshad na nang rkyen des dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la 40

snang med khur med byas pas rig gnas dang bsam blo/ chos lugs kyi 'du shes gang yod la ngar shugs gsar pa rgyas rgyu phar bzhag dngos yod 'phel rgyas kyi ldog phyogs su 'phel rgyas phyin te dngos yod kyi 'phel rgyas la sun 'byin zur phud/ dgag bzhag bya byed du gyur yod pa red/khyod kyis smos pa ltar srol rgyun gyi 'du shes khyab khongs yongs la zhib bsher dang rtogs gzhigs byed rgyu ni dngos yod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong bar sgul shugs rang bzhin ldan pa'i rig gnas bsam blo gsar pa 'byung byed kyi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi yin par mos 'dun yod la/ nged gnyis kyi gleng gzhi brjod don yang bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad rtags thog bzhag tshe gleng don de brgyud nas nga tshor med pa'am yang na nga tsho'i rig gnas bsam blo'i 'du shes kyis ldang gi med pa'i 'du shes gang yin kha gsab phyogs su'ang dge mtshan rma med cig skrun thub nges red/kha des na brjod don dngos la 'jug pa la/ 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘chab srid bon dang sgrung lde'u gsum gyi babs skad pa/ sde snod (gsum )bod du 'byung ba'i snga ltas su/ bon dang sgrung dang lde'u gsum spyod pa'o ’’zhes dang / yang de nyid du ‘‘de'i dus su (gri gum btsan po'i dus/)yu 'gyur sna sa sna bya ba na mu stegs breg pa'i bon po wa zha bya ba gcig la bon byung ste/ rdzu 'phrul che ba nas/ gnam la lhab lhab 'phur zhing kha nas thol thol smra/ shing la 'breng du 'dra zhing rdo la lhu gzugs byed pa des/ zhugs bcad kyi btsan la las su mchod do//’rizhes bkod yod pa de las nga tshos rtogs thub pa ni rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i ring nas bon dar yod pa dang / de ltar cha 'jog byas tshe bon chos 41

de sangs rgyas chos lugs las bod yul du dar snga ba yod pa dang / bod —rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar ba'i dus bon chos ni bod rang gnas kyi chos lugs lta bur gyur yod pa red/'on te sangs rgyas chos lugs der rgyal rgyud mi tshang gis ram 'degs byas yod pa ma zad nang bstan rang nyid dar 'phel gyi khrod du sngar yod chos lugs de dang lhan du bsres nas 'phel rgyas phyin par brten chos lugs phan tshun gyi 'du shes dbar gyi 'gal ba chung du song ba dang /chos lugs phan tshun gyi 'gal ba chung du phyin pa dang lhan du phan tshun gyi 'phel rgyas la 'gog rkyen dang gnon shugs sprod pa'i bsam blo nyung ngur phyin pa nas med par gyur te chos lugs shig gis chos lugs gzhan zhig bsdu len dang dang len byed pa'i go rim brgyud yod pa dang / chos lugs de nyid kyis kyang gnas bab che ge mo zhig gi thog skabs bstun rang bzhin gyi bzo lta zhig mtshon bzhin yod pa ni chos lugs 'phel 'gyur gyi go rim dang bon chos kyis sangs rgyas chos lugs bsdu len dang zur bshol bsam shes byas tshul gyi khyad rtags red/ka gong du brjod pa ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du ma spel gong bon chos nyid mtsho bod mtho sgang du dar yod pa dang / phyis su sangs rgyas chos lugs bod yul du dar ba'i skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis bon chos kyi byed lugs 'ga' zhig dang len dang 'ga' zhig zur 'don byas yod pa ni/(1)srong btsan sgam po'i dus nang bstan rjes 'jug pa tshos bon chos kyis lo ltar sems can mang po dmar mchod 'bul dgos pa skyon du ngos 'dzin byas pas srong btsan sgam pos srid kyi nus pa spyad de bon 42

chos bsnubs pa dang /(2)〈bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa 〉ru khri srong lde btsan lo na phra ba'i dus ma zhang khrom pa skyes kyis dbang cha yongs rdzogs bzung yod cing / ‘‘blon po ma zhang ni bon po'i chos lugs la dad pa byed pa ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la gtan nas mi dga' ba'i rkyen gyis bka' phab don du skye ba phyi ma la skye ba len rgyu yod zer ba rdzun yin/ tshe 'dir lha 'dre'i gnod 'tshe bzlog thabs la bon po'i bgyi ’’zhes dang ‘‘sems can bsad pa'i rgyu ma dang / nang khrol rnams lha sku'i mgo bo dang lag pa'i steng du bkal/ lha sku'i steng du pags pa dmar po bskams/ chos la dad pa'i blon po lang mes gzigs dang 'bal ldong tshab gnyis khrims la sbyar nas srog thog btang ’’ba der khri srong lde btsan yid ma rangs par phyis su rang nyid kyis srid dbang dngos su bzung rjes bon chos kyi lta ba'i rjes su 'brangs mkhan ma zhang khrom pa skyes gson por dur sbas btang tshul skor bkod yod pa ni ban bon gnyis dbar gyi rgyal pham gyi lo rgyus mtshon pa'i 'thab rtsod cig yin pa ma zad zhi ba'i dmag 'khrug de'i khrod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis kyang g.yang sgrub pa dang mdos glud gtong ba/ ro bsreg pa/ lha bsangs gtong ba/ hom bsreg sogs khag cig bsdu len byas yod pa de ni ban bon dbar gyi zhi ba'i dmag 'khrug ste bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad rtags mtshon byed du gyur yod pa red/kha gna' rabs kyi dus su chos lugs shig nyams dmas su gtong ba dang / chos lugs gzhan zhig dang len dang 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu ni rgyal po gang de'i gdam nga la rag las yod pa 'dra/ yang 43

gcig gna' bo'i dus su mi'i rigs kyis chos lugs nyid dang len byed don yang chos lugs de nyid kyis skabs de dus kyi tshul ldan shes rig gi 'thus tshab byas yod pas yin pa dang / nga tshos chos lugs kyi gnad don la bsam gzhigs byed skabs lo rgyus thog gi phan nus dang dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi 'gog rkyen gnyis dbar dbye mtshams gsal 'byed byed dgos/ de ni deng phyin nga tshos rig gnas bsam blo gang 'dra zhig dang len byed dgos par rag las yod pa dang / gal srid nga tsho lo rgyus kyi slad du srol rgyun gyi khyab khongs de las brgal ma thub pa yin na nged cag gi gom pa'i 'degs 'jog de 'jigs nyen gyi phyogs su bsgyur bzhin yod pa smos ga la dgos/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus nang bstan chos lugs de mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnas pa'i rang rigs tshos bsdu len dang dang len byed don yang srol rgyun gyi chos lugs 'du shes khyab khongs nas brgal rgyu dang gcig gnyis su skabs de'i chab srid kyi 'pho 'gyur dang 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho'i ched du yin pa dang / thu bhod rgyal rabs brtan po 'ong ba'i ched rgyal rabs rim byung gis sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dar 'phel thad dmigs su rgyab skyor byas yod pa dang / khri srong lde btsan gyis 〈bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma'i mdo 〉bya ba'i dpe deb brtsams te 'khyar bon nam ma ni'i chos lu gas la dgag bzhag dang rtsod spongs/ zur phud byas te sangs rgyas chos lugs la bstod pa dang dang len bya rgyur skul 'ded byas yod pa de dag gis ra sprod byed thub pa ni thu bhod rgyal rabs kyi dus su chos lugs kyi khyab khongs shig nas chos lugs kyi khyab khongs gzhan zhig tu bgrod dgos par 'dod pa ma zad/mtsho bod mtho sgang du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar thub pa ni rgyal rgyud mi 44
