tshang gi rgyab skyor rma med la rag las yod pa dang / de ni bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad rtags gzhan zhig ste rgyal rgyud mi tshang gis chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang 'tsham po'i ngang rgyab skyor byas yod tshul de red/ka nged cag gi bsam blo'i 'gul bskyod mtha' dag dra phad kyi nang du tshud nas bsdad pa yin na mtha' mjug ngal dub che thag chod cing / 'jig rten gyi ltad mo gang yang ma mthong bar 'chi lam du skyod mkhan ni nga tsho rang yin rgyu red/ dus rabs nges can zhig gis mkho 'don byas pa'i shi min gson min gyi re 'dun de nas 'go brtsams te nged cag gi rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi tshad gzhi de nyid gzhan gyi rig gnas bsam blo'i chu tshad 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi ru ngos 'dzin byas yod pa dang / de dang lhan du nga tsho'i zur 'bud kyi bsam blo yang shugs che ru phyin te mtsho bod mtho sgang gi mkha' dbugs dang sa gshis gnas bab la kha g.yar te phyi phyogs sgo 'byed dang rig gnas bsam blo gzhan dag bsdu len byed pa'i sgo mo de brgyab yod pa red/ der ma zad sangs rgyas chos lugs nang khul gyi bsam blo'i 'dzin stangs de yang rgya ba/ra du khungs gtugs gang thub byas yod pa ni cig car gyi lugs 'dzin pa po ha shang ma ha ya na dang rim can pa'i rang lugs 'dzin pa po ka ma la shi la gnyis dbar gyi rtsod pa lta bus mtshon zhing / spyir btang cig car ba dang rim can pa'i lta ba ni 〈mdo sde pad ma dkar po 〉dang 〈ṭagengs rgyas phal po che'i mdo'i 〉rjes su 'brangs shing theg pa chen mo'i mdo sde de gnyis kyi dgongs don la rjesasdo 'jug pa tsho shes rtogs kyi chu tshad mi 'dra ba'i cha nas byung ba zhig yin pa las ha shang ma ha ya na yis ston pa shākya thub pa'i 45

dgongs don 'khral 'khrul tu shes rtogs byas pa dang / ka ma la shi las ston pa shākya thub pa'i dgongs don 'khrul med yang dag tu shes rtogs byas pa'i gnad don zhig min/ khri srong lde btsan gyis gdan 'dren zhus shing khri srong lde btsan gshegs nas zla gsum gyi rjes su bod du phebs myong bar brjod pa'i paṇa chen bi ma la mi tras (lo tsā ba tshul khrims rin chen gyi 〈bstan 'gyur dkar chag 〉2791nas 793bar gsal/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / 1985lo'i zla 12par/) kyang 〈cig car 'jug pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsgom don 〉zhes pa dang 〈rim gyis 'jug pa'i bsgom don 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb gnyis brtsams yod pa der brtag tshe cig car ba dang rim can pa'i bsam blo'i mtho rlabs de ni nang palī chos lugs dar yul gyi bsam blo'i mtho rlabs shig tu gyur yod pa ma zad rgya gar rang yul du'ang cig car ba dang rim can pa'i lta ba shugs chen sgos dar spel phyin pa rtogs thub/ yin yang mtsho bod mtho sgang du lta lugs de gnyis dus yun lo gsum ring rtsod pa byas rjes rgyal pham thag chod pa'i zol la brten te so so'i rang gnas su log yod na'ang de'i 'bras bur mi mngon sbas pa'i ngang tshul zhig dang lhan du 'phel rgyas su byung yod pa ni bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha'i skor gleng ba'i dus zhu rgyu yin zhes pa ni cig car ba dang rim can pa'i lta lugs rtsod pas mtshon pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi khyad rtags so/ /kha nga tshos phyogs gzhan zhig nas bltas tshe thu bhod rgyal rabs kyi dus su sangs rgyas chos lugs nyid phyogs yongs nas bsdu len byed don ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dad mos des thu bhod dus rabs kyi 46

'bangs mi ser la ngar shugs slong thub pa dang dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi srid dbang shugs che ru gtong thub pa'i ched du yin pa dang / kho tshos skabs de'i spyi tshogs lam lugs de mu mthud sra brtan 'ong ba'i ched 'bangs mi ser gyi khams dang 'tshams par spyi lo 762lo nas spyi lo 766lo'i dbar bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa ma zad spyi lo 767lor bod la grwa pa byed thub mkhan yong dang mi yong tshod lta byed ched/rgya gar nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa yin pa'i dge slong bcu gnyis gdan drangs nas mkhan chen bo dhi su tos mkhan po dang /dge slong bcu gnyis kyis kha skong byas te rba gsal snang dang sang shi/ rma rin chen mchog 'khon klu'i dbang po srung / pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ la gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub bcas mi bdun rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs sgrub/ de ni bod la grwa pa byed mkhan gyi thog ma yin pas sad mi mi bdun zer/ sad mi mi bdun rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi las ka de mthil phyin pa byung bar brten kri srong lde btsan gyis bskyar du mi sus grwa pa byas na des khral dang dmag khral 'khur mi dgos pa dang grwa pa gcig mi tshang bdun gyis gso dgos pa'i 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs dang mi mthun pa'i lam lugs btong pa nas lo ngo gcig lhag tsam gyi ring snga rjes su grwa pa'i sdom 'bor gyi grangs sum brgya dang gdan 'dren zhus pa'i mkhan chen bo dhi swa to dang paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra/ za hor nas gdan 'dren zhu bar brjod pa'i pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khrom nas ka ma la shi la/ rgya nag gdan 'dren zhus pa ha shang ma ha ya na dang wun su'u (sprasau)dang lang shig( gle.au)kha che nas a nan ta sogs la rag las yod pa red/47

ka nga tsho'i shes bya'i yul du gyur pa'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya'i ngos nas bshad na khyod kyis gong du smos pa ltar dgon sde gsar 'dzugs dang ser mo ba bskyed sring / nang bstan chos lugs kyi sgron sgrog pa bod du 'byor zhing kho tshos rgyal rgyud mi tshang dang 'brel ba dam zab sgos nang chos spel ba dang / khri srong lde btsan gyis 'dul ba dang mi mthun pa'i gtan 'bebs mdzad pa bcas ni bod brgyud nang bstan gyi khyad chos yin nges na'ang gsal 'byed byed dgos pa'i gnad don yang 'di 'dra yod pa ste/ thog ma'i char bsam yas ni dgon pa ma yin par lo paṇa tshos rgyud sde man ngag gi chos bsgyur yul yin pa dang skabs de dus bsam yas sgra bsgyur gling zer ba las bsam yas dgon pa zhes mi 'bod/sad mi mi bdun dus thog gcig tu rab tu byung ba yin min yang brjod dka' ba dang o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mkhan chen bo dhi su to gnyis kyi phyogs su'ang dogs slong byed dgos pa 'di 'dra 'dug 〈be+e ro'irnam thar 'dra 'bad chen mo 〉ru za hor mkhan po bo dhi su to zhes bkod yod pa dang 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉du rgya gar nas bo dhi su to dang bi ma la mi tra zhes bkod yod la bon gyi chos 'byung 'ga' ru mkhan chen bo dhi su to ni rgya gar du slob sbyong la phyin myong ba'i lha sa'i mi zhig tu bshad/o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi cha la 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉du za hor nas pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes dang / 〈bai ro'i rnam thar 'dra 'bag chen mo 〉ru o rgyan yul nas spyan drangs pa'i pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes gdan 'dren zhu yul so sor bkod yod pa des nga tshos kha tshon gcod dka' ba ni chos lugs kyi sgron sgrog pa de tsho yang —snying yul phyogs gang nas yin lugs de red/ lhag par du 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉du gsang sngags snga 'gyur dang phyi 48

'gyur ram yang na gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbye ba brjod pa'i skabs 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉2143nang du/ ‘‘rdo rje gdan nas 'gyur ba gsar ma yin la/ u rgyan nas 'gyur ba rnying ma yin zer/ mkha' 'gro nas rgyud pa gsar ma la/ rig 'dzin nas rgyud pa rnying ma/ gter ma med pa gsar ma/ gter ma yod pa rnying ma yin zer te/ de rnams ma nges gsungs ’’ zhes snga 'gyur gsang sngags sam rnying ma ni rgya gar rang nas dar ba min pas zur 'bud rang bzhin gyi dogs slong byas yod pa dang /nga tshos dogs gzhi de spyad de cha 'jog cig byas chog pa ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i dus su kho bos 'khyar bon du 'dod pa'i ma ni chos lugs de da lta'i dbyi ran tshud pa'i a rab sa khul dang e she ya'i dbus lho sa khul du dar khyab 'gro bzhin pa'i sgang yin pa dang / o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ni dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod du 'byor ba dang o rgyan yul ni da lta'i dbyi ran yin par ngos 'dzin pa/ u rgyan nas 'gyur ba rnying ma zhes zur 'bud kyi dogs slong bcas dogs gzhi mang bas dpyad par 'tshal/kha bsam yas sgra bsgyur gling du spyi lo 824lo'i dbar snga phyir dpe cha 735tsam bsgyur ba'i mtshan byang bkod pa las / dpe cha 735yi khrod du dpe cha 2la zhu chen byas med pa dang / bsgyur 'phror lus pa dpe cha 6yod pa de byings tshang mtshozhu chen gtan 'bebs byas tshar ba dang /mang che shos ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' red/ lo rgyus de ni khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la bsgrigs pa'i 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉las rtogs nus shing / 〈bai ro tsa na'i rnam thar 'dra 'bag che mo 〉ru bsam yas sgra bsgyur gling du dpe cha 164lhag tsam bsgyur ba'i mtshan byang bkod 'dug49

gzhan 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉ru theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rgya las bsgyur ba zhes ched du bsgrigs pa'i nang 〈mdo sde phal po che 〉dang 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉bcas dpe cha 22lhag tsam gyi mtshan byang bkod yod pa la gzhigs tshe bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de rgya gar gcig pu nas bsgyur ba ma yin par nye 'brel mi rigs khag nas bsdu len byas yod pa ra sprod byed thub pas tshul de yang bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad rtags shig yin pa smos ma dgos/ka chos lugs dang rig gnas kyi bsam blo gang yin yang nang 'dren gyi gnas bab nas rang gnas chos lugs dang rig gnas bsam blo ru 'gyur ba'i go rim zhig brgyud yod pa dang / go rim de'i khrod du sngar yod kyi rang gnas chos lugs dang rig gnas bsam blo des nang 'dren chos lugs dang rig gnas bsam blo der bkag rgya bzo ba dang zur 'bud byed pa/ rgyal rgyud mi tshang gi dgos mkho skong ba'i slad 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs byung yod pa ma zad so so'i dad mos kyi dbang gis srog la rgol ba'i don rkyen yang byung yod pa ni khri srong lde btsan gyi dus nang chos la dad pa'i blon po lang mes gzigs dang 'bal ldong tshab gnyis srog thog tu btang ba dang / bon chos la dad pa byed mkhan ma zhang khrom pa skyes gson sbas byas pa lta bu red/kha nga'i bsam par nang 'dren chos lugs dang rig gnas bsam blo nyid rang gnas chos lugs dang rig gnas bsam blo ru gyur zhes pa'i go don dngos ni nang 'dren gyi chos lugs dang rig gnas bsam blo des rang nyid 'phel rgyas 'gro yul gyi mi rigs gang de'i rig 50

gnas bsam blo bsdu len dang dang len byas pa'i cha rkyen 'og yul de ru 'phel rgyas phyin par 'dod la/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis chos dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i mo rgyud kyi yul lha'am lha srung zhi drag bcu gnyis spel ba nas lha la 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi rtogs sad dam rnam sad kyi lha dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas su brtse zhing rol bar dga' ba'i lha/ 'jig rten mi yul du mi rang nyid lha'i go sa la bkod pa'i yul lha zhes lha rigs gsum byung ba'i phyi ma 'jig rten pa'i lha de mo rgyud spel ba dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar ba nas lo ngo stong phrag gcig dang sum brgya'i ring 〈mdo mdzangs blun 〉du bkod pa'i dge slong ma ut+pala'i mdog la nyes skyon chag sgo byung tshul dang sdug bsngal myong tshul kha g.yar te dge slong ma'i sdom rgyun spel ma thub pa dang yang na ma spel ba de gnyis ni bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad chos shig yin na'ang 'dir nges par bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa'i gnad don gzhan zhig ni bod du spel ma thub pa dge slong gi sdom rgyun ma yin par dge slong ma'i sdom rgyun yin pa dang / o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dam la btags par brjod pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyang bud med yin pa de gnyis kyis brjod mi shes pa'i gsang ba zhig skong yod pa ma zad spobs pa chen pos cha 'jog cig byas tshe thu bhod rgyal rabs kyi dus su bud med kyi spyi tshogs gnas bab shin tu dma' ba dang / rim pa mthon po'i spyi tshogs kyi khrod du bud med la ngan pa dang brnyas par blta ba'i 'du shes shig yod nges snyam/ka cha 'jog ni nam yang cha 'jog yin na/ nga tshos cha 'jog gi 51

thabs lam spyad de rnyed 'dod pa ni yang dag pa'i dris lan de red/ nga tshos 'jig rten gyi yod tshad bden par bzung chog la 'jig rten gyi yod tshad la the tshom yang byed chog de ni 'jig rten gyi bya dngos khag gcig 'jig rten chos nyid kyis brlas/sa pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya dngos khag gcig ni mi rang nyid kyi dgos mkho dang dad mos phyogs res kyis brlags yod pa las gzhan gang yang ma yin/ der brten nga tshos gnad don kha shas kyi dris lan la the tshom byed pa'ang gtan tshigs dngamathun pa dang / gnad don de dag gi dris lan nyid cha 'jog gi rigs par brten te 'tshol 'dod pa'ang 'os shing 'tshams pa zhig red/ de'i thad la nga rang rbad de mos mthun yod/ nged gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i dam bca' ni srol rgyun gyi khyab khongs de nas srol rgyun de nyid gleng slong bya rgyu min par srol rgyun gyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya dang yang na rgyun mthong shes bya'i khyab khongs las brgal te brjod bya de nyid gleng slong bya rgyu yin pa dang / mthar thug gi dmigs yul ni gnad don gang yin yang srol rgyun dang yang na brtag dpyad gang yang med pa'i dris lan gcig la yid ches brtan po byed pa'i dris lan gyi gol sa'am 'khrul gzhi de las brgal (n+t+ramalhohāṣ+ka k+ṣusnu)rgyu de red/ der brten nga'i re bar gsham du bstan pa phyi da ra skabs kyi bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi khyad rtags skor gleng ba'i dus kyang rtsa ba'i dam bca' de'i rmang gzhi'i 'og cha 'jog gi rigs pa spyad de gnad don de nyid gsal bshad byed rgyu ma/ zad gleng gzhir gyur pa'i khyad rtags kyi rigs gang yin yang de dag gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya dang rgyun mthong shes bya'i skor gyi gleng slong nyung du btang ste rtog 'jug gi bsam blo dang dpyad gzhigs kyi thabs lam/52

gleng 'dod pa'i brjod don de nyid rtsod sgrub rig pa dang dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi bsam blo'i mdzub ston la brten te mtshon thub pa byed rgyu ni 'gangs chen zhig red/kha bstan pa phyi dar ni sangs rgyas chos lugs de nyid rang gnas chos lugs su gyur pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog nas dar spel byung ba dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyis mtshon thub pa ni mtshams de nas bzung sangs rgyas chos lugs de nyid bod mi tsho'i blo ngor sim 'dzul ( ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)byung ba'i lo rgyus las gzhan bod mi tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi 'du shes de spyad nas 'jig rten rang byung gi khamaru/ 'dul sbyong byed pa'i rtsa don rang dutsādor te mi tshe'i mthar thug gi gnad don skor la mno sems byas tshul de red/ka bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi khyad par skor la dbye 'byed byed skabs gong du gsal ba'i snga dar dang phyi dar gyi khyad rtags de dag las gzhan bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dpa' ngar ldan pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus sangs rgyas chos lugs rgya cher dar spel byas pa'i dbang gis bod mi tsho'i sems btul te rang byung khams dang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i spobs pa de gnyom chung nus med du gyur yod pa/ yang gcig bstan pa snga dar gyi dus sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bsam blo de bsdu len ched du srid dbang skyong mkhan dang chos dad pa phan tshun dbar 'thab rtsod byung ba dang /bstan pa phyi dar skabs gtso bor 'dul ba'i bstan pa slar gso'i phyogs su 'bad 'bungs byas yod pa/ bstan pa snga dar dus sad mi mi bdun la rab byung sgrub par brten ser mo ba'i sde byung ba dang / bstan pa phyi 53

dar dus sngags 'chang lcang lo can gyi sde dar yod lugs ni lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi 〈bka' shog 〉tu gsal/ der brten glang dar mas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsnubs zhes pa'i go don de yang skabs der yid la mi 'bab pa'i byed srol 'ga' zhig bsnubs pa tsam las sangs rgyas chos lugs phyogs yongs nas bsnubs par ra sprod byed thub med/kha yin na'ang kha cig gis rnying ma ba'i grub mtha' de khri srong lde btsan gyis o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs pa nas dar bar 'dod pa la brtag par bya rgyu 'di yod de/ gal srid khri srong gi dus rnying ma'i grub mtha' dar yod na skabs de dus dar ba'i rnying ma'i grub mtha' de'i lta sgom spyod gsum shod dgos pa dang / lta sgom spyod gsum 'god mi thub na ni de nyid la grub mtha'i mtshan nyid mi tshang ba rang bzhin gyis grub pas de las brling pa'i tshad ma zhig nga tshos phyogs gzhan du 'tshol ga la dgos/ yang gal srid 〈man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba 〉nyid rnying ma'i lta sgom spyod gsum mtshon byed kyi gzhung yin zer na khri srong lde btsan gyi dus sam spyi lo 824lo'i gong du bsgrigs pa'i 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma'i 〉khrod du 〈man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba 〉nyid kyi mtshan byang 'god dgos pa la 'god thub med pa dang / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis rang gi slob dpon gyi lta slom spyod gsum mtshon pa'i dpe deb kyi mtshan byang de'ang 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma'i 〉nang 'god ma thub pa dang yang na ma bkod pa de nyid gnad don zhig ma red dam/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rin chen gyi 〈bstan 'gyur dkar chag 〉tu 〈lta ba'i rim pa'i man ngag 〉ces pa'i dpe deb kyi mtshan byang bkod yod pa de ni ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis brtsams pa dang / bon gyi 〈bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉tu 54

〈man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba 〉zer ba zhig bkod yod pa de ni o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang yang na rnying ma'i grub mtha' dang 'brel ba gang yod ma nges/ 'o na rnying ma'i grub mtha' zer ba ni yang snying gang ljoridra red dam zer na/ kho bo'i sems par rnying ma'i grub mtha' dngos ni klong chen rab 'byams pa nas dar ba dang / de'i bsam blo'i 'byung khungs ni 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉red/ 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉red zer ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni de'i brjod bya la rag las yod pa dang /〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo'i 〉brjod bya gtso bo ni/(1)'jig rten gyi bya dngos thams cad sems las byung ba dang thams cad bden par ma grub cing sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin pa/(2)'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi rgyud du bde gshegs snying po yod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi rgyud du sangs rgyas kyi sa bon yod pa/(3)rang rgyud kyi rtogs pa 'phel bar 'bad 'bungs dang rigs pa'i rtsod pa la gtsigs chen mi byed pa bcas yin pas red/ka 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉ni rgyal nang gi bsam gtan sde pa (nyanyatshan)dang yang 'brel ba dam po yod pa dang / kho tshos 'dod pa'i bsam gtan lta ba'i mthar thug ni 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉ru brnga4ma gtan la (rgya yig par mar)(1) smarkeglotsospyoyā(2)sno/rmedzosre/lnga'i(3)3cholha'ishā0ne+elha(4)kre0nyekhrilnga'i(bod yig par mar ) (1)byis par nye bar spyod pa'i bsam gtan dang /(2)don rab tu 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/55

(3)de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan/(4)de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan sogs bzhi ru dbye yod pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan de yin pa dang / bsam gtan sde pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum thad kyang 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo'i 〉dgongs don khas len pa ni yāng tsun wun (rnyer+shalkosteng)gyis bris pa'i 〈thang rgyal rabs lnga'i bsam gtan sde pa'i lo rgyus 〉〈ṣ+ṭhastu4shur+ṣalko4〉su/(1)tshotsho( miskre3khuci shā’tshojorkor+sā0(2)(4dzadaspra 41kre0gelnga sko6’oṃ—ོba1sgo'i75yi/lkolhashā'i0(3)n+dhu7ske3)cikhri༈skyo’khusna.oṃmar+sāsprastsa0(4)tsābamojilnga'i zhes yod pa 'dis ra sprod byed thub/kha rnying ma'i grub mtha' dang bsam gtan sde pa phan tshun dbar shugs rkyen thebs res byung ba'i lo rgyus yig cha gsal po zhig da phan kho bos ma mthong yang 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉nyid rgya yig las bsgyur ba dang rnying rna 'i grub mtha' ni cig car ba dang rim can pa'i lta ba'i rtsod pa'i phyis su dar ba de'i thog nas brtag tshe bsam gtan sde pa'i shan zhugs yod rgyu red snyam la/ phyogs gzhan du ‘‘rdzogs chen ’’zer ba'ang bsam gtan sde pa'i krespu mojilnga'i zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi don bsgyur min nam snyam ste 'jam dbyangs mkhye/ na brtse dbang po'i 〈gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du bsrings pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi zhes bya ba 〉ru ‘‘rdzogs chen ’’zhes pa'i don ni/ ma hā sarnyi'i sgra las drangs na yang dag pa'i bsam gtan chen po zhes par 'gyur te zhes gsung yod pa lda dalnge gorngo gsaṃl de bizhinaX ga'egs pa'i bsam gtan zhes pa gnyis kyi go don gcig tuX 'groX ba'i phyir/ 'o na ‘‘rdzogs chen ’’gyi dod du yang dag pa'i bsam gtan chen po zhes rang sor ma bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan yang tha snyad kyi bsgyur tshul dang 'phel rgyas 56

pa ma zad nga tshos rig gnas bsam blo gang zhig bsdu len dang bsam blor mdzub ston bya byed du 'dzin dgos pa'ang rtogs nus/ de ni nga tshos bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs la 'dzin pa'i blang bya'ang yin pa dang / mi rang nyid spyi tshogs kyi mi yin pa dang 'tsho sdod byed yul spyi tshogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la'ang mi dmigs par sems kyi 'tsho ba 'jig rten phyi ma ru 'dzin pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gang yin yang nga tsho'i dngos yod kyi bsam blor mdzub ston bya byed bsam blo'i drag chas su mi rung la bsam blo'i drag chas su ngos 'dzin yang byed mi rung / ma gzhir nga tsho dngos yod kyi mi yin pa dang nga tshos rang nyid dang rgyab 'gal byas tshe de las lhag pa'i rgyab 'gal zhig gang du yod/ de gnyis kyis bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs skor gyi khyad rtags gleng ba'i dmigs yul yang deng phyin ‘‘snyigs dor bcud len ’’bya rgyu'i thad byed thabs gang zhig spyad rgyu de yin pas da ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi khyad rtags skor mu mthud gleng ba la/ spyir btang bstan pa phyi dar dus bod mi rang gi blo yis bskrun pa'i grub mtha' dar thub don ni khri srong gi dus cig car ba dang rim can pa'i dbar rtsod pa byung ba de'i shugs rkyen yin pa dang / gnyis su glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes lo ngo brgya lhag gi ring 'khral 'khrul gyi dus rabs shig byung ba dang / gsum du dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang rgya gar nas chos spel ba de tshor rag las yod pa red/ gal srid rgyu rkyen de gsum med pa yin na grub mtha'i 'dod lugs dar yod med ni brjod khag po red/ grub mtha'i 'dod lugs mang po zhig dar ba nas grub mtha' so so'i srol 'byed pa tshos rang rang gi lta sgom spyod gsum phyogs su hur brtson byas yod pa ma zad 58

grub mtha' phan tshun dbar du'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad rtags shig gces 'dzin byas yod pa ni/ bka' gdams pa dang dge lugs par mtshon na/ bka' gdams pa'i dus su yang srid ngos 'dzin byed srol dar med pa dang / dge lugs pas sprul sku'i lam lugs la gong bkur byed pa/ bka' gdams pa'i dus su dge 'dun gyi na bza' cha tshang zhig dar med pa dang / dge lugs pas gzan sham thabs sogs cha tshang ba'i na gza' gsar gtod byas pa/ bka' gdams pa'i dus su mtshan nyid kyi rnam dpyod dar med pa dang / dge bshes kyi slob rim sprod srol yang dar med/ dge lugs pa'i dus su gling bsre'i dam bca' dang rab 'byams pa'i dam bca'i rmang gzhi'i thog dka' bzhi ba dang dka' bcu ba/ tshogs rams pa dang lha rams pa/ rdo rams pa dang sngags rams pa'i slob rim lam lugs sogs 'phel rgyas byung yod pa lta bu red/yang sa dge bka' rnying grub mtha' bzhi por mtshon na'ang sa dge gnyis te mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs la rtsod mkhan tshos sgom la 'jog sgom dang dpyad sgom gnyis ka mkho bar khas len pa dang / bka' rnying gnyis kas 'jog sgom las dpyad sgom khas mi len/ sgom yul gnas ni ri khrod du 'dod la/ rgya gar ba tshos nags tshal ni sgom yul gtso bor byed pa de ni so so'i khor yug gi cha rkyen la bltos pa zhig red/ yang bka' brgyud pa phan tshun dbar du'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod mod/ de ni bdag gis bris pa'i 〈bod ljongs chos lugs kyi grub mtha' khag gi ngo sprod mdor bsdus 〉(rgya yig ) su gsal bas 'dir ma bkod/ 'di rnams ni bstan pa phyi dar ska/bas kyi grub mtha'i khyad rtags so/ /ka nang bstan rjes 'jug pa tsho'i srol rgyun gyi 'dod tshul ltar — 59

na bod kyi sprul sku thog ma ni karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa yin par brjod mod/ nga tshos 〈deb sngon 〉du bkod pa ltar shes rtogs byas tshe sprul sku dang po ni rje sgam po ba khu dbon gyi dngos slob tshul khrims dpal yin pa dang / tshul khrims dpal ni dbu ru stod du pha dge bsnyen 'byung song dang ma sgrol ma 'bum gnyis kyi sras su me pho byi (spyi lo 1156)'o ra 'khrungs shing dgung lo so bdun pa chu pho byi (spyi lo 1192)lor gshegs pa dang / de'i yang srid dge slong nam/ mkha' 'od ni chu mo glang (spyi lo 1193)lor 'khrungs pa red/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yang srid karma pak+ṣi ni spyi lo 1204lor 'khrungs pa yin pas de gnyis dbar lo bcu yas mas kyi snga phyi yod/ yang 〈deb sngon 〉rang du dge slong nam mkha' 'od kyi pha mas nam mkha' 'od nyid ‘‘lo brgyad dgu la chos rje dus gsum rma khyen pa la phul/ lo brgyad dgu phyag phyir 'bral meng du bsdad/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa dpag med mdzad/ byis pa'i spyod pa med par cho/sa gus kyi bla ma brten zhing gdams pa rtsad bcad pas rje shin tu mnyes par gyur ’’zhes bkod pa la brtag tshe gsal bar mngon nga sa sgrub byed gzhan 'tsho' ba'i ngal bar ma zhugs/ de ni bstan pa phyi dar las sprul sku'i khyad rtags yin pa dang / spyir yang srid lem lugs 'dir kha tsha dgos gtug gi dpyad pa zhig gtong dgos yod na de nyid gzhan du zhu bar bya'o/ /kha de bzhen slob dpon klu sgrub kyi 〈dbu ma rin chen phreng ba'i 〉lta ba'i shugs rkyen 'og khri srong lde btsan lta bu ni srid chos zung 'brel byed ma khan dang / tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan lta bu'i ser mo bas srid phyogs la the jus byas pa'i cha nas chos srid zung 'brel zhes pa'i rul 60

sungs kyi lam lugaru/ shig dar myong ba ma zad/ zas gos dang rol mo/dgon pa'i sgrig gzhi/ dge bshes gtong stangs dang rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod/ mdzes rig gi lta bar 'phrel 'gyur dang 'phel rgyas kyi khrod nas lta ba de gcig gyur byas pa/ zlos gar dang dbyangs kyi slor la/bstan pa snga dar dus sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar pa la rgyal rgyud mi tshang gis rgyab skyor byas pa/ phyi dar dus su dmangs khrod nas ma bskul dang len sgos dar spel byas pa sogs kyi khyad rtags kyang yod pa ni dus tshod kyi rkyen pas 'dir zhu bar mi bya'o zhes pa ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi khyad rtags so/ /ka nga la gtam gleng 'di da dung yang mjug sgril med pa'i tshor ba yong gi yod na'ang dus tshod kyi dbang gis 'di nas mjug mi sgril thabs med byung / gang ltar nged gnyis kyi dmigs yu' ni gnad don de dag gi gleng slong dang 'byung 'gyur la sngon dpag byas pa brgyud lo ngo brgya lhag gi gong du byung ba'i 'jar man gyi 'phags mi'i sher rtogs rib/ pa ba ne khre nang bzhin srol rgyun la dgag rgyag byed mkhan dang rin thang yod tshad la gsar du gdeng 'jog byed ma khan/ yang na ‘‘dkon mchos / gshegs song da ngas khyod la 'phags mi'i 'gro stangs bslab ’’ zer mkhan gyi rig pa'i dpa' bo zhig gi rig stobs kyis nged cag la 'tsho sdod kyi lta tshul gsar 'dzugs 'ong ba'i ched du yin pas de don klog pa pos bsam gzhigs yod pa 'tshal/ /mchan 'grel/dumi rma ngon sbas pa'i rig gnas/—'dzam gling dpal 'byor mnyam las dang 'phel rgyas tshogs pa'i lo re'i snyan sgron du/ shes bya dang po dang gnyis si la 61

phyogs bsdus rigs kyi rig gnas dang / shes bya gsum pa dang bzhi pa la mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas zhes btags yod pa dang / de la mi mngon sbas pa'i rig gnas ni mi mngon pa dang phyogs bsdus byed khag pa/ tshad 'jal gyi shes bya la zer ba dang / de ni gtso bo las/ len gyi shes bya'i skor red/dumar mang rin cus yus gtso sgrig byas pa'i 〈chos lugs kyi tshig mdzod chen mo 〉ru ‘mar gyi don ni ma rungs pa dang sdug rul yin pa dang / ma ni ni ma ni rang gi ming ste hā ra wi si'i skad du k+ṣe817skus1 zhes brjod ces dang / h+pha ran si sha wen sis (0stu9skubasakhubya)brtsams pa'i dz+nyom ni'i chos lugs krung gor dar ba'i brtag dpyad 〉du mar ma ni par sig gi skad 7klukrotsā'i01 sgra bsgyur te ‘mar gyi don ni gtso bo yin pas ma ni'i gtso bo la mar ma ni zhes brjod par bshad/dum ni'i chos lugasag (spubugrab—6—7'isasku51 )spyi lo'i dus rabs gsum pa'i nang ma nis srol btod pa dang / tsā ra tshe'u se khra'i chos lugs kyi rgyu gnyis smra ba'i lta tshul gyi rmang gzhi'i thog sangs rgyas chos lugs dang ci to'o chos lugs/shes bya'i chos lugs kyi bsam blo'i rgyu cha la brten te ma ni'i chos lugs grub pa dang / ma nis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos bdun ni ma ni'i chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung lugs yin par bshad/dutsā ra che'u se khra'i chos lugasakhri (skye25ba—2sku1spyo0sdusmo1 )gna' rabs par sig gi chos lugs shig yin pa dang / spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs bdun pa'i smad dang spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i stod kyi char dar ba zhig red/ gdod ma'i char phan tshun ltag 'gal gyi dge ba dang sdig pa'i dbye ba zhig gzhi grub yod par 'dod pas dge sdig rgyu gnyis smra ba'i lta tshul ni chos lus/sa 'di'i gzhung lugs kyi ma lag gal chen zhig yin par bshad/dushes bya'i chos lugs da (tha00bya 1 khu1 byasku)gna' rabs dzā ma'i dus dar ba'i gsang ba'i chos lugs shig yin pa dang / spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i nang mi rnams kyis mthong chen du gyur pa'i chos lugs shig kyang red/ chos lugs 'di'i 'dod tshul ltar na dngos po'i 'jig rten thog myo/ra bskrun mkhan ni bla med kyi lha 62

gang de ma yin par lha gang de las cung tsam dman pa'i bzo rtsal mkhas pa'i lha zhig gis bskrun pa dang / bla med kyi lha gang de'i ngo bo ni rnam rig dang tshe srog 'od zer yin par brjod/me bstan bcos bdunag ma ni'i chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung lugs mtshon byed yin pa dang / ma ni'i yi ge la brten te bris pa dang tun hong nas thon par bshad/ 〈thu'u bkan grub mtha' 〉ru bon po'i skor brjod pa'i dus bon gyi lta sgom spyod gsum dang 'phrin las/ bskyed rdzogs kyi 'bras bu smin byed du bstan bcos drug drangs yod pa ni ma ni'i bstan bcos bdun gyi ming dang 'dra mtshungs yin pa dang / nga tshos brjod don la brtag dpyad byed skabs bstan bcos kyi mtshan byang 'dra ba kho na tsam ma yin par nang don thad kyang 'dra mtshungs mang po yod pas dpyad par 'tshal/rjorwas ningadzi (zlesbyo'i 638da 713)thang rgyal rabs kyi grwa btsun te bsam gtan mkhan po 'am cig car ba'i srol 'byed pa yin la/ ne'u paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa smon lam blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 〈sngon gyi gtam me tog phreng ba 〉zhes bya ba ru/ha shang dhe ba zhes bkod yod pa ni twos ning min nam snyam ste dhe ba'i don tshur bsgyur tshe shes rab gsal dang shes rab thar yin pa dang / tun hong nas thon pa'i 〈chos lugs skor gyi bsgyur yig dum bu 'ga' 〉zhes bya ba ru mkhan po shes rab thar zhes bris yod pa'ang rwas ning yin snyam pas brtagarjo mkhan po ni ho shen shig 'di ni sung rgyal rabs kyi grwa btsun te bsam gtan mkhan po ༵tsheg (1002da 1069)yin snyam pas brtag skabs 'di'i shen shi ni rgya yig gi kho'i(/ ta zhes pa'i sgra bsgyur yin pa ljoridra/du mkhan po 'gwa lun shen shing thang rgyal rabs kyi grwa btsun te bsam gtan mkhan po r+sārnye.oṃ(771da 854)yin snyam pas brtag⑩ mkhan po glu cu shen shig thang rgyal rabs kyi grwa btsun te bsam gtan mkhan po oṃ7(840da 901)dang r+sā7(651da 739)gang yin cha ma 'tshal/tun hong nas thon pa'i 〈chos lugs skor gyi bsgyur yig dum bu 'ga' 〉zhes bya ba 63

ru spyir btang ming gi snga gzhug brjes yod na'ang blu cu'i ming ni mgo rnga brjes med pa 'dra/ gal srid mgo rnga brjes yod tshe cu bla zer ba zhig da lam kho bos rnyed ma thub/⑪mkhan po kin hran shen shig thang rgyal rabs kyi sngags pa saulko(752—805)min nam snyam pas brtag⑥ mkhan po de'u lim shin ging thang rgyal rabs kyi grwa btsun wāṣ+ṭha1(507da 581)e yin snyam pas brtag⑫rig stobs dpala'aphyorag da lta'i char gsar du dar bzhin pa'i rig sgo zhig yin pa dang / rig stobs dpal 'byor smra ba'i mkhas dbang tshos brjod don ltar na rig sgo 'di'i 'thus tshang gi ma lag nyid ni spyi lo 2030yas mas su grub nges par bshad/ de la rig stobs dpal 'byor ni rig stobs rmang gzhir byas pa'i dpal 'byor gyi bsdus ming ste nga tshos srol rgyun du brjod pa'i rig stobs dang mi 'dra ba ni tha snyad der sgra yang 'jug gi rang bzhin ldan pa ste (1)rig stobs ni rig stobs ci zhig yin pa dang / (2)rig stobs ni sa/nga zhig gi rig stobs yin pa/ (3)gang 'dra byas te gsar gtod byed dgos pa shes pa'i rig stobs dang / (4)rig stobs ni gang gi rig stobs yin pa ste de ni do dam skor gyi rig stobs dang nus pa la bya'o/ / mdor na/ rig stobs dpal 'byor zhes pa'i rig stobs kyi nang du nga tshos nam rgyun gleng bzhin pa'i shes bya dang nus pa zung du 'dus pa dang / gsum du tshan rig gi khyab khongs su rang byung tshan rig dang spyi tshogs tshan rig 'dus pa mtshon yod/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/1 〈rgya nag chos 'byung 〉mgon ngo skyabs kyis brtsams/ si khron mi rigs dpe skru na khang / 1983lo'i zla 4par/2 〈bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag lnga 〉 (gangs can rig mdzod dpe tshogs )bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / 1990lo'i zla 4par/64

3 〈gsang sngags snga 'gyur bod du rtsod pa snga phyir byung ba rnams kyi lan du brjod pa nges pa don gyi 'brug sgra〉/ blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams/ zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1997lo'i zla 10par/4 〈tun hong nas thon pa'i gna' bo'i bod yig shog dril〉/ bsod namasaskyid dang dbang rgyal gyis phyogs sgrig dang 'grel bshad byas/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1983lo'i zla 8par/ 5 〈bod kyi sher rtogs rig pa'i ris/sa shes〉/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1996lo'i zla 7par/6 dz+nyorig stobs nga/pal 'byor〉/ (rgya yig )wu'u ci sung gis brtsams/pe cin tshan rig lag rtsal dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 3par/7 〈bdag gi nang bstan shes rig gi lta tshul gyi 'phros〉/ (rgya yig )'jar pan pa ad khe rda rde sa khus brtsams/ si khron mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /1998lo'i zla 4par/8 〈bdag gi then thad (zlod+dha)kyi lta tshul〉/ (rgya yig )'jar pan pa ad khe rda rde sa khus brtsams/ si khron mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / 1999lo'i zla 3par/9 〈rig stobs dpal 'byor la do khur byed pa〉/ (rgya yig )chin yan gyis brtsams/ then cin mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 9par/10 dz+nyom ni'i chos lugs krung gor dar ba'i brtag dpyad〉/ (rgya yig )h+pha ren si'i sha wen sis brtsams/ tshong don par khang dpe skrun khang / min go lo nyer drug pa'i zla 6par/11 〈thu'u bkan grub mtha'〉/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi lcags par ma/12 〈bon gyi gnas ri'i dkar chag〉 (gangs can rig mdzod dpe tshogs )bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang gi lcags par ma/13 〈bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las mdo btus pa bzhugs so〉/ rgyal 65

po khri srong lde btsan gyis brtsams/ dz+nyobastan 'gyur 〉sna tshogs/ (co pa )sde dge'i shing par ma/ (shongs grangs 104la gzigs )14 〈chos lugs kyi tshig mdzod chen mo〉/ (rgya yig )rin cus yus gtso sgrig byas/ hrang he'i tshig mdzod dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 8par/15 〈bod ljongs kyi tshan rtsal byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus〉/ (rgya yig )zhu krin yus gtso sgrig byas pa/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / 1995lo'i 10par/16 〈ga 'dra zhig la sher rtogs rig pa zer 〉 (rgya yig )rga si this brtsams/ tshong don par khang dpe skrun khang / 1996lo'i zla 3par/14 〈rig stobs dpal 'byor 〉(rgya yig )wu'u ci sung gis brtsams pe cin tshan rig lag rtsal dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 3par/15 〈sa gzhi ril mor gtam du gleng ba 〉(rgya yig )hod yong phin bcas kyis brtsams/ deng rabs 'jig rten dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 10par/16 〈sna tshogs gangs ri'i khrod kyi bsam gzhigs 〉pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1994lo'i zla 8par/17 〈bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed dang tha snyad rig gnas lnga'i rabyung tshul 〉mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang 'dar stod dgra 'dul dbang pos brtsams/bod ljongs dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / 1988lo'i zla 2par/18 〈zur mang gi 'jig rten 〉(rgya yig )a ri ba kyan mu sis brtsams/tshong don par khang dpe skrun khang / 1999lo'i zla 3par/19 〈'tsho sdod sher rtogs rig pa 〉(rgya yig )a ri ba lor tun dang thu sho gnyis kyis brtsams/ ho nan mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / 1988lo'i zla 4par/20 〈thengs bzhi pa'i kha phyogs skor mtshams 〉(rgya yig )a ri ba si thu ru'u su dang hod wer gnyis kyis brtsams// mtsho rlabs par ris sgyu rtsal dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 9par/21 〈rang gis rang nyid skyob pa 〉(rgya yig)dbyin ji ba si le h+phu had le 66

phus brtsams/ pe cin yan hran dpe skrun khang / 1999lo'i zla 7par/22 〈las dbang gtan la phab pa'i gdam nga 〉(rgya yig)a ri ba la tshe los brtsams/ gsum sbre9shaṃ dpe skrun khang / 1997lo'i zla 4par/23 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉mkhas pa lde'us brtsams/ bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / 1987lo'i zla 6par/24 〈lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 〉zhol par ma/25 〈bai ro'i rnam thar 'dra 'bag chen mo 〉g.yu sgra snying po sogs kyis brtsams/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1995lo'i zla 11par/26 〈thang rgyal rabs lnga'i bsam gtan sde pa'i lo rgyus 〉(rgya yig)yāng tsun wun gyis brtsams/ krung go spyi tshogs tshan rig dpe skrun khang / 1999lo'i zla 5par/27 〈bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/〉dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi brtsams/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1983lo'i zla 1por/28 〈rig stobs/ dpal 'byor/ 'tsho sdod/〉(rgya yig )wang khreng ye sogs kyis sgrig krung go 'dzugs skrun rgyu chas bzo las dpe skrun khang /1998lo'i zla 8par/29 〈'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i gsung rtsom gces sgrig〉'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang pos brtsams/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /1989lo'i zla 3par/30 〈gsang sngags snga 'gyur la bod du rtsod pa snga phyir byung ba rnams kyi lan du brjod pa nges pa don gyi 'brug sgra 〉blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1998lo'i zla 4par/31 〈bstan 'gyur dkar chag〉32 〈dkar chag lngan dkar ma/〉33 〈deb sngon/〉34 〈g.yung drung bon gyi bka' 'gyur dkar chag〉rnamaru/ so//67

༄khya/ / bod kyi deng rabs sher rtogs rig pa'i ma lag gsar 'dzugs skor gyi dpyad gleng /—dusarabs21par 'jug pa'i tshan rig dang lag rtsal/ sher rtogasarig pa/ka nga tsho 'jig rten nas 'gro dus 'jig rten thams cad brjed de thal/ nga tsho 'jig rten nas 'ong dus 'jig rten thams cad rgyus med du mthong / gzhan yang nga tsho 'tsho sdod byed dus gsar pa gsar pa'i 'du shes bskyed de rnying pa rnying par goms par byed/ 'on te shes pa yi 'gul skyod phra mo 'dir sher rtogs rig pa ba tshos bzhag tu med pa'i chos nyid du ngos 'dzin byed kyang / deng rabs rdzas lugs rig pas bsngog 'ango/na byas pa ltar na shes pa'i 'gul bskyod kyi lkog gyur go rim der rdzas rgyun sa bon (zlo khwa ) du 'bod/ de lta yin rung deng rabs rdzas lugs rig pas rdzas rgyun sa bon gyi lta tshul nyid skye ba snga phyi'i mtshams 'dzin byed kyi shes pa snga phyi'i rgyun de'i thog nas mi 'jog par dngos yod bden grub kyi cha ste pha yi rdzas rgyun rigs 'ga' so so'i bu yi thog ji bzhin nyar tshags byas pa'i 'bras bu'i thog ma/sa 'jog pas mi'i rigs kyis da dung yang gnad don 'dir 'grel baya/da rgyag ma thub par ya mtshan lkog gyur gyi gnas su lus yod pa red/ sa/nad don 'di'i 68

rigs la khyed kyis lta tshul gang 'dra 'dzin gyi yod dam/kha dgongs pa ma tshom lags/ spyir zab mo'i gnad don skor la rtog 'jug dang bsam gzhigs bya rgyur 'dun pa med pa'i rkyen gyis khyed kyi dri ba der dris lan gsab rgyu gang yang med/ tshul ldan shes rig gi bshul lam ring mo brgyud pa'i khrod du nga tshor srol rgyun zhig yod pa ni mi'i rigs kyi rnam par shes pa'i spyod yul las brgal ba'i lkog gyur gyi cha der dpyad zhib bya rgyu de yin la lo rgyus kyi khyab khongs su gyur pa'i shes rig de'i khrod du ngas srol rgyun de nyid yang dag min par ra sprod byed mi thub/ 'on kyang dus rabs gnyiru/ kyi 'brel mtshamase dang lhag don 'phrin gsar rig gnas kyis sa gzhi ril mo'i khyon kun tu tshul ldan shes rig gi le'u gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir ngas brjod btub pa ni nga tsho'i srol rgyun der spyi tshogs dar rgyas su gtong ba'i sgul shugs kyi nus pa de tsam med pa dang / da lta'i char nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang dbye mtshams shin tu ring ba ni srol rgyun la zhen drags pa dang / nam ya nga srol rgyun gyi lkog tu 'greng ste sdod drags pa des deng gi char nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs hri' por skye stobs kyi dpal yon de tsam rgyas mi thub pa dang / sa gzhi ril mo'i thog nas phyir bud 'dod kyi 'du shes ngan pa'i rmang gzhi zhig bting yod pa ma zad shes rig gi ma lag hril por gsar sbol lam gsar skrun byed pa'i nus shugs med par gyur pa de red/ der brten nga'i re bar nged gnyis kyi gleng mol gyi rmang gzhi'ang sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul thog gzhi bcol tshe legs par sems la/ de ni sher rtogs rig pa ni dus rabs la stobs shugs rgyas byed dang / dus rabs kyi ded dpon/ mi'i rigs kyi shes 69

rab kyi snying bcud/ dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyur mtshon byedatshobacas yin pas red/ des na nga tshos sher rtogs rig pa de nyid dngos yod kyi bkag rgyar kha gtad gcog byed kyi yo byad byas te spyi tshogs nyid 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i phyogs su bsam gzhigs bgyis tshe mi legs sam/ka gnad don ni gnad don rang red/ 'jig rten rang nyid gnad don gyi bdag po yin pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya dngos re re gnad don ma yin pa ga la srid/ gnad don rang la mtshon na mngon lkog gi dbye ba med mod/ mi'i 'du shes kyis de ltar bzhag pa yin pas nga tshos shes rtogs thub pa ni mi'i 'du shes kyi tshad yod rang bzhin dang zhan/ cha de nyid red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas brjod na sa gzhi ril mo nyid sna mang zur mang gi gnad don gyi byed po zhig yin pa dang 'dzam gling hril po 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi sgul shugs gtso bo'ang phyogs so so nas kha gtad gcog thub pa byung ba'i dbang gis yin pa las kher rkyang gi gnad don dang kher rkyang gi bsam blo/ kher rkyang gi rig gnas/kher rkyang gi lta tshul zhig gi 'bras bu ga la yin/ 'on te nga rang tshor gnad don re re'i rtog 'jug pa shin tu dkon pas gnad don kha shas ni myur bar thag gcod dgos pa'i gnad don yin pa yang da dung thag gcod ma nus par rgya yan du lus yod par brten nga tshor rigs gcig mkhas can dang ched gnyer rang bzhin can gyi zhib 'jug pa nyung drags pa'ang de las shes thub/ nga la mtshon na zab mo'i gnad don skor la mno sems bya rgyur dga' ba ma zad/ kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi dngos yod gnad don skor la dris lan 'tshol rgyur yang shin tu dga' po yod/yin yang sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul sna tshogs la rgyus mnga' byed 'dod 70

med pa'i mi rigs shig la sher rtogs rig pa nyid bsam blo'i yo byad du spyad de gnad don gyi lta tshul gleng slong byas pa yin na gong bkur dang dang len e byed dam/kha mi'i rigs kyis sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul dang phan nus skor la the tshom byed pa ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid cig red/ dngos po gang yin rung bzang ngan gyi cha re yod pas sher rtogs rig pa'ang dngos po'i khyab khongs kyi chos nyid de las ga la brgal thub/ 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus kyi khrod du sher rtogs rig pas gtan tshigs kyi ched du gtan tshigs la gzhigs rtsod dang spyi tshogs kyi gnad don la do snang gtan nas ma byas pa des mi rnams la ra sprod byung ba ni sher rtogs rig pa'i gnyom chung nus med kyi snang tshul des bskrun pa de red/ des na nga rang tshos spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i bkag rgya'i rigs su gyur pa'i snang tshul de'i rigs yo bsrang byas te spyod go chod pa'i sher rtogs rig pa zhig la mno sems byas pa yin na der gong bkur dang dang len mi byed pa ga la srid/ gang yin zhe na/ ma gzhir mi rnams kyang 'tsho sdod dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos shing 'tsho sdod kyi go rim khrod du shes rab spyod mi dgos pa'i yul zhig dang dus shig med pas red/ dper na tshags sha ni tsha grang btang snyoms can zhig yin pas nga tshos zos kyang pho bas 'ju bde ba dang gzugs por 'phrod po yod/ lug sha ni tsha ba'i rigs yin pas mkhris pa la gnod shas che/ phag sha ni bsil ba'i rang bzhin can yin yang phag pa'i rang bzhin gti mug che bas na tsha'i 'byung rkyen du 'gyur 'gro ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan ni shes rab kyis gtan 'bebs byed dgos pa des 'thus/71

ka 'dzam gling hril po'i shes rig gi 'phel phyogs la bsam blo btang thub na de lta rang red/ nga tsho nam yang srol rgyun sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul gyi lkog tu yib ste sdod pa'ang 'jig rten dngos yod kyi 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang mi mthun pas rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul la bsgyur bcos dang dag ther bya rgyu ni dus rabs kyi 'du shes dang dgoṭasdo mkho rang red/ 'o na nged cag gi rig gnas bsam blo'i rmang sa/zhi'am ma lag de nyid gang ltar phyogs gang nas 'dzugs gnyer byas na legs sam/kha thog mar nga tshos nges par rtogs dgos pa ni mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gsang ba'i man ngag de red/ mi'i rigs kyi gdod ma'i snang tshul ni rang byung khams kyis bskrun pa 'i 'phel 'gyur gyi 'bras bu zhig yin mod/ mi'i rigs rang la shes rab kyi stobs shugs rnyed pa nas bzung rang gi shes rab kyi nus pa spyad de mi rang nyid 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu ni rtsa don ldog med cig tu gyur yod/ rnam pa de ni mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi phyogs so sor mthong rgyu yod par brten/ nga tshos lo rgyus zer ba yang mi'i rigs kyi grub 'bras dang pham nyes/ 'gal rkyen/ 'thab rtsod dang rgyal kha'i zin tho'am 'grel bshad cig tu ngos 'dzin byas chog la/ nga tshos lo rgyus dus rabs kyi rnam pa der sdom tshig bzos pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog skabs babs kyi dngos yod lo rgyus nyid 'phel rgyas gtong dgos pa'ang smos ma dgos pa'i gtan tshigs shig red/ des na 'dir srong btsan sgam po'i ring yi ge yod med la ma ltos par bod kyi mkhas pa tshos ‘‘srong btsan sgam po'i ring yi ge gsar bzo mdzad ’’ces pa'i spyi don la gzhigs tshe yi ge gsar bzo mdzad pa'am 72

rig gnas bsam blo gang zhig gsar bskrun byed pa ni skabs de dus kyi dngos yod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pa dang / krung go'i deng rabs kyi mar le ring lugs pa blo mthun zha'o phing gis rgyal yongs kyi dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon gnyis phan tshun 'gal zla med pa'am phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i slad ‘‘krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs ’’zhes pa nyid spyi tshogs hril po khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du bkod de rtsa don de nyid legs 'grub dang mngon 'gyur 'ong phyir khong gis ‘‘bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i mdun du mi su zhig yin rung nor 'khrul 'byung chog kyang nor 'khrul de nges par yo bsrang byed dgos ’ zhes dang ‘‘zhi mi dkar nag gang yin rung tsi tsi gsod thub pa yin na 'grig yod pa red ’’ces sgul shugs rang bzhin ldan pa'i sdom tshig cig gsungs yod pa des rang rgyal gyi dngos yod spyi tshogs la gnam sa bla 'og brje ba lta bu'i 'pho 'gyur zhig byung bar byas yod pa ni da lta'i char nga tshor mig mthong lag zin du gyur yod pas 'thus/ tshul de bzhin nga tshos kyang bod kyi rig gnas kyis dngos yod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong ba la nus pa 'don thub pa'i ched ‘‘srol rgyun dang deng rabs can ’’zhes dang / ‘‘deng rabs bod kyi shes rig’’ ‘‘spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i bod kyi rig gnas /’’yang na ‘‘tshan rig gi lam du skyod pa'i bod kyi deng rabs shes rig ’’zer ba'i rtsa don zhig sngo na 'gro'i cha rkyen du bkod de snang tshul de'i 'og rig gnas kyi lta tshul hril por zhib bsher byas pa yin na sa/zhi nas dngos yod kyi gson shugs dang nus stobs che ba'i rig gnas bsam blo'i ma 73

lag cig rnyed thub rgyu red snyam/ka nga rang khyed kyi gnad don gyi gleng phyogs dang lta tshul gyi 'jog lugs der shin tu mos mthun yod/ mi'i rigs shes rab gsar brje can du zhugs pa'i 'du 'god kyi 'go brtsams pa nas bzung skye stobaṭasdo kyi shes rab ldan pa gang zhig gis kyang gsar gtod kyi blo yul las 'gongs pa'i rgyu nor gsar brje chen po zhig dar yod pa dang / de ni lag rtsal gsar brje'am bzo las gsar brje yi 'bras bu rma med cig red/ 'on kyang rang re'i srol rgyun shes rig nyid gsar brje'i snang tshul de las byol ba'am yang na rnam pa der do snang gang yang mi byed pa de ni lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod du rang nyid 'phro brlag gtong 'dod pa'i 'du shes kyi gtan tshigs shig yin pa ra sprod byung yod/ des ma tshad da dung dbul phyug gi he bag chen po zhig bskrun yod pa dang / lus kyis rtsol sgrub mang po zhig byed dgos pa'i khar 'tsho bcud kyis mi ldeng bar tshe srog gi yun yang thung du 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyun srol zhig chags yod/ spyir bshad na 'jig rten 'tsho sdod kyi drang bden ni go sla zhing mdor bsdus pa ste bzo las can ni dbul po'i re 'bras nyag gcig red/re 'bras de nyid mngon 'gyur byed pa la nga tshor+sā nges par du bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa ni sngar yod kyi rig gnas 'du shes sam ma lag de red/ ma lag der bcos bsgyur byed pa'i ched ‘‘srol rgyun dang deng rabs can ’’zhes pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen de'i 'og tu srol rgyun gyi 'du shes la zhib bsher dang deng rabs 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas la zhib bsher dang deng rabs 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug byas te dngos yod kyi spyi tshogs dar rgyas yong ba'i thad ram 'degs byed par nus pa 'don 74

thub pa'i rig gnas kyi 'du shes can dang lta tshul can/ shes rab can gyi ma lag gi rmang gzhi zhig 'ding thub pa yin na de ni nga tsho'i mdun lam red snyam zhing / rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi de 'dra ni rig gnas kyi rnam grangs dang rig sgo so so nas 'dzugs dgos pa zhig red/ mdor na nga tshos gsar du bsam zhib byed dgos pa'i bod kyi deng rabs shes rig gi ma lag ni tshan rig gi lam du bskyod par byed pa'i shes ri ga cig yin dgos pa las dus rabs kyi tshul ldan shes rig dang dbye mtshams shin tu ring ba'i srol rgyun gyi 'du shes shig min par 'dod la/ deng phyin nga tshos nges par du bgrod dgos pa'i lam kha'ang srol rgyun gyi 'du shes shig min par 'dod la/ deng phyin nga tshos nges par du bgrod dgos pa'i lam kha'ang srol rgyun gyi 'du shes khod snang ba'i rig gnas la snyigs dor bcud len dang deng rabs kyi tshul ldan shes rig gam tshan rtsal gyi grub 'bras legs shos rnams bsdu len gang thub byed dgos pa de yin par nges/kha rig gnas dang rig gnas kyi 'jig rten ni mi nyid gzhi grub pa'i rtsa ba'i rnam pa'am shes pa'i rten gzhi yin zhing / lo rgyus kyis mi rigs so sor ma/kho 'don byas pa ni do mnyam dang 'dra gshib kyi go skabs de red/ der ma zad spyi tshogs dang rig gnas la mtshon na rang byung khams ltar rgyu 'bras kyi gtan srol chos nyid dang mtshams pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba ni mi'i rigs gnas bcas pa'i sa gzhi ril mo'i thog ha cang dpe mi srid pa'i chos nyid cig yin/ gang yin zhe na spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas khrod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas ni rig gnas rang nyid la rag las pa zhig min par de'i byed po mi'i gsar gtod kyi skul 75

'ded nus shugs la rag las yod pa'i phyir/ gnas tshul de ni nga tshos spyi tshogs rig gnas 'phel ba'i lo rgyur+sā kyi rgyab ljongs la bsam ga'igs byas tshe shin tu gsal bas 'dir rgyas par gleng dgos pa'i ngal ba ma mchis/ 'jig tswan tshul ldan shes rig gi lo rgyus kyi lam bu'i kro/ da du sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul mi/ chos lus/sa kyi 'du shes las phyis su byung ba zhig yin pa dang de ni rgyu mtshan gzhan gang yang min par mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo dang shes rab kyi 'phel rgyas shig mtshon bzhin yod pa red/bod mi tshos lo rgyus kyi 'phel rgyas ring mo zhig gi khrod rig gnas dang bsam blo/ dngos yod lo rgyus bcas gsum gzhi gcig tu ngos 'dzin byas te gleng ba'i srol la gzhigs tshe kho tshor thun mong ma yin pa 'i 'tsho sdod kyi stobs shugs shig yod par mngon yang 'phrin gsar gyi dus rabs 'dir kho tshor bsam blo zhig la bsnyon 'byin dang rtsod spongs/gdeng 'jog dang gdam nga byed pa'i spobs pa gang yang med par bsam blo zhig gi bran g.yog tu gyur yod pa dang bsam blo de'i bsam blor yang snying brjod byas phyug cing nges par dang len byed dgos pa'i cha ji yod kyi gnas tshul der skabs re kho tshos gsang ba lkog gyur gyi lha sgrung gi gtam rgyud cig gis dril bsgrags byed pa dang / skabs rer rig stobs zad pa'i rnam pa dang brlan gsher gyi yid ches shig gis 'grel bshad byed/ de'i mjug 'bras ni kho tsho bsam blo dang bral ba'i bsam blo bar gyur yod pa ma zad 'tsho sdod gnad don gyi mdun du gnyom chung nus med pa dang / 'byor med 'phyor sprang ba'i 'du shes can du gyur yod pa red/ mdor na ngas gong du gleng ba'i bsam blo'i khyab khongs kyi zhan cha'i 'du shes kyi dpe mtshon de dag gis bsgrubs pa ltar deng phyin 76

sngar yod kyi bsam blo der ngos 'dzin dang shes rtogs yang dag byas te bsam blo der mgo mi 'thoms pa byed dgos pa ma zad/ bsam blo de nyid dus rabs dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas gtong ba dang dus rabs kyis gsar bskrun byas pa'i tshul ldan shes rig gi grub 'bras yod tshad la mthong chen byed dgos/ gnad don de ni mi'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs la rag las pa zhig yin pas thog mar nga tshos bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'ang mi'i shes rab kyi nus pa de red/ sher rtogs rig pa ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rab kyi chu tshad mtho shos de nyid mtshon byed kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yin par bsam blo ba tshos brjod pa ltar rang mi rigs kyi bsam blo der bsgyur bcos 'ong ba'i phyir 'dir yang sher rtogs rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang tshan rtsal gyi shes bya'i cha nas gtam gleng byas na ga 'dra 'dug gam/ka khyed kyi brjod pa ltar ngas kyang de ltar sems/ spyir yang lo rgyus ni pham nyes par mtshon na ya nga ba'i drag chas shis/ yin pas/ nga tshos da dung yang nged cag rjes lus thebs byed kyi rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen nam srol rgyun gyi 'du shes der bsgyur bcos ma byas pa yin na phyis 'byung gi lo rgyus khrod du pham nyes myong mkhan ni nga tsho rang yin pa dang / ‘‘gnad don nyid gnad don du mthong yang ma mthong ba'i 'du shes spyad de btang snyoms su 'jog mkhan ’’ zhes pa ni nga tsho'i nag nyes yin nges red/mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi lam bu'i khrod du bsgyur bcos dang gsar gtod kyi 'du shes dang bral ba'i dus rabs shig byung med 'a /gal srid bsgyur bcos kyi 'du shes dang bral ba yin na mi'i rigs la da/ lta'i tshukhasga ldan shes rig gi 'bras bu 'di dag kyang 'byung mi srid 7༵ ma

zad/ mi'i rigs dmu rgod kyi gzugs dbyibs dang bsam blo'i lta tshul de'i 'og 'tsho bzhin pa thag gis chod/ bod mi rigs kyi ngos nas bshad na'ang spyi lo'i dus rabs drug bdun gyi yas mas su ri klung grong khyer du bsgyur ba dang / zhing la chu 'dren pa/ thong gshol bzos te zhing rmo ba la sogs kyis mtshon pa'i gsar gtod dang 'du shes kyi bcos bsgyur de dag byung thub med pa yin na bod mi rigs nyid mi rigs su grub yod min dang bod mi rigs zhes pa'i da lta'i gdags gzhi 'di ya thog tu yod med brjod dka' bar gyur/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsam tshe mi'i rigs kyi 'phel rgyas dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas zhes pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi go dor+ghaṃ dngormo ni gsar gtod kyi rmedu sherme dang bsgyur bcos kyi 'bras bu la brjod pa yin na nga tshos gtsigs chen byed dgos pa'i gnad don yang 'di nyid yin/ spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i snga gzhug tu mi'i rigs kyis rang nyid 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi rtsa ba'i sgul shugs der rig gnas dang bsam blo/ lo rgyus zhes pa'i gdags gzhi spyad yod kyang 'phel rgyas kyi 'pho 'gyur khrod du gdags gzhi der 'gyur ldog che ru btang bar brten dus rabs bco lnga pa nas 'go brtsams te ‘‘mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong byed kyi nus shugs der tshan rig dang lag rtsal sher rtogs rig pa mi’zhes spyi mtshan pa'i rig gnas kyi gdags gzhi spyad yod pa ma zad/ shes rab kyi ngos 'dzin gsar pa zhig gsar sbol byas pa des gzhi nas mi'i rigs rang nyid kyi 'dod pa skong ba'i slad shes rab kyi 'jigs nyen dang bsdongs pa las bkrol bar byas te mi'i rigs rang nyid kyi phugs bsam mngon 'gyur phyogs su dbye mtshams nye ru 'gro bzhin yod pa red/78

bod mi rigs la rang gnas nas 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rig gnas ni 'tsho sdod kyi rmang gzhir gyur pa'i zhing las rig gnas dang phyugs las rig gnas las gzhan baXrda matwon dwang bzhin can gyi rig gnas shig yod par bdag la sgrub byed yang dag 'dren rgyu med la rig gnas lo rgyus khrod nyar tshags byas pa'i bon gyi shes rig dang nang bstan shes rig la mtshon na gsar gtod dang bsgyur bcos kyi skul 'ded 'og byung ba'i tshan rig dang lag rtsal/ sher rtogs rig pa zhes pa'i rig gnas kyi lta tshul la rtog 'jug byas pa'i gtan tshigs shig lo rgyus kyi glegs bu'i ngor 'tshol dka' bar snang / 'di ni kho bo'i dpyad rtsom zhig gi nang bod kyi de sngon gyi sher rtogs rig pa'i gdags gzhi der ‘‘sher rtogs rig pa phyed ka dang yang na nga tshor yod pa ni sher rtogs rig pa phyed ka de red ’’ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yin/ dngos gnas brjod na'ang nged cag la yod pa'i sher rtogs rig pa des bsam pa'i tshul ldan shes rig cig dar rgyas slad rang nus rtsal sprugs byas yod pa las dngos stobs kyi tshul ldan shes rig gam tshan rtsal gyi 'jig rten shes rab der do snang gang yang byas med par brten gnad don de ni mi rigs dang mi rigs dbar dang sher rtogs rig pa dang sher rtogs rig pa'i dbar/ lta tshul dang lta tshul dbar rjes lus dang sngon thon gyi te bag skrun byed kyi rtsa ba'i gnas lugs su grub yod pa red/kha do na ngo mar yang de lta rang red/ sngon thon mi rigs dang nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par 'byed byed dang /nub phyogs sher rtogs rig pa dang nang bstan shes rig dbar gyi he bag 'byed byed kyi tshad gzhi nyag gcig kyang khyed kyis gong dra smos pa'i gtan 79

tshigs de red/ nga tshos zhib tu dpyad gzhigs byas tshe gnad don 'di'i 'byung khungs ni nga tshos bsam blo dang dngos po gnyis dbar gyi rtsod sgrub kyi lta tshul te dngos po'i dpal yon gyis bsam pa'i dpal yon 'phel rgyas gtong ba dang bsam pa'i dpal yon gyis dngos po'i dpal yon gsar skrun byed pa'i 'brel ba de nyid yang dag par thag gcod byed ma thub pa'i 'bras bu dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na rje blo bzang grags pa'i rten 'brel dgongs pa'i dngos yod rang bzhin skor la nges rtogs byed ma nus pas lan yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis deng rabs bod kyi sher rtogs rig pas nges par du bsgrub dgos pa'i las 'gan 'gangs chen zhig ni rig gnas bsam blo'i lta tshul dang des bskrun pa'i 'bras bu'i thad kyi he bag mtha' dag la ngos 'dzin gsal po byas te kha gsab yong bar 'bad pa byed dgos/ de'ang lo rgyus sngon gyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas sngon gyi rig gnas/ rdo chas gsar rnying gi dus rabs nas spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dbar la bod mi rigs kyi rang gi shes rab kyis gsar skrun byas pa'i thon skyed nus shugs kyi 'bras bu'i cha ji yod 'jig rten tshul ldan shes rig gi lo rgyus ngor 'god thub yod med sogs ni 'dir gleng 'dod kyang dgos pa gang yang med/ rgyu mtshan ni lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim de'i khrod du mi'i rigs kyis chos lugs kyi 'du shes der brten te 'tsho sdod dang rin thang bskrun par hur brtson byas yod pa dang gcig gnyis su dus rabs bco lnga pa'i sngon du tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i mgyogs tshad de dus rabs bco lnga pa'i rjes su tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i 'gros dang bsdur tshe shin tu 'gor po yin pas red/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dus mjug nas tshan rig sher 80

rtogs rig pa ba pa khon rjodang / mu rad/du rdad kha tshi dhil sogs pas mi sger ring lugs pa'i re 'dun la rgyab skyor dang shugs snon 'ong ba'i phyir chos tshogs kyi zil dbang der rgol lan sprad de spyi tshogs 'du shes dang dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul gnyis so sor phye ste mi rnams kyi rang byung rgyun shes mthor 'degs dang 'phrul chas sgrig sbyor gsar gtod byas pa des gzhi nas nub phyogs kyi mi'i bsam blo dang lhag par nye rabs kyi mi'i rigs gna' rabs pa'i brdol chos kyi lta tshul dang byusarabyās dkyil ma'i 'khral 'khrul dang smug klong / mun nag lkog gyur gyi bsam blo'i dbang shugs las bkrol bar byas te dngos po'i dpal yon 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i lam kha gsar pa zhig tu slebs par bas byas yod pa red/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i mjug dang dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dus 'go ni bod rang la mtshon na dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul gsar sa/tod dang yang na rang gis blo ngor bsgrubs zin pa'i grub mtha'i lta ba gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i rigs pa'i mtho rlabs kyi mjug bsgril na'ang spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes ring du dor cing dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul la dad mos byed pa'i snang tshul nyid shugs che ru phyin yod pa red/ sa gzhi ril mo'i phang bar rang so so'i stobs kyis 'tsho bzhin pa'i mi rigs gzhan rnams rang rig shes pa'i dran pa brnyes par byas te dngos po'i dpal yon gsar sbol byed pa'i 'du 'god khrod tsha tsha 'ur 'ur byed pa'i skabs der nga tsho ste bod mi rigs nyid ni srol rgyun gyi 'du shes de'i phyir bskyar du gdod ma'i dus su snyeg 'dod zhen 'ching gi ngang tshul zhig byung ba 'di 'dra ni 'jig rten gyi sher rtos/sa rig pa 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus khrod du ha cang yid skyo 81

ba'i rnam pa zhig yin par ma zad mi rigs gang der mtshon na'ang god chag chen po zhig red/ der thal/ kho bos 〈'jig rten sher rtogs rig pa'i shes rab 〉kyi dpe deb rtsom 'bri byed pa'i dus dmigs su rnyed pa'i drang bden zhig ni 'jig rten hril por dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul mjug sgril ba'i dus par zig pas ti se'i ljongs su 'bod pa'i gangs can yul du dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lang tsho dar rgyas 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / 'jig rten sher rtogs rig pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim gnyis pa'am sher rtogs rig pa nyid chos lugs kyi bran g.yog tu snyam pa'i dus rim dkyil ma'i bsam blo de'i mjug sgril sa'ang tshan rtsal gyis stong pa'i mtha' 'khob yul gangs can red/ 'on te 'jig rten sher rtogs rig pa 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i mjug nyid bod yul du bsgril na'ang / bod du nub phyogs kyi yul gang rung nang ltar 'du shes 'dzin stangs gsar nga/ zhig 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba phar zhog sngar yod kyi 'jig rten lta tshul der dad pa'i stobs kyis rting snon dang u tshugs mkhregs 'dzin gyi kun slong 'og rgyun 'dzin byas yod pa dang / rgyun 'dzin gyi rnam pa der gdam nga dang rtsod spongs kyi rang bzhin gang yang med par brten deng gi char nged cag gi spyi tshogs thog 'tsho sdod byed pa'i mi rnams kyi 'du shes kyang ser mo ba'i 'dod chung chog shes kyi 'du shes dang mtshungs par tshan rtsal dar spel dang gsar gtod 'du shes kyi ngar shugs gang yang med par gyur yod pa 'di lta red/ka 'jig rten la rang rkya 'pher ba'i gshis ka zhig med pas ji ltar 'grel bshad byas kyang 'grig pa dang mi'i rigs kyis lta tshul gang der khas len min ni nged cag gi shes rab kyi chu tshad dang gtan tshigs 82

kyi dngos stobs rang bzhin la rag las yod ces gtan tshigs sher rtogs rig pa ba tshos 'dod mod mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i ltos med kyi drang bden zhig ga la yin/ rgyu mtshan yod de dngos po gang dang gang zhig yin yang rgyu rkyen mang po lhan du 'dus pa'i rnam pa'i 'og dngos po rang gi ngo bo grub yod pa dang / de yang 'o skol mi'i rigs kyi rigs rgyud rgyud 'dzin gyi cha la mtshon na'ang phyi rkyen dang nang rkyen gnyis 'dzoms pa'i gnas tshul 'og mu mthud 'phel rgyas byung yod pa red/ nang rkyem/ ni pha ma gnyis dang mi'i rnam par shes pa'i rten dang bcas pa yin pakyidang / phyi rkyen ni mi'i rigs kyis 'tsho sdod kyi go rim khrod du gsar gtod mang po zhig rim par byas yod pa dang / gsar gtod kyi 'du shes dang 'bras bu de dag gis mi rang gi rigs shes 'phel rgyas 'gro bar skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po thon yod pa ma zad/ mi'i rigs mu mthud 'tsho sdod dang tshul ldan shes rig gi skya rengs gsar pa zhig bsu bar rlabs che ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen zhig bskrun yod pa red/dper na dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang nub phyogs su tshan rig dang sher rtogs rig pa gnyis so sor dbye ba med par ma lag gcig la brten te 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / rigs pa'i rtogs 'jug gang zhig yin yang sher rtogs rig pa'i khyab khongs kyi tha snyad spyad de ming brda sbyor ba dang gdags gzhi spyod par byed pa/ nye rabs lo rgyus khrod tshan rtsal gyi 'du shes 'phel rgyas byung ba des mi'i rigs kyi rjes dpag gi shes pa mdun skyod byung ste bden sgrub dang dbye mtshams gang zhig gis kyang 'gog tu med pa'i rang dbang gi yul du slebs par ra sprod byas pa'i 'og spyi tshogs kyi grub cha la 'pho 'gyur gtong nus pa'i chos lugs 83

bsgyur bcos dang tshong las gsar brje/ zhing las gsar brje sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bsam blo'i gsar brje zhig sngon bsus dang 'phrul chas kyi 'jig rten lta tshul zhig 'phel rgyas 'ong bar rmang gzhi brtan po bting yod pa ni ko rber rna'u si'i dhi gnam rig skar rtsis kyi brtag dpyad gsar brje dang / rga le lad kyi dukyi gnam rig skar rtsis kyi gsar rtogs dang byings gzugs gtan srol/ rnam rdzun mgyogs tshad kyi rtsa ba'i rig pa dang / 'gul shugs rig pa/ 'od rig pa/ rno dbal rig pa sogs ni dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang gi lag rjes 'gangs chen zhig red/dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang ho lan pa kyan san dugyis phra mthong me long gsar gtod byas pa dang /(de'i rjes hod khes rjosna mang phra mthong me long dang / ker zher rjogyis phra mthong me long / rad wun hod khe'i lpe+orkyang cha'i phra mthong me long / kham phe ni ⑫dang wer san ⑪gyi gcus gzer can gyi phra mthong me long sogs bzos yod/) pa khon gyis gsar gtod byas par grags pa'i rgyang mthong me long dang / (de la'ang ho lan rgyang mthong me long ngam sga le lad rgyang mthong me long dang khe spu rlar yigyi rgyang mthong me long sa e na'i tsorgyang mthong me long / had we li'u si'i ⑫rgyang mthong me long ring po/ had kan si'i ñcabar snang blta byed kyi rgyang mthong me long / ne'u tun yigyi ldog 'phros rgyang mthong me long sogs rim bzhin sa/sar bskrun byas yod/) ke rad ge ⑪gyis gsar gtod byas pa'i drod tshad 'jal chas dang (de la'ang ke rad khe'i drod tshad tshod blta byed chas dang a mon tun ⑫gyi drod tshad 'jal chas sogs yod )rga le lad mchan bu tho rad su'u res ⑫kyi rlung gnon 'jal chas dang / (ke rad khe'i chu'i rlung gnon 'jal chas/ a mon tun gyi mtsho spyod rlungaganon 'jal chas/ hod khe'i 'khor lo'i rnam pa'i rlung gnon 'jal chas 84

sogs/ rim bzhin gsar bzo byas yod/) ke rad khes gsar gtod byas pa'i dbugs 'then dpyad chas dang / (rnam pa mi 'dra ba gsum yod/) de'i rjes rbu e er yigyis kyang dbugs 'then dpyad chas mi 'dra ba khag bzos yod/ dpyang 'gel chu tshod 'khor lo ni su zhig gis thog mar gsar gtod byas pa ma nges mod/ chu tshod 'khor lo 'phel rgyas byung ba de nas bzung chu tshod 'khor lo rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig gsar bskrun byas yod pa ma zad/ gzings spyod dpyad chas sogs kyang gas/ra bzos byas par brten mi'i rigs kyi bzo tshong dar rgyas thad sngar med pa'i grub 'bras thob pa dang lhan du mi'i rigs tshul ldan shes rig gi le'u gsar pa'am rang nyid kyi phugs bsam mngon 'gyur byed pa'i yul du dbye mtshams nye ru phyi+on pa red/ yin na yang rang mi rigs la mtshon na dus rabs 'di'i tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi brjod bya ni rtsom 'phror lus pa'i bstan bcos shig yin par brten dgos nges kyi kha gsab dang lhan thabs su rtsom rgyu ni bskal ba'i dus mjug 'dir 'tsho ba rol ba'i mi rabs 'di dang rig gnas de'i las 'gan nyag gcig red snyam mo/ /kha nga tshor lo rgyus kyi rig gnas las gzhan gang yang med pa ma zad/ nga tshos brgyud myong ba'i lo rgyus de'ang mi'i rigs kyis brgyud myong ba'i lo rgyus dang 'dra gshib yin pa dang / nga tshos lo bo+os kyi thog nas lo rgyus la dpyad gzhigs byed dus lo rgyus rig gnas khrod kyi btang snyoms min pa'i rgyu rkyen dang des bskrun pa'i ngar shugs gsar bskyed dang gnyom chung nus med kyi he bag gi snang tshul de red/ yin yang nga tsho lo rgyus kyi zur gzhan zhig nas 'greng ste lo rgyus kyi gnyer ma'i bang rim khrod du rang gis rnyed na ci ma rung bsam pa'i lo rgyus kyi rjes shul 'tshol 85

dus skabs der nged cag gi dpyad gzhigs kyi yul las 'gongs pa'i dri ba re thob pa ni 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus kyi go rim nges can nam gang rung zhig gi khrod shar phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi rig gnas dar ba'i yul gtso bo 'gar bod kyi tshul ldan shes rig dar myong yod pa dang / skabs de dus nga tshos rig gnas kyi 'du shes gang zhig yul phyogs gzhan du khyab bsgrags dang dar spel byas pa red dam zhes pa de red/ de yang gsal por bshad na sangs rgyas chos lugs ni rgya gar gyi rig gnas shig yin pa dang / bon gyi shes rig ni bod rang sa/nas nas 'phel rgyas byung bar cha 'jog byas kyang da lta'i char nga tshos rnyed thub pa ni 'khyar bon dang bsgyur bon/ nang bstan can du gyur ba'i bon chos de las thog ma'i char dar ba'i brdol bon gyi rjes shul tsam yang rnyed mi thub/ yang rig gnas 'phel ba'i lo rgyus kyi zur gzhan zhig nas bltas na nub phyogs par zig yul gyi gri brdung mkhan dang shar phyogs rgya nag yul gyi dkar yol bzo mkhan gyi lag rtsal pa bod du drangs pa'i lo rgyus byung ba des rang byung bya dngos spyod 'dul byed pa'i 'du shes mtho ru song ba'i sgrub byed bkod yod na'ang nang 'dren rig gnas sam nang bstan shes rig gi bsam pa'i dpal yon la gtsigs chen byed pa'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs shig dar ba nas 'go brtsams te de snga yod pa'i bzo rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi khyab khongs mtha' dag kyang spyi tshogs hril po'i dgos mkho la kha gtad gcog pa'i ngang tshul las ldog ste chos lugs cho ga'i yo byad bzo skrun gyi rig gnas su gyur pa dang / dus yun ring mo zhig gi lo rgyus khrod bzo rig pa ni spyi tshogs yongs kyi 'du shes dang kha bral ba'i spyod med rig gnas su gyur yod pa red/ gso ba rig pa dar 'phel 86

byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi bshul lam ring mo der tshod gleng byed pa'i dus gso ba rig pa ni nged gnyis kyi brjod gzhi'i khyab khongs kyi re smon dang mthun par tshan rig lag rtsal dang lhan cig gong du 'phel ba'i snang tshul byung yod pa ni/ bod kyi gso rig sman dpyadal cha bzhag na/ skam pa mthing ril mchu/ skam pa 'dam bu'i mchu rigs gnyis/ 'brum gcod skyong bu/ rnag brtag pa'i dpal ldan/ tsher bzung / gzhang 'brum brtag byed lam 'jug blo dkar/ pho mo gzhang 'brum brtag pa'i sbubs can gnyis/ brtag dpyad sbrul mig gce'u/ zlum dpyad kha dbrag rtse gug pa/ gce'u chung / rtse kyog pa/ skam pa seng ge kha/ bra bo'i mgo/ zlum bo'i mgo/ me bum/ brtag dpyad khab mgo/ so srin bsreg pa'i thur skyog sha khab/ lce chung bsreg thur/rngabs rwa/ gre ba'i them bu/ tel pa/ spu gri/ sog le/ chan pa/ rnag zur mdung rtse/ sog le ring po/ gsor ba/chu ser thur ma 'bri lce/gsor ba rtse gug/ ste'u 'dra/ ste kha 'dra ba/ ba le kha/ rko ma'i mchu 'dra/ 'phrul thur/ skam pa seng ge kha/ rde'u 'byin pa'i thur phyed/khrag rtsa'i gtsag/sa bu/ sna rngub pa'i sbubs can/ mngal thur/ skam pa karga mchu/ lce gshags pa'i zor ba/ skam pa bya rog mchu/ rus rtsa'i gtsags bu/ khrag rtsa'i gtsags bu/ skrangs pa zhal ba'i chu gri mgo rma'i smyug gri brang ba can/ kha sna du ba rngub pa'i sbubs can/ sbubs thur/ sbubs thur smyu gu kha/ sbubs thur byid po'i mchu/ mig thur nas mgo/ mig thur sbal mgo/ mig thur bra mgo/ mig thur 'bri lce/ mig thur gzor kha la sogs kyis mtshon nus mod/ yid phangs pa zhig la cha dpyad de dag bzo mkhan gyi bsam gzhigs pa dang / gsar gtod pa/87

lag rtsal pa su yin dang yang na bod kyi gso rig gis gso rig dang tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas phyogs su hur brtson ci yod byas pa'i thad kyi dpyad rtsom zhig da phan phran gyi gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i spyod yul du 'dzin thub med/ u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyi 〈dngul chu grub pa'i bstan ba'os 〉brtsams pa nas za byed khams brgyad ja(gser rdo/ dngul rdo/ lhang tsher nag po/ chu skyur/ rdo khab len/ ba bla/ ldong ros/ pha wang long bu dang brgyad do/)dang / 'ching byed lcags brgyad (gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags/'khar ba / ra gan/ zha nye/ gsha' dkar dang brgyad do/) dngul chu dug 'don sogs mi rigs gzhan du mi snang pa'i lag rtsal gyi cha dar spel byas yod kyang de ni spyi tshogs hril po'i tshan rig lag rtsal 'phel rgyas gtong dgos/ pa'i 'du shes las rgyab tu phyogs yod pa des spyi tshogs thog tshan rtsal dar spel byas pa la dmigs bsal gyi nus pa gang yang thon mi 'dug snyam/ 'on te phyogs gzhan zhig nas sems tshe bod du dar 'phel byung ba'i rig sgo gzhan dag gi khrod du tshan rtsal gyi 'bras bu gang la'ang do snang mi byed kyang gso ba rig pa ni tshan rig lag rtsal gyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas byung ba ni bod mi tsho'i tshe srog gi rin thang nyid 'jig rten du gzhi grub pa kun las mtho bar 'dzin pas yin zhing rig sgo gzhan yod tshad kyis thon skyed nus shugs ring du spong dgos pa'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul la gong bkur byed dgos pa'ang rtsa don der rag las yod pa red/ nga tshos 'jig rten steng zur 'bud byed 'dod kyi bsam blo der ji ltar dang len byas pa de tsam gyis shes rab kyi lta tshul dar 'phel 'gro ba'i dmangs gtso'i rang bzhin nyams dmas su phyin te sngon thon mi rigs tham sa cad kyis dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i lta tshul la 88

phyir phyag bgyi zhing lta tshul gzhan zhig dar spel gtong ba'i skabs rang re'i yul du da dung yang dus rabs dkyil ma'i 'dod chung cho ga shes kyi lta tshul de nyid mu mthud lus yod pa dang / dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang gzhi nas dgon sde'i sher rtogs rig pa'i grub mtha' gsar gtod kyi 'du shes mjug sgril thub pa'i phyi 'byor gyi gnas tshul 'u thug 'di byung ba red/ da dung yang 'das pa'i lo rgyus dang ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam gnad don skor la bsam zhib gang yang mi byed par 'di mur lus pa yin na de ni skyob dka' ba'i nyen kha zhig ma yin nam/ka dus rabs ni tshul ldan shes rig gi dbye mtshams 'byed byed cig yin pa dang / 'jig rten gyis gnyom chung nus med rnams la gces 'dzin mi byed par rtsis med du gtong ba yin na/ nga tshos 'jig — rten gyi 'tsho ba'i don snying de nyid mngon 'gyur bya phyir bskyar du bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa ni tshan rig lag rtsal thang/ kyi dngos yod rin thang skor de yin/ da lta'i char nga tsho 'byor med sku drag tu gyur pa'i ngang tshul 'di ni nga tshor yod pa'i tshul ldan shes rig gi stong cha'am gsal por bshad na dus rabs kyi dgos mkho skong thub pa'i tshan rig lag rtsal gyi tshul ldan shes rig gsar pa zhig gsar sbol dang gsar skrun/ jus 'god/ 'don spel bcas byed ma nus pas lan pa red/ khyed kyis gong du brjod pa bzhin nga tshor nyi tshe ba'i tshan rtsal zhig yod kyang tshan rtsal de spyi tshogs hril po'i thon skyed nus shugs dang kha bral ba'i rgyu mtshan ni tshan rtsal gyi zhib 'jug bya yul gtso bo de gzhi rtsa'i zhib 'jug dang rgyun spyod zhib 'jug gsar sbol zhib 'jug bcas phyogs gsum gyis grub pa'i snang tshul lam rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba zhig yin pa der do 89

snang byed ma thub pa'i 'bras bu yin pa dang / nga tshos nub phyogs su dus rabs bcu drug pa dang bcu bdun pa'i nang tshan rig lag rtsal 'phel rgyas thad phyogs so so'i rig sgo gang yod kyis ji ltar zhib 'jug byas pa'i gnas tshul rags tsam bkod na gsal rtogs yong rgyu ste/ gnam rig skar rtsis la mtshon na sbu ra had ⑨dang khe sbu rad/ had kan si/had rlad /② ob rdzu/tso kha se ne༈ ro mur sogs kyis bzhag pa'i byas rjes lta bu dang / de bzhin rtsis rig dang shugs rig dngos lugs rig pa dang / 'od rig pa/ tsha rig sgra gdangs rig pa/dbal rig glog rig gnam gshis rig pa/ rdzas 'gyur/ sa gshis rig pa/ skyes dngos rig pa/ srog chasas rig pa/ gshag bcos rig pa/ skye khams rig pa/ gso rig tshan rig lag rtsal/ zhing las/'khel las/ 'dzugs skrun/ gter bsngog dang gser dngul bzhu ba/'phrul chas bzo 'god/ mi 'bor sdom rtsis rig pa/ 'phrul chas rtsis 'khor/ sems khams rig pa/ spyi tshogs rig pa/ sher rtogs rig pa sogs kyi khyab khongs su'ang g.yur du za ba'i grub 'bras thob yod pa ma zad/ tshan rig lag rtsal dang 'brel ba dam po'i sgo nas tshan rig gi dpyad chas mang po gsar gtod dang bed spyod byas pa des mi'i rigs hril po'i tshan rtsal gyi tshul ldan shes rig mdun bskyod byed par skul lcag gi nus pa bla med cig thon yod pa lta bu yin/ nga tsho'i shes rig gi lo rgyu sa snang tshul ngor tshan rtsal de'i rigs sna gcig kyang byung med pa des 'dra mnyam gyi dus rabs de'i khrod du 'phel rgyas dang 'phel rgyas dbar he bag chen po zhig byung yod pa ra sprod tan tan byed thub pa ma zad/he bag de ni 'tsho sdod kyi las dbang gtan 'bebs bya byed cig yin 90

par yang gsal bshad byed thub/kha nga tshos dbyi ta li dang / h+pha ran si/ si phen/ dbyin ji rgyal khab sogs su rig gsar bskyar dar gyi las 'gul nyid ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen la ma ltos par rig gsar bskyar dar gyi las 'gul dar spel byas pa des sher rtogs rig pa dang / sgyu rtsal/ rtsom rig tshan rig slob gso/ chos lugs sogs phyogs so so'i khyab khongs thad g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bu thon par byas te dus rabs dkyil ma'i spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa dang mi 'dra ba'i spyi tshogs gsar pa'i sgrig gzhi zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i dge mtshan dang don snying gi thog nas dpyad pa yin na nga tshor nges par mkho ba'ang rig gsar bskyar dar lta bu'i las 'gul zhig yin pa dang / gal srid h+pha ran si dang / dbyin ji/ dbyi ta li bcas su rig gsar bskyar dar gyi las 'gul de 'dra dus rabs bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa'i nang rim bzhin dar spel byung med pa yin na mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo rnying pa la 'pho 'gyur gtong thub pa'i bsam blo'i gsar brje de 'dra 'byung mi thub la da lta'i 'phel rgyas ni de bas kyang gleng dka' ba zhig yin/ gcig byas na kho tsho'ang nga tsho dang 'dra bar bsam pa'i tshul ldan shes rig dang dngos po'i tshul ldan shes rig dbar gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel ba'i gdam nga la rmongs te rjes lus thebs yod nges red/ 'on te yod pa ni yod pa'i gtan tshigs kyi dris lan yin par brten rig gsar bskyar dar gyi las 'gul spel myong ba'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs de tshor mtshon na dus rabs bcu bzhi pa dang / bcu bdun pa ste khyon bsdoms lo bzhi brgya'i ring bsags pa'i bsam blo dang tshan rtsal gyi 'bras bu'i rmang gzhi'i thog dus rabs bco brgyad par dpung 'jug 91

byas yod pa ma zad/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa ni rjes dpag dang rig pa'i sgo 'byed kyi dus rabs dang / rtsod spongs dang sher rtogs rig pa'i dus rabs shig yin par ngos 'dzin dang / dus rabs de'i khrod du mi'i rigs kyis shesatshobya dar spel byed pa'i khyab khongs nyid sngon ma'i gnas gzhi las babol bar byas te mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos byas yod pa red/ des ma tshad da dung rig sgo so so'i khyab khongs khrod du tshan rig lagre/ rtsal thad zhib 'jug byed pa dang gsar gtod byed pa'i 'du thes shugs che ru phyin yod pa ni rtsis rig la mtshon na tshab rtsis rig pa nyid ma lag can du 'phel rgyas byung zhing / zur gsum rig pa nyid rtsis rig rnam 'byed kyi khyab khongs su gyur pa/ skar rtsis rig pas nyi ma dang sa gzhi ril mo/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum phan tshun 'then shugs kyi rgyu ru gyur pa'i 'gul bskyod can du ngos 'dzin byas te ched du zhib 'jug byas yod pa/ de bzhin dngos lugs rig pas glog gi snang tshul dang srog chags kyi glog ( myo'ilhamiwo)gi skor la rtogs 'jug byas yod pa lta bu/ sher rtogs rig pa la mtshon na sems gtso dang dngos gtso/ the tshom smra ba dang bden grub smra ba/ sngon thob smra ba sogs rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i 'du shes 'og 'phel rgyas byung ste dus rabs de'i 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen chen po bzhag yod pa ma zad/ sher rtogs rig pa'i khyab khongs kyi sems khams rig pa nyid skabs der dar rgyugs che ba'i rig sgo zhig tu gyur yod pa red/ 'on te med pa ni med pa rang gis thag chod pas nga tshos lo rgyus kyi brjed byang der yo bsrang byed ga la nus/mi'i rigs kyis dus rabs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa'i nang sngar srol gyi 'du shes yul las brgal ba'i tshan rtsal gyi 'bras bu sna tshogs 92

shig 'khyer te dus rabs nyi shu par bskyod pa'i dus gangs ri'i khrod du gnas pa'i spun zla rnams ma chog 'dzin gyi 'du shes der mgo 'khor te bsdad pas da lta 'i char smos ma dgos pa'i 'bras bu zhig smin yo da nga 'di yang / nga tshos rig gnas kyi ma lag hril por bskyar du mno sems byed dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i cha rkyen zhig red/ka dus rabs bcu drug pa dang bcu bdun pa/ bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa/ lhag par dus rabs nyi shu par slebs nye ba'i skabs su sdom tshig smra ba tshos dus rabs de dag ni mi'i rigs dus rabs dkyil ma'i bkag sdom gyi bsam blo dang kha bral te deng rabs 'jig rten du slebs par ngos 'dzin byed kyang dngos 'brel bshad na dus rabs de dag gi khrod du deng rabs 'jig rten 'grub byed kyi bsam blo'i 'gal 'du mang po zhig brgyud yod pa ma zad/ sher rtogs rig pa'i shes rab dang lha'i rig pa'i shes rab gnyis dbar dbye 'byed byas par brten/phyis kyi 'phel rgyas khrod du sher rtogs rig pa'i shes rab nyid rim bzhim/ nyams dmas su phyin pa dang / tshan rig gi shes rab nyid gong du dar 'phel byung ste dngos po'i dpal yon thams cad tshan rig gi skul 'ded la brten dgos pa'i rlabs che ba'i dus rabs shig sngon bsu byas yod pa red/ de bas sdom tshig smra ba la las dus rabs nyi shu pa ni sher rtogs rig pa nyid nyams rgud dang / chos lugs kyi ngo bo nyin re las nyin rer 'gyur ldog 'gro ba/ mi rnams kyis tshan rig nyid 'jig rten skyob pa'i re 'dun che shos su 'dod ces brjod kyi yod la don ngo mar yang de lta'i gtan srol zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis chags yod pa red/ sher rtogs rig pa la mtshon na tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas phyogs su 'brel ba gang yang 93

med par sgra dog 'jug gi spyi tshogs rigre/ pa'am sher rtogs rig pa'i shes rab kho na'i phyogs su gzhol bar hur brtson byas yod pa ni gzhi grub smra ba dang dngos spyod smra ba/ gtan tshigs rnam bden smra ba sogs kyis ma tshon nus shing sher rtogs rig pa nyid tshan rtsal dang kha bral ba des sher rtogs rig pa dang rang nyid nyams rgud kyi rmang gzhi bskrun rgyu las tshan rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas thad 'gog rkyen gang yang bzo thub med pa dang /tshan rig la mtshon na gnam gru sna tshogs dang brnyan 'phrin sna tshogs/rlangs 'khor sna tshogs bzos yod pa ma zad/ nus pa'i thon khungs gsar rnyed byung ba dang / rdul phran mtshon cha dang / nying rdul tsha ba'i mtshon cha/ bar snang dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rtog 'jug byed pa/bar snang du 'phur bskyod byed pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i grub 'bras thob yod pa de lta red/ 'on te rang re'i pha yul du de 'dra'i bsod nams kyi bskal ba'i longs spyod cig 'byung rgyu phar zhog de 'dra'i rigs gsar gtod byas tshe gsar gtod byed pa po der lta ba log mkhan dang thon skyed kyi 'bras bu der bdud 'phrul gyi rdzas su ngos 'dzin byas te spyi tshogs kyis dma' 'bebs dang zur 'bud byas pas 'das pa'i dus yun khrod thon skyed nus shugs phyogs su bsam blo gtong mkhan tshor 'gog rkyen mi nyung ba zhig thebs yod pa de dag kyang da lta'i char spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes dang rig gnas kyi ma lag hril por bskyar du zhib bsher byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'gangs chen zhig red snyam/kha 'jig rten hril po'i sher rtogs rig pa'i bsam blo dar 'phel gyi gnas babs la gzhigs tshe sher rtogs rig pa dang tshan rig (sgra yangs 'jug gi cha nas brjod na ) gnyis skabs rer phan tshun 'brel 94

ba'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas byung yod pa dang / skabs rer phan tshun dbar 'brel ba gang yang med par so so'i lam du phyogs te dar 'phel byung yod pa ni dus rabs bco lnga pa nas bco brgyad pa'i dbar sher rtogs rig pa ba'ang yin la tshan rig pa'ang yin pa'i bsam blo ba tshos 'gan gcig lcogs byas te rang byung shes bya'i tshan rig skor la brtag dpyad byas yod pa lta bu dang / dus rabs bco brgyad pa nas nyi shu pa'i dbar tshan rig pa dang sher rtogs rig pa ba gnyis rig sgo mi 'dra ba'i khyab khongs su zhugs te tshan rig dang sher rtogs rig pa'i rig gzhung gnyis dbar rtsa ba'i thog phan tshun dbar 'brel ba gang yang med pa'i gzhung lugs kyi sgrig srol lam lugs shig gi rmang gzhi bting ba des mtshams rer dngos po'i dpal yon kho na 'phel rgyas phyin te bsam pa'i dang/la yon 'phel rgyas kyi shugs shin tu chung ba dang / re 'gar bsam pa'i dpal yon kho nar gtsigs chen byas pas dngos po'i dpal yon gsar bskrun byed pa'i nus stobs gang yang med par 'gyur ba sogs spyi tshogs dang mi sger gyi khe phan skor la btang snyoms min pa'i snang tshul zhig byung yod pa de ni spyi tshogs hril po'i brtan brling thad mi sman pa'i rgyu rkyen du gyur yod pas/ dus rabs nyer gcig par mdun bskyod byed pa'i skabs 'dir nga tshos nges par du sta gon byed dgos pa'ang stong cha kha skong dang sngar med gsar gtod kyi yul du zhugs te sher rtogs rig pa dang tshan rig (dngos po'i dpal yon dang lag rtsal skor ) gnyis zung 'brel byed pa'i lam du 'jug dgos shing / de 'dra byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni sher rtogs rig pa dang tshan rig gnyis kyis bsam pa'i dpal yon dang dngos po'i dpal yon gnyis kyi tshab byas yod kyang de gnyis ni 95
