chub dang drug dge slong byas te ’’slozhes gsungs mod/ 〈sba bzhed 〉rang du mchan btab pa ltar sba dpal dbyangs dang sang shi ta/ sba gsal snang dang ye shes dbang po dang yang khri bzher gyi bu sang shi ta rnams mi gcig gi ming du byas tshe sad mi mi bdun gyi khrod du pha bu gnyis yod pa ni sba gsal snang dang sba khri bzher gnyis te sba gsal snang gi ming gzhan la sang shi ta zer ba dang sang shi ta'i pha ni sba khri bzher yin pa'i phyir te khri bzher gyi bu sang shi zhes dz+nyosba bzhed 〉rang du rga/sungs pa'i phyir/ de min sba gsal snang dang sba khri bzher gnyis mi gcig tu ngos 'dzin byas pa yin na sad mi'i mi lnga ma gtogs 〈sba bzhed 〉du 'khod thub med/ ne'u paṇ+ḍi ta'i 〈sngon gyi gtam me tog phreng ba 〉ru (bod kyi btsun pa la snga ba )rba rmang gzigs kyi bu rad na/ 'chims shākya'i bu shākya pra ba/ rtsangs the len tra'i bu legs grub/ rba dpal dbyangs/ zhang nyang bzangs kyi bu lha bu/ gzhan yang shud bu hong len/ rba gsal snang de la ye shes dbang po zhes btags dang bdun ’’yizhes gong gsal gyi chos 'byung lo rgyus gang dang yang mi 'dra ba zhig gsungs yod pa dang / gal srid dz+nyosba bzhed 〉kyi 'dod pa ltar rba dpal dbyangs dang rba gsal snang gnyis mi gcig gi ming yin tshe de la zlos skyon zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis yong gi yod pa red/ der ma zad/ dz+nyotshal ba'i deb dmar 〉du ‘‘bod 'bangs nang nas/ sba gsal snang / dbas khri sher/ sang shi ta/ pa gor bai ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/’’yi‘‘'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ rma a tsar rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub ste sad mi mi bdun ’’yidu 'dod pa las/ sba gsal snang dang sang shi ta zhes mi gcig mi gnyis su bgrangs pa'i zlos skyon dang / dbas khri sher dang dz+nyosba bzhed 〉du bkod pa'i sba khri bzher gnyis kyi ming gi dag cha der yang dpyad dgos pa zhig red/ dz+nyobu ston chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ste rgan gsum ni dba' mañja shrī/ dba' ran+ta198

(rat+na)rasti(rak+ṣi)ta/ bran ka mu ti ka gzhon gsum ni 'khon nā gen+d+ra/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ rtsangs de wen+d+ra'o// bar ba glang ka ta na rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes dbang po yin la ’’phyezhes dang / ‘‘mkhan po bo dhi sa twa byas nas thog mar bya khri gzigs rab tu byung bas mngon shes lnga dang ldan par gyur to/ / de nas sba gsal snang / 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ rma ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub dang bdun rab tu byung bas mtshan ye shes dbang po dang dpal dbyangs la sogs pa yin ’’zhes gong du sgra ming 'bri ba'am legs sbyar skad kyi ming 'bri ba'i dus rus kyi yi ge dba' dang rtsangs zhes bris yod pa dang /de mur sba dang gtsang zhes bris pa la dmigs bsal dgos mkho gang yin ma nges mod/ phan tshun nang 'gal lta bur gyur ba ni gong du bar ba glang ka ta na zhes pa'i ming de phyis brlags tshar ba dang / bya khri gzigs zer ba zhig thol ba byung ba ma zad bya khri gzigs nas gtsang legs grub kyi bar du mi brgyad yod pa la lan ji skad gdab/ de min (sba bzhed 〉kyi dgongs bzhed ltar sba gsal snang dang 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta gnyis mi gcig tu bgrangs dgos/ de min dba' rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang bran ka mu ti ka gnyis kyang gong 'og gi lung bsdur ba'i dus phan tshun 'phrod sbyor byed khag po 'dug (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed 〉du dz+nyosad mi bdun ni dba' mdzi shrī/ tsangs dhe waṃn+d+ra/ bran ka mu ti ka ste rgan gsum/mkhan po na len+d+ra/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ rma ar+ya rin chen mchog ste gzhon gsum/bar pa glang ka na na rab tu byung ba'i ye shes dbang po dang bdun no zhes stidang /dz+nyobu ston chos 'byung 〉du dba' ran+da (rat+na)rasti(rak+ṣi)ta rgan gsum du bgrangs pa las dz+nyobastan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed 〉du tsangs dhe win+d+ra tshab tu bris yod pa dang / dz+nyobu ston chos 'byung 〉gi dba' ran+da(rat+na) rak+ṣi (rak+ṣi) ta'i tshab tu 199

(bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed〉du rma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog dang / de min 'khon nā gen+d+ra zer ba la mkhan po na leṇ+ḍa zhes kyang 'byung / 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me 'o/nga 〉du ‘‘de nas rgyal pos 'bangs rnams bsags te blo rno ba bdun sto lha sa twa'i drung du rab tu byung ste/ de'ang sba sang shi'i bu rat+na/ mchims a nu'i bu shākya bra ba/ pa gor rat+na'i bu be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrungs ba/ (lo rgyus kha cig na 'khon klu'i dbang po sad mi mi bdun la mi the zer ba'am 'dug)gtsang legs grub ste bdun gyis rab tu byung bas ri’stizhes gong gsal chos 'byung de dag dang ches mi mthun pa zhig sba sang shi'i bu rat+na zhes yod pa de red/ zhes dang ‘‘khong rnams la rim pa bzhin du sba dz+nya na rtse rak+ṣi ta ye shes dbang pos bsrungs pa/ da was rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ rin chen bsrung ba/ran rad nanan+t+ra rak+ṣi ta rin chen dbang pos srung ba/ glang khams pa su gha ta wa rma rak+ṣi ta/ bde bar gshegs pas bsrung pa/ pa gor be+e ro tsā na rak+ṣi ta rnam pa snang mdzad bsrung ba/'khon na ga in+d+ra rak+ṣi ta klu'i dbang pos bsrung ba/ gtsang de ben+t+ra rak+ṣi ta rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba/ 'khon na ga in+d+ra rak+ṣi ta klu'i dbang pos bsrung ba/gtsang de ben+t+ra rak+ṣi ta lha'i dbang pos bsrung ba/ bya bar ming btags/ bod kyi btsun pa la snga ba/ sad mi mi bdun du grags pa byung ’’yizhes gsungs pa la'ang brtag par bya ba 'di yod de sma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog dang ran rad nartse rak+ṣi ta rin chen dbang pos bsrung ba/ gtsang legs grub dang gtsang de berkye rak+ṣi ta lha'i dbang pos bsrung ba bcas kyi bar du nga tshos rigs pa spyad de khas len thub na'ang gong du smos pa'i ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / glang khams pa sa gha ta warma rak+ṣi ta bde bar gshegs pas bsrung ba gnyis kyi dbar du 'gal 'du chen po zhig yod pa de red/ 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du ‘‘snga rabs mang po zhig 200

ni rba mañja shrī warma ('jam dpal go cha) rtsangs de we n+d+ra rak+ṣita (lha dbang bsrung ba) bran ka mu khan+d+ra (rak+ṣi ta sgo'i dbang po bsrung ba ) ste rgan gsum/bar ba rlangs khams pa go cha/ gzhon pa (klu'i dbang bo)khon na gin+d+ra/ pa gor(rnam snang )be+e ro tsa na/ rma a tsa ra rin chen mchog ste gsum rnams sad mi mi bdun du chad do mi’zhes dang / kha cig gis bzhed pa lung drangs pa ni ‘‘rba rat+na/mchims shākya bra bha/ gtsang legs grub/ be+e ro tsa na/ zhang lha bu/ shud bu khong legs/ ye shes dbang po dang bdun no ’’yizhes gsungs yod pa las phyi ma kha cig gi bzhed tshul dang / ne'u paṇ+ḍi ta'i dz+nyosngon gyi gtam me tog phreng ba 〉ru drangs pa gnyis phan tshun bsdur ba'i tshe/ rba rmang gzigs kyi bu rata na—rba rat+na/'chims a nu'i bu shākya pra ba 'chims shākya bra bha/ rtsangs the len tra'i bu legs grub —gtsang legs grub/ zhang nyang bzangs kyi bu lha bu/ shud bu hong len—shud bu khong legs/ gzhan 〈sngon gyi gtam me tog phreng ba 〉ru drangs pa'i rba dpal dbyangs dang rba gsal snang gi tshab tu gong gsal kha cig gi bzhed tshul de'i nang be+e ro tsa na dang ye shes dbang po zhes bris yod pa dang / 〈chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed 〉(lag bris ma)280par/ bod la btsun pa btub mi btub sad pa'i phyir du mi bdun rab tu byung ste/ de dag gi mkhan po ni bo dhis twa'o// de las rgan gsum ni sbas rat+na rak+ṣita rin chen srung ba ces bya ba'o//sbas snye na rtse rak+ṣita ye shes dbang po bsrung ste/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i mkhan po bod la sku drin che ba yin zhing / mkhan po bo dhi sa twa sku gshegs nas 'dis mkhan po'i gdan sa mdzad/ rat+na ne+en+d+ra rak+ṣita rin chen dbang bo bsrung ba ste gsum mo// bar pa ni glang su ga ta warma rak+ṣi ta/ bde bar gshegs pa'i so/ cha bsrung ba zhes bya ba'o/ / gzhon nu gsum ni nga/pal gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/rnam snang mdzad srung ba ces bya ba nges pa'i don theg pa'i rtse mo la sku drin shin tu 201

che ba/ 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi dbang bo bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ rtsangs de brtswa rak+ṣita lha'i dbang bo bsrung ba dang gsum mo/ / 〈dam pa'i byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings 〉(shing par ma) kyi 2121par/ ‘‘bod la btsun pa btub mi btub sad pa'i phyir sang/ mi mi bdun rab tu byung ste/ de la rgan gsum ni dba' rat+na rak+ṣita rin chen bsrung ba zhes bya ba bod yul du btsun pa byung ba la snga ba yin no/ / dz+nyā ne+en+d+rarak+ṣita ye shes dbang po bsrung ba ste/ dam pa'i chos 'byin pa'i bod la bka' drin che ba yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' rta skad ces par lung bstan pa yin no//yang / rat+narak+ṣita rin chen dbang po bsrung ba gsum mo/ / bar ba ni glang khams pa su ga ta warma rak+ṣi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i go cha bsrung ba zhes bya'o// gzhon gsum ni pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba dang / mkhon na ṅgān+d+ra rak+ṣita klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ gtsang de watre+e rak+ṣita lha'i dbang bo bsrung ba dang gsum mo ’’zhes kyang 'byung ngo / / 〈'brug pa'i chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘rgan gsum ni sbas rat+na rak+ṣita/rin chen bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ sbas dzha na nan+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ ye shes dbang po bsrung ba ste/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i mkhan po chen po bod la sku drin che ba yin zhi/nga mkhan po bo dhi sa twa sku gshegs nas 'dis mkhan po'i gdan sa mdzad/ rat+na naje rak+ṣi ta/ rin chen dbang po bsrung ba ste gsum mo/ / gnon nu gsum ni dpa' gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ nges pa'i don theg pa'i rtse mo la shin tu sku drin che ba/ 'khon nā gan+ni rak+ṣi ta/ klu'i dbang po bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ rtsangs de ban+ni rak+ṣi ta/ lha'i dbang po bsrung ba dang / gsum mo//’’slozhes pa dang / dz+nyorgya bod yig tshang chen mo 〉ru lung drangs pa gnyis bsdur ba'i dus chos 'byung sa/nyis kas sad mi mi bdun la mkhan po'i mtshan zur ‘‘rak+ṣi ta ’’sbyar yod pa khas len na'ang (rgya bod yig tshang chen mo 〉ru 202

ye shes dbang po bsrung ba la sba dh+ri tre+e rak+ṣi ta zhes dang / rin chen srung ba la da was rat+na rak+ṣi ta zhes dang / ming yig kha shas kyi 'bri stangs thad khyad rma ra yod pa gzhir bzhag rgan gsum dang gzhon gsum gyi dbye ba de'ang 〈rgya bod yig tshang chen mo 〉ru bkod med/ mkhan po'i mtshan zur de yang chos 'byung lo rgyus rnying ma dag tu mthong dka' na'ang 〈'brug pa'i chos 'byung 〉dang / dz+nyorgya bod yig tshang chen mo 〉ru cha tshang zhig byung yod pa der yang dpyad dgos pa zhig 'dugadz+nyoklong chen chos 'byung 〉 du ‘‘dba' rma gzigs kyi bu dba' khri rat+na dang /mchims a nu'i bu shākya pra bha dang / rtsangs then le tra'i bu rtsangs legs grub dang /pa gor he 'dod kyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / zhang bzang gi bu lha bu dang / shud pu khong sleb pa dang sba gsal snang bcas rab tu byung ’’zhes dang / yang chos 'byung de ru ‘‘lo rgyus gcig las lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun ni/ rgan gsum/ gzhon gsum/ bar ma gcig ste ’’tso zhes ming yig mi 'dra ba bris yod pa ma zad dmigs su ‘‘lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun ’ zhes pa'i tha snyad sbyar yod pa dang / tha snyad der go ba 'di 'dra zhig len rgyu yod pa ste bo dhi sa twa'i drung rab tu byung mkhan mang po yod pa las sad mi mi bdun ni lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun yin tshul de red/ mdor na/ sad mi tsho'i ming yig 'bri stangs mi 'dra ba dang dang don gyi 'dren lugs mi 'dra ba des phyogs gcig nas sad mi mi bdun ni dus gcig la rab tu byung ba min par lo rgyus kyis bsags nyar byas pa'i bod kyi mdzangs mi bdun nang ltar rim bzhin mdzad rjes che ba bdun phyogs gcig tu sdom pa'i sdom tshig cig yin pa dang / phyogs gzhan nas sad mi mi bdun der mdo'i bstan bcos bsgyur mkhan gyi sad mi mi bdun bya ba dang / gsang sngags bsgyur mkhan gyi sad mi mi bdun/ de min spyi'i cha nas lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun bya ba'i dbye ba'i rnam grangs kyang med dam snyam pas brtag par 'tshal/203

lnga/ nges pan 'tshol dgos pa'i dris lan/btsan po'i dus rabs su sad mi drug dang bdun/ yang na brgyad dang dgu gzhan sad mi bcu gsum dang de dang lhan du mi brgya dang bzhi bcu rab tu byung ba dang / sum brgya dang bzhi brgya/ de min ‘‘bod khri sde bcu gsum gyi nang nas stong phrag gsum ban gsar du dus cig mdzad ’’nyaces chos 'byung lo rgyus mang por sad mi'i skor bkod yod pa des dngos su gsal bshad dang ra sprod byed thub pa ni btsan po'i dus rabs su rab tu byung ba'i sad mi yod pa thag gis chod pa dang /btsan po'i dus rabs su ‘‘rtsal chen gyi mi bdun ’ ②zer ba dang / ‘‘bod kyi mdzangs pa mi bdun ’’tso‘‘bon gyi mkhas pa mi bdun ’’zhes dang ‘‘mthu chen mi bdun ’’phy-izhes grangs ka bdun can gyi 'bod srol yod pa la brtag tshe ‘‘sad mi mi bdun ’’min yang snyam mod/ de ni bdag gis 'ol tshod byas pa'i cha 'jog tsam las rbad de thag bcad pa'i gtan 'bebs shig ga la yin/ sad mi de tsho rab tu byung ba'am dge slong btub dang mi btub blta ba'i nyams sad kyi dus tshod de mes ag tshom dang khri srong lde btsan gyi dus gang yin thad chos 'byung lo rgyus rtsom pa po mang shos kyis khri srong lde btsan gyi dus rabs su sad mi byung bar khas len pa ji bzhin nga tshos kyang gong bkur byed mi chog pa ga la yod/ de min 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyi dz+nyodeb sngon 〉du bkod pa ltar lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring bod du phebs par 'dod pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems 'tsho dang lo tsā ba li thetshose gnyis la shes rtogs byas te ‘‘bo dhi sa twa blo sems su li the ses bsgyur/ 'tsho zhes pa zhi ba 'tsho dang 'byor bas so ’’ñcazhes u tshugs kyis 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu las 204

ma 'das shing / bo dhi sa twa nyid rgyal rabs dgu'i bar du 'jig rten mi yul du bzhugs par brjod pa'i lha sgrung gi gtam rgyud der gzu bor gnas pa su yis dngos don du khas len byed dam/ de ni rang gis rang la bslu brid byas pa'i 'du shes kyi rol rtsed cig ma red dam/ gang ltar rtsom yig 'di bris pa brgyud nged cag gi dngos gzhi'i gnad don 'di 'dra zhig ste sad mi'i khrod kyi rba (sba)dpal dbyangs ni rgya rigs yin pa dang / 〈sba bzhed 〉du gug rtags nang mchan bkod de gsal bshad byas pa ltar na/ ‘‘rba(sba)dpal dbyangs la rgya nag skad du sang shi ta zer/ la la khri bzher gyi bu sang shi ta zer/ sba gsal snang skya ba'i dus ming /de nas sems bskyed zhus nas dang rab tu byung nas ming ye shes dbang por slob dpon bo dhi sa twas btags ’’ñcazhes brjod/ 'on te sba gsal snang dang sang shi ta gnyis mi so so yin par yang dz+nyosba bzhed 〉rang du 'dod de/ 〈sba bzhed 〉du ‘‘sang shis gsol ba/ rje lha sras dang / bo dhi sa twa dang / sba gsal snang dang /bdag cag rje 'bangs smon lam gcig pas ’’zhes dang ‘‘rgyal pos sba gsal snang dang / sba sang shi ('ba' zer ba'ang 'dug) dang zhang nya bzang dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / snyer rtag btsan ldong gzigs dang lnga zhabs 'bring du khrid ’’rgyaces gsungs pa des sgrub par nus la/ 〈mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar 〉tsodu a tsa ra dpal dbyangs dang sang shi ta/ sba gsal snang bcas kyi dbar 'brel ba gang yod skor gsal bshad gang yang byas mi 'dug pas nged cag gis the tshom byed rgyu tsam las gzhan gang yang mi 'dug sba sang shi nyid rgya nag gi phru gu yin par dz+nyosba bzhed 〉du 'dod pa ma zad〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du ‘‘'di dag tu yi ge ma dag pa 'phel ba las sngar gyi rgya phrug gar mkhan de la yang rba sang shi ta zhes bris pa sogs snang yang rba rat+na ni rba khri bzher gyi bur bshad la/rgya phrug sang shi ni rgya nag gi pho nya'i bu yin pas rba'i rus su mi 'ong la ri’ñcazhes 205

bkod pa des sgrub par nus/ yen yang gnad don gzhan zhig ni dz+nyobu ston chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta ’ zhes dang / dz+nyorgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉du ‘‘sba sang shi'i bu rat+na ’’zhes gsungs pa der deb ther mkhan po dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas lan ga 'dra zhig 'debs rgyu yin nam/ gal srid sba sang shi dang 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta gnyis mi gcig gi ming yin na ming yig 'bri stangs thad sna tshogs shig yod pa ni (sba bzhed 〉du khri bzher bu sang shi ta zhes dang / 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉du 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta/ 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉du sba sang shi'i bu rat+na/〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du dbas khri sher/dz+nyorgya bod yig tshang chen mo 〉ru da was khri gsher zhes bris yod pa dang / sba yig gi tshab tu rba dang / sba dang 'ba'/ dbas/ ste dang bī zhes bris pa'ang yod la/mi zhig gi rus yig thad bod kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus rtsom pa po rnams rgyus med du gyur te sna tshogs shig bris yod pa ni gnad ka chen po zhig yin pas deng phyin dpya da gzhi yig cha sngog 'don dang de la brten nas dris lan gsab thub pa byed rgyu ni rtsom 'bri bas klog pa po rnams la zhu ba'i dmigs bsal re 'dun lags pas don gnyer ba tshos phan tshun bar bsam 'char brje res yod pa 'tshal/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/me krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis 1988lo'i zla 9par bskrun pa'i dz+nyobu ston chos 'byung 〉2186du gsal/du mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1980lo'i zla 6par bskrun pa'i 〈sba bzhed 〉258par gsal/du bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis 1987lo'i zla 10par bskrun pa'i 〈bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed 〉kyi 252par gsal/206
